query_text: A procedure for caregiving, comprising: shifting, by an operator seated in a sitting posture, a cradle receptacle from at least one of an initial location or an initial attitude to at least one of a subsequent location or a subsequent attitude by manipulating at least one of the cradle receptacle or a carrier structure holding the cradle receptacle so as to pivot and/or slide the cradle receptacle with respect to a pedestal such that a forward panel section of the cradle receptacle faces the operator and lies near enough that the operator can reach a cavity of the cradle receptacle from the sitting posture, the cradle receptacle linked to the pedestal through a post arrangement and a boom pivotally joined to the post arrangement; and reaching, by the operator in the sitting posture, a baby situated within the cavity of the cradle receptacle by advancing a first limb of the operator through a first aperture formed above a first lowered section of the cradle receptacle and a second limb of the operator through a second aperture formed above a second lowered section of the cradle receptacle such that the operator contacts the baby through the first aperture and the second aperture, the first aperture and the second aperture divided by the forward panel section, the forward panel section standing taller above a base region of the cradle receptacle than the first lowered section and the second lowered section.

A cradle apparatus comprising: a support pedestal; a upright member assembly coupled to the pedestal; a swing boom pivotally mounted to the upright member assembly; a carriage frame linked to the swing boom; a removable sleeping receptacle detachably engaged with the carriage frame; and a stabilizing outrigger pivotally attached to the upright member assembly, the stabilizing outrigger positioned beneath the pedestal, wherein: the stabilizing outrigger pivots within a same plane as the swing boom while the upright member assembly turns relative to the pedestal; and the stabilizing outrigger is arranged to engage a floor surface and to reduce the likelihood of the cradle apparatus overturning.

A cured rubber material suitable for forming a tread portion of a vehicle tyre, the cured material being produced by curing a rubber mixture comprising: (a) at least one elastomer; (b) at least one reinforcing filler chosen from the group consisting of metal hydroxides, metal oxides, hydrated metal oxides, metal salts, hydrated metal salts, and blends thereof; and (c) at least one N,N-dimethylamide corresponding to the structure set out above, in which R denotes a C6-C12 alkyl radical and each of R′ and R″ is methyl.

A tyre tread component for road vehicle wheels, comprising a cured rubbery material produced by curing a rubber mixture containing: (a) at least one elastomer; (b) at least one reinforcing agent chosen from metal hydroxides, metal oxides, hydrated metal oxides, metal salts, hydrated metal salts, and blends thereof; and (c) at least one N,N-dimethyl amide corresponding to the structure in which R denotes a C6-C12 alkyl radical and each of R′ and R″ is methyl.

A cured rubber article for forming a vehicle wheel tread, the cured rubber article having been produced by curing a rubber mixture comprising: a polyalkylene glycol having a weight average molecular weight within a range of 1500 to 8000, the cured rubber article being as recited in the preceding claim 26, wherein the polyalkylene glycol is present in the rubber mixture as a processing aid.

An elastomeric support member for a airless wheel, comprising: an outer extremity configured to couple the member to an annular tread band; an inner extremity configured to couple the member to a central boss; and a body spanning from the inner extremity to the outer extremity, the body containing a filament-like strengthening element winding in a zigzag path between the inner extremity and the outer extremity.

A tire without air pressure, comprising: a circular tread portion configured to engage a road surface; a band layer carrying the tread portion; and a linkage assembly coupling the band layer to a central hub, the linkage assembly including a plurality of elastomer-based struts, each strut including: an outboard terminal region for attaching the strut to the band layer; an inboard terminal region for attaching the strut to the central hub; and a body portion spanning from the inboard terminal region to the outboard terminal region, the body portion containing a filament that is embedded between a first elastomeric sheet and a second elastomeric sheet, the filament zigzagging from the inboard terminal region toward the outboard terminal region.

A two-wheeler tyre, comprising: a plurality of lugs disposed over a tread contact face; wherein, when a tread semi-span measured along the carcass surface from a mid-plane to a tread contact edge is split into two equal zones, one zone being a central tread zone and the other a shoulder tread zone, a intermediate lug of the plurality whose exterior sidewall, facing away from the mid-plane in the axial direction, lies within the shoulder tread zone is formed such that only that exterior sidewall has its upper edge bevelled, thereby providing a bevelled portion on the intermediate lug.

A pneumatic vehicle wheel covering, the covering including: an axis of revolution, a median plane situated at a central location along the axis of revolution; and a peripheral tread region encircling the axis of revolution, the peripheral tread region including a tread design presenting at least a first repeating unit and a second repeating unit, each of which contains: a central land element intersected by the median plane, and two lateral land rows which are angled relative to each other and extend outward from the central land element; the first repeating unit having a first repeat distance and a first count of land elements; and the second repeating unit having a second repeat distance which is less than the first repeat distance, and a second count of land elements which exceeds the first count of land elements.

A pneumatic vehicular tyre, comprising: a spin axis, a median plane located at a central station along the spin axis; a peripheral tread region encircling the spin axis, the tread region having a tread design presenting at least a first repeating unit and a second repeating unit; the first repeating unit containing a first set of uniform protrusions which include a first central protrusion and two lateral protrusion rows angled relative to one another, and a first quantity of uniform protrusions; and the second repeating unit containing a second set of uniform protrusions which include a second central protrusion adjoining the first central protrusion, and two lateral protrusion rows angled relative to one another, and a second quantity of uniform protrusions greater than the first quantity.

A pneumatic vehicle wheel covering, comprising: a ground-contacting surface configured with a first repeating motif and a second repeating motif, the first repeating motif spanning a first longitudinal distance and incorporating a first plurality of ground-engaging segments disposed in a chevron-like arrangement extending transversely across the surface's breadth; the second repeating motif spanning a second longitudinal distance that is less than the first longitudinal distance and incorporating a second plurality of ground-engaging segments disposed in a chevron-like arrangement extending transversely across the surface's breadth.

A heavy-vehicle tyre tread designed to contact the road by way of a running face, the tread including grooves bounding projecting blocks, the tread in an unworn condition possessing at least one compound incision which includes, when traced along a median trajectory, a succession of outer recesses that open at the running face alternating with inner recesses that do not open at the running face, each pair of adjacent recesses, one outer and one inner, being joined together by a linking passage of non-zero extent, each outer recess possessing, within a median plane that contains the median trajectory and a radial axis perpendicular to the running face, a depth measured along the radial axis between the running face and a floor of the outer recess, and an extent measured along the median trajectory at the running face, each inner recess possessing, within the median plane, a depth measured along the radial axis between a roof of the inner recess and a floor of the inner recess situated radially inward of the floor of the outer recess, and an extent measured along the median trajectory at the floor of the inner recess, each linking passage possessing, within the median plane, a depth measured along the radial axis between an upper wall and a lower wall of the linking passage at the circumferential junction between the outer recess and the linking passage, and an extent measured along the median trajectory between the outer recess and the inner recess, the compound incision having, within the median plane, an overall depth measured along the radial axis between the running face and the floor of the inner recess, the depth of each outer recess being at least equal to half the overall depth of the compound incision, wherein the depth of each linking passage is at most equal to one third of the overall depth of the compound incision.

A tire monitoring calibration procedure implemented in a tire pressure detection unit, the procedure comprising: sending a locale indicator, which includes at least one of a nation, a district or a purchaser, to a handheld smart apparatus over a short-range wireless link, thereby instructing the smart apparatus to automatically cross-reference a data store using the locale indicator and to supply, from the data store, a maker identifier associated with a predefined vehicle model designator; obtaining the maker identifier transmitted by the smart apparatus over the short-range wireless link; and configuring the tire pressure detection unit according to the maker identifier.

A tire monitoring reprogramming process executed on a handheld or portable computing unit, comprising: obtaining a locale descriptor having at least one of a nation, a geographic zone, or a purchaser through short-range wireless exchange from a tire monitor; aligning a stored records collection with the locale descriptor; retrieving from the records collection a maker key associated with a predefined automobile model descriptor; and transmitting the maker key to the tire monitor through short-range wireless exchange in order to direct reconfiguration of the tire monitor according to the maker key.

A valve stem extraction apparatus for dislodging a tire stem from an aperture formed in a wheel flange comprising a housing, a turnable screw element, a pivoting wheel-engaging element, a joining arm, and a grip; each of said turnable screw element, said pivoting wheel-engaging element, and said joining arm being mobile relative to said housing; said grip being attached to said housing and offset from at least one of said turnable screw element, said pivoting wheel-engaging element, and said joining arm; said valve stem extraction apparatus being arranged to withdraw a tire stem from a wheel flange while a lengthwise centerline of the tire stem stays aligned or nearly aligned with a lengthwise centerline of the aperture in the wheel flange during withdrawal of the tire stem from the wheel flange.

A process for extracting a valve stem from an opening formed in a vehicle wheel flange, the process comprising: supplying said wheel flange carrying said valve stem, with said valve stem partially seated within said opening; furnishing a pivoting valve extraction apparatus including a main frame, a rotatable screw element, a pivotable flange-engaging element, a coupling arm, and a grip; each of said rotatable screw element, said pivotable flange-engaging element, and said coupling arm being movably joined to said main frame; said grip being secured to said main frame and separated from at least one of said rotatable screw element, said pivotable flange-engaging element, and said coupling arm; threadably engaging said rotatable screw element with an upper end of said valve stem; placing a lower edge of said pivotable flange-engaging element against an upper face of said wheel flange; exerting a downward load on said grip to draw said valve stem upward out of said wheel flange; and wherein said apparatus is operable to withdraw said valve stem from said opening while a central axis of said valve stem stays aligned or substantially aligned with a central axis of said opening throughout withdrawal.

An aerial drone apparatus, comprising: an impermeable casing; a rotor aperture passing through the impermeable casing; a rotor mounted to the impermeable casing and situated inside the rotor aperture; a buoyant enclosure attached to the impermeable casing and arranged to keep the apparatus afloat on a water surface; and a controller located within the impermeable casing, the controller being arranged to run the apparatus in a first state that includes flying the apparatus through atmosphere, and in a second state that includes maneuvering the apparatus beneath the water surface.

A technique for acquiring photographs with an aerial drone, the drone including a sealed enclosure, a controller situated inside the sealed enclosure, an aperture passing through the sealed enclosure, a rotor fitted to the sealed enclosure and located within the aperture, and a flotation chamber attached to the sealed enclosure that keeps the drone afloat on a water surface, the technique comprising: flying the drone through atmosphere in a first operating state; transitioning the drone from the first operating state into a second operating state; and maneuvering the drone beneath a water surface in the second operating state.

A non-transitory machine-readable storage device holding instructions that, upon execution, direct a processing circuit of an aerial drone having a sealed enclosure, a controller contained within the sealed enclosure, a rotor aperture passing through the sealed enclosure, a rotor mounted to the sealed enclosure and situated inside the rotor aperture, and a float body attached to the sealed enclosure that keeps the drone afloat on water, to carry out the following: running the drone in a first operating state involving flight through atmospheric air; transitioning the drone from the first operating state to a second operating state; and running the drone in the second operating state involving movement beneath the water surface.

A vehicle front corner linkage, comprising: a control arm having a first extremity furnished with a hub-carrying section configured to receive a steerable road wheel of a motor vehicle and a second extremity situated laterally closer to the vehicle centerline than the hub-carrying section, the second extremity including a chassis coupling section designed for fastening to a structural chassis member of the vehicle; and a shock absorber carried by a mounting bracket formed on a region of the control arm adjacent the hub-carrying section, the shock absorber having a lower end received by the mounting bracket and an upper end joined to the structural chassis member; wherein the mounting bracket of the control arm incorporates a fracture-initiating weakened zone that promotes controlled rupture of the control arm.

A segmented vehicle wheel structure, comprising: a hub-receiving band having a cylindrical sleeve, a bead-retaining flange extending from an circumferential edge of said sleeve toward its axis, and a lip section emerging outwardly from a junction of said sleeve and said flange, said flange defining a flat face whose perpendicular is aligned with an axis of said sleeve, said lip section defining a sloped face joined to an outer margin of said flat face and forming an oblique included angle therewith, and a rim-edge face joined to an outer border of said sloped face and forming an oblique included angle therewith; and a spoked plate secured to said band, and including a central plate body, a plurality of arms radiating outwardly from said central plate body and circumferentially separated from one another, and a stiffening annulus joined to said arms and affixed to said lip section, said stiffening annulus bearing against at least one of said sloped face and said rim-edge face.

A non-pneumatic wheel assembly comprising: a ring-shaped outer band adapted to engage a driving surface; a ring-shaped hub zone positioned radially inside the outer band and adapted to engage an electrically conductive rim; and a web member linking the outer band with the hub zone, wherein the outer band includes a first region exhibiting electrical conductivity and presenting a traction face, and a second region positioned toward the hub zone and abutting the first region, the second region, the web member, and the hub zone incorporate a polymeric material or elastomeric material, the polymeric or elastomeric material contains an static-dissipating additive, the static-dissipating additive is a polymer-type or surfactant-type agent, and the static-dissipating additive is present in an amount of 0.5 to 20% by mass relative to 100% by mass of a base constituent of the polymeric or elastomeric material.

A non-air-filled wheel covering apparatus comprising: an inner annular member possessing a smaller radial extent; an outer annular member possessing a larger radial extent than the inner annular member, the outer annular member being arranged concentrically about the inner annular member; a web arrangement joining the inner annular member to the outer annular member; and a ground-engaging assembly secured to the outer annular member, the ground-engaging assembly including a surface wear layer and a reinforcing belt, the reinforcing belt including a strand bundle formed of a multitude of separate strands exhibiting a non-round profile, the strands being positioned and oriented such that they occupy at least 92% of the bundle's volume.

A process for fabricating a non-pneumatic wheel covering, the process comprising: furnishing a base annulus of a first radius and a crown annulus of a second radius exceeding the first radius; joining the base annulus to the crown annulus via a bracing framework; producing a multitude of separate strands possessing a non-round profile; consolidating the multitude of separate strands into a traction band exhibiting a fill fraction of at least 92%; laminating a wear layer onto the traction band to yield a peripheral tread; and mounting the peripheral tread onto the crown annulus.

A airless wheel tyre, comprising: a base annulus having a first measure across; a crown annulus having a second measure across larger than the first measure, the crown annulus being generally concentric with the base annulus; web structure joining the base annulus to the crown annulus; and a peripheral tread secured to the crown annulus, the peripheral tread including a wearing layer, at least one non-stretchable ply, and at least one stretchable ply, the at least one non-stretchable ply and the at least one stretchable ply being positioned between the wearing layer and the crown annulus along a radial orientation of the airless wheel tyre, the at least one non-stretchable ply including a filament bundle containing a plurality of discrete strands whose cross-section is non-round, a circle enclosing each of the strands having a dimension of 0.1-25 mm, each of the strands bearing a sheath having a thickness of 0-10 mm.

A tire without inflation, delimiting axial, radial, and peripheral orientations, the tire comprising: a ring-shaped flexible belt having a ring-shaped shear stratum formed of an elastomer; and a set of separate, ring-shaped strengthening members embedded in the shear stratum along a number of axially-running lines lying in a radial plane of the tire, the strengthening members exhibiting rectangular profiles within the radial plane of the tire, the strengthening members each defining a midpoint, wherein the midpoints of the strengthening members in neighboring axially-running lines are displaced relative to one another along the radial direction while the midpoints of the strengthening members in alternating lines along the radial direction are mutually aligned along the radial direction, wherein the strengthening members are free of metal, and wherein a volumetric proportion VF of the strengthening members is at least 0.7.

A pneumatic radial casing for a construction-site machine, including: a belt package positioned radially beneath a tread band of axial breadth Lbdr and positioned radially above a ply structure; the belt package having at least two cross-wise bracing plies, a first of greater lateral extent Ltmax and a second of lesser lateral extent Ltmin, each bracing ply formed from parallel steel cords inclined at angles between 10 and 45 degrees relative to the peripheral direction, with at least two of the inclination angles of different algebraic sign; the belt package further including at least one circumferential restraining ply of maximum lateral extent Lfmax formed from stretchable steel cords parallel to one another and inclined at no more than 5 degrees to the peripheral direction (XX′); each cord of every ply of the belt package exhibiting, once excised from its elastomeric matrix, a structural elongation As, a maximum load Fm in newtons, a tensile strength Rm in megapascals, an ultimate total elongation At and a tensile modulus, all measured per ASTM D 2696-04; each cord of the restraining ply having a structural elongation Asf of at least 0.5%, an ultimate total elongation Atf of at least 3% and a tensile modulus Ef of at most 150 GPa; the cords of the bracing plies being stretchable and having a structural elongation Ast of at least 0.5%, an ultimate total elongation Att of at least 3% and a tensile modulus Et of at most 150 GPa; and all metallic reinforcers within the belt package being stretchable.

A process for producing a vehicle tyre, the process comprising: laying a elastomeric layer onto a shaping core to create a hollow green body for the tyre, inflating the hollow green body so as to shape a casing of the tyre, placing a wire member and a fabric member over the casing, thereby producing a green tyre assembly, vulcanizing the green tyre assembly, thereby joining the members to one another through vulcanization, obtaining a compound composed by blending hydrothermally carbonized lignin with an elastomeric base substance having a gas-barrier function, and positioning the compound on the shaping core prior to said inflating of the hollow green body, and/or positioning the compound on an interior face of the casing, the process further comprising: disposing a reinforcement such that at least a portion of the compound containing the hydrothermally carbonized lignin lies between an innermost side of the tyre and the reinforcement.

A pneumatic vehicle wheel covering comprising: a pair of annular bead reinforcements; a ply structure running between the annular bead reinforcements; a reinforcing ply assembly positioned radially outward of the ply structure; and an outer wear layer positioned radially outward of the reinforcing ply assembly; wherein an external diameter OD (mm) lies within a span of 200≤OD≤660, an overall cross-sectional width SW (mm) lies within a span of 100≤SW≤400, the reinforcing ply assembly includes a pair of inclined plies consisting of a broad inclined ply and a narrow inclined ply, and a radial thickness Tce (mm), measured in a central median plane from a running surface contour to an outer peripheral face of the broad inclined ply, satisfies 0.008≤Tce/OD≤0.130 relative to the external diameter OD (mm).

A motorcycle tyre comprising: a tread section having a first tread margin, a second tread margin, a road-engaging face bounded between the first tread margin and the second tread margin, a set of channels formed in the road-engaging face, and a tread circumferential half-span, wherein the tread circumferential half-span is an arc length measured along the road-engaging face from an equatorial plane of the tyre to the first tread margin; the channels include a series of central channels situated on the equatorial plane, a series of intermediate channels situated nearer the first tread margin than the central channels, and a series of edge channels situated nearer the first tread margin than the intermediate channels; each of the central channels is folded into a V-profile projecting toward one side in a tyre circumferential direction; and each of the channels has a minimum separation from a neighbouring channel adjacent thereto of between 5% and 30% of the tread circumferential half-span.

A tire for pneumatic inflation, comprising: a set of bead sections positioned on opposite sides of a tire midplane along the tire's lateral axis; bead assemblies located within the bead sections, each bead assembly being formed by looping bead filaments into an annular configuration and presenting a polygonal profile when viewed in a meridional section; a casing ply spanning between the bead sections on both lateral sides, the casing ply passing around an inward side of each bead assembly in the radial direction from its inboard lateral face and being turned up toward an outboard lateral side at the bead section, the casing ply comprising casing cords encapsulated in a topping elastomer; an inner fiber-based reinforcing ply wrapped about each bead assembly and comprising organic fiber cords encapsulated in an elastomeric coating; and an elastomeric reinforcement layer interposed between the inner fiber-based reinforcing ply and the casing ply so as to envelop at least a filler apex on the innermost lateral side of the bead assembly, wherein a minimum separation between the bead filaments and the casing cords is 3 mm or greater.

A pressurization arrangement comprising: a feed passage extending through a rotating coupling into a central body; the central body including a flexible membrane engaging a biasing element, the membrane isolating the feed passage from a discharge passage; the biasing element being arranged to permit two-way flow of working fluid between the feed passage and the discharge passage when fluid pressure exceeds a set limit pressure.

A process for inflating a tire on a spinning wheel, the process comprising: coupling a tire to a rotating hub through a flexible line; calibrating the rotating hub to a first activation pressure; charging a feed passage to a set fluid pressure, the feed passage extending through a rotating seal to the rotating hub while being isolated from the flexible line by a flexible membrane; delivering air from the feed passage into the tire upon the tire pressure falling beneath the first activation pressure and displacing the flexible membrane; and discharging air from the tire into the feed passage upon the tire pressure rising above the first activation pressure and displacing the flexible membrane.

A tire pressure telemetry apparatus comprising: a tubular stem body having a central bore, externally threaded surfaces, and at least one aperture extending radially through its sidewall; a cartridge component detachably seated within the central bore of the tubular stem body, the cartridge component carrying an electrochemical power cell coupled to a valve core; and a monitoring housing receiving the tubular stem body in removable fashion, the monitoring housing containing a circuit board bearing a pressure transducer, wherein the electrochemical power cell is electrically coupled to the circuit board.

A tire pressure sensing valve body apparatus, comprising: a tubular member defining a central bore; a first threaded region formed on an exterior surface of the tubular member adjacent a first terminus, the first threaded region exhibiting an M8 by 1.0 male thread profile; a second threaded region disposed nearer a midpoint of the tubular member along its exterior surface, the second threaded region exhibiting an M10 by 1.25 male thread profile; a releasable retention feature; a flange body situated between the second threaded region and the releasable retention feature; at least one airflow aperture traversing the flange body, the airflow aperture extending from a sidewall of the flange body into the central bore; and a third threaded region located at the first terminus on an interior surface of the tubular member.

A method for handling tire pressure transducer identification data, the method comprising: identifying a wheel location whose stored transducer identification data in a tire monitoring arrangement is to be erased; producing spurious identification data for the transducer at the wheel location to be erased; following activation of a training state by the tire monitoring arrangement, transmitting the spurious identification data to the tire monitoring arrangement so that the arrangement overwrites the transducer identification data of the wheel location with the spurious identification data; acquiring genuine identification data of a transducer at a wheel location to be paired, the wheel location to be paired including the wheel location to be erased; and transmitting the genuine identification data to the tire monitoring arrangement so that the arrangement overwrites the identification data of the transducer at the wheel location to be paired with the genuine identification data.

A tyre pressure transducer data handling apparatus, comprising: a controller, a storage medium, a network port, and a data bus, wherein the controller, the storage medium, and the network port exchange signals with one another over the data bus; the storage medium holds at least one runnable directive that prompts the controller to carry out the following procedure: identifying a wheel location whose stored transducer identification data in a tyre monitoring arrangement must be erased; producing spurious identification data for the transducer at the wheel location to be erased; once the tyre monitoring arrangement activates a teaching state, transmitting the spurious identification data to the tyre monitoring arrangement so that the arrangement overwrites the identification data of the transducer at that wheel location with the spurious identification data; acquiring genuine identification data of the transducer at a wheel location to be paired, the wheel location to be paired encompassing the wheel location to be erased; and transmitting the genuine identification data to the tyre monitoring arrangement so that the arrangement overwrites the identification data of the transducer at the wheel location to be paired with the genuine identification data.

A non-transitory machine-readable medium storing at least one executable instruction, the instruction, upon execution by a processing unit, directing the processing unit to carry out a procedure comprising: identifying a wheel location whose associated pressure transducer identifier held by a tire monitoring arrangement is to be erased; producing a spurious identifier for the pressure transducer at the wheel location to be erased; upon the tire monitoring arrangement entering a training state, transmitting the spurious identifier to the tire monitoring arrangement so that it substitutes the spurious identifier for the identifier of the pressure transducer at that location; acquiring the genuine identifier of a pressure transducer at a wheel location to be paired, the wheel location to be paired encompassing the wheel location to be erased; and transmitting the genuine identifier to the tire monitoring arrangement so that it replaces the identifier of the pressure transducer at the wheel location to be paired with the genuine identifier.

An apparatus for securing a spoke to a bicycle rim, the apparatus being joined to at least one terminal region of a spoke fitted to a wheel, the apparatus comprising: a unitary body having a flange-like head and a shank of reduced cross-section extending from the head toward one side; a seat member defining an aperture through which the shank is received; and a damping element defining a bore and disposed between the head and the seat member by receiving the shank through the bore.

A wheel structure in which a circumferential rim and a central hub are joined through a set of wire spokes, the wheel structure comprising: a threaded fastener unit affixed to at least one terminal region of each spoke, wherein the fastener unit includes: a body having a flange positioned on a first side with respect to the axial direction of an opening formed in the rim or the hub, and a shank projecting from the flange toward a second side and threadably engaged with the spoke while passing through the opening; a seat member defining a first aperture, received over the shank through the first aperture, arranged on the first side relative to the axial direction of the opening, and bearing against the rim or the hub; and a damping element defining a second aperture and interposed between the flange and the seat member by receiving the shank through the second aperture.

A vehicle road wheel of full-face fabricated construction, comprising: a barrel structure centered on an axis of rotation, the barrel structure incorporating an inner retaining lip; an inner tyre seating ledge; an outer tyre seating ledge; a drop center channel positioned between the inner and outer tyre seating ledges; an outer edge flange bent outward so as to project radially away from the axis of rotation; and a face plate having a hub-engaging center section with a central bore coaxial with the axis of rotation and a plurality of fastener apertures distributed circumferentially around the central bore; and a recessed seat formed at a peripheral end of the face plate, the recessed seat presenting a locally thinned zone at that peripheral end relative to the adjacent face plate thickness immediately beyond it, wherein the outer edge flange is received within the recessed seat and fixed thereto; wherein the wheel is either a euroflange wheel or a non-euroflange wheel.

A wheel for a motor vehicle, the wheel being built from separately formed parts, comprising: a barrel component possessing an outwardly bent outboard lip that projects radially away from a rotational axis of the wheel; and a face component presenting a securing zone at a peripheral edge, the securing zone exhibiting a localized thinning relative to an adjoining section of the face component situated immediately beside the peripheral edge, wherein the outboard lip is positioned within the securing zone and fastened thereto; wherein the wheel is either a euro-style flange wheel or a non-euro-style flange wheel.

A wheel assembly comprising: a barrel component delimiting a rotational axis and presenting a terminal outward lip; and a face member incorporating an indentation at a peripheral edge that forms a zone of diminished wall thickness, wherein the terminal outward lip of the barrel component is at least partly seated within the indentation of the face member, and wherein the barrel component is fastened to the face member, the wheel assembly being either a euro-style wheel or a non-euro-style wheel.

A process of manufacturing a complete-surface built-up road wheel, the process comprising: furnishing a barrel element establishing a rotational axis of the wheel, the barrel element incorporating an inboard retention lip; an inboard bead support; an outboard bead support; a depression situated between the inboard and outboard bead supports; a terminal outboard edge extending outwardly from the rotational axis in a radially outward orientation, the terminal outboard edge being folded outwardly; furnishing a web element having: a central hub seat incorporating an axial bore disposed about the rotational axis and a plurality of fastener apertures spaced circumferentially about the axial bore; and a joining zone formed at a peripheral extremity of the web element, the joining zone presenting a locally diminished thickness at the peripheral extremity relative to a thickness of the web element immediately adjacent the peripheral extremity, wherein the terminal outboard edge of the barrel element is arranged to seat within the joining zone of the web element and be fixed thereto; and affixing the web element to the barrel element; wherein the complete-surface built-up road wheel is either a euro-flange road wheel or a non-euro-flange road wheel.

An automotive assembly incorporating a hubcap arrangement, comprising: a road-engaging wheel having a hub-mounted rim and a pneumatic casing seated on the rim; a pivot housing joined to the road-engaging wheel, the pivot housing structured to spin independently of the road-engaging wheel during forward or reverse travel of the automotive assembly; a hubcap affixed to the pivot housing, the hubcap having a first segment that overlies a first sector of the pneumatic casing; a second segment that overlies a second sector of the pneumatic casing, the second segment having a first zone structured to, during operation, abut a first section of a body panel of the automotive assembly when the automotive assembly steers in a first lateral direction; and a second zone structured to, during operation, abut a second section of the body panel when the automotive assembly steers in a second lateral direction.

A motor conveyance, comprising: a road wheel having a hub body and a tread band mounted on the hub body; a journal housing mounted to the road wheel; a hubcap secured to the journal housing, the hubcap presenting an exterior face and an interior face oriented toward the road wheel; a fixed link; and a restraint arrangement joined to the fixed link and to the interior face of the hubcap, the restraint arrangement including: a stabilizer element having a proximal end attached to the fixed link and a distal end provided with a guide socket; and a carriage element fastened to the interior face of the hubcap and slidably engaged within the guide socket of the stabilizer element.

A vehicular rim arrangement configured for mating with a set of decorative cover panels, the rim arrangement comprising: a shell possessing a round peripheral wall enclosing an inner void, the peripheral wall terminating at a first margin and a second margin; a mounting disc secured to the peripheral wall within the inner void, the mounting disc defining a series of apertures suitable for fastening the mounting disc and the shell to the vehicle; and a coupling member positioned at the center of the mounting disc, the coupling member including a central spigot operable to receive one or more of the decorative cover panels in detachable engagement.

A road-wheel arrangement configured for mounting on an automobile having studs for securing wheels, the arrangement comprising: a rim body including a peripheral wall bounding an open inner cavity, the peripheral wall terminating in a first ring-shaped edge and an opposing second ring-shaped edge; a central boss joined to the rim body and positioned at the middle of the inner cavity, the central boss presenting an outward-facing surface and an inward-facing surface and defining a plurality of bores dimensioned and contoured to slide over the studs for fastening the boss and rim body to the automobile; and a decorative cover panel dimensioned and contoured to be detachably secured to at least one of the central boss and the rim body so as to overlie a segment of the central boss and a section of the inner surface of the rim body.

A motor vehicle provided with a set of fasteners, the motor vehicle comprising: a rim unit including a shell having a lateral wall whose inner face bounds a cavity, the shell defining an open proximal extremity and an open distal extremity that is in fluid-free communication through the cavity with the proximal extremity; a central disc disposed within the cavity and presenting an outer face and an inner face, the disc comprising a plurality of apertures dimensioned and configured to fit over the respective fasteners so as to secure the disc and shell to the motor vehicle; and a decorative cover plate dimensioned and configured to be detachably connected to at least one of the disc and the shell so as to overlay at least a segment of the disc and at least a segment of the inner face of the lateral wall on the outer face side of the disc.

A rolling drive apparatus, comprising: a central support frame and a set of wheel segments coupled around a periphery of the central support frame; each wheel segment including a carrier housing with a primary rotor module and a secondary rotor module, the primary rotor module having a main spindle and an axially fixed rotor body; the secondary rotor module including an auxiliary spindle and a free-spinning rotor body mounted thereon; wherein, in at least one of the wheel segments, the free-spinning rotor body is retained between a shoulder projecting radially from the auxiliary spindle and a retaining interface of the carrier housing; and the wheel segments are distributed in a circumferential arrangement about the central support frame so that the primary rotor bodies and the free-spinning rotor bodies together define a continuous annular rolling surface; and wherein the carrier housing further includes the retaining interface, and the auxiliary spindle comprises a spindle core and the shoulder extending outwardly from an outer surface of the spindle core, and in at least one of the wheel segments, the spindle core is coupled and fastened to the retaining interface to trap the free-spinning rotor body between the shoulder and the retaining interface.

A locomotion apparatus, comprising: a chassis and a wheel arrangement, the wheel arrangement including a central mount and a plurality of roller modules each secured to the central mount; each roller module having a primary roller subassembly with a support frame and a first rolling member carried by the support frame, and a secondary roller subassembly having a spindle and a second rolling member supported on the spindle; wherein, in at least one roller module, the second rolling member is confined between a stop projecting from an outer surface of the spindle and the support frame, the plurality of roller modules being spaced circumferentially about the central mount so that the first and second rolling members collectively define a continuous annular rolling surface; and wherein, in the at least one roller module, a body of the spindle is fastened to a coupling feature of the support frame to retain the second rolling member between the stop and the coupling feature.

A cycle wheel hub for vehicles driven at least partly by human muscle power, comprising: a spindle; an outer casing; a driven member; and a one-way clutch assembly; wherein the outer casing is carried for turning on the spindle by two axially separated casing bearings, specifically an inboard casing bearing and a distal casing bearing; and wherein the driven member includes a driven body and is mounted on the spindle for turning by two axially separated driven-member bearings, specifically an inboard driven-member bearing and a distal driven-member bearing, and wherein the one-way clutch assembly includes a casing-side ratchet disk arrangement and a driven-side ratchet disk arrangement engaging therewith, each having a face serration for mutual meshing, and urged into a meshed state by a spring element; the driven body includes at least two segments, namely a leading segment and a trailing segment joined to the leading segment so as to transmit torque without relative rotation, one of the segments receives one of the driven-member bearings while the other segment receives the remaining driven-member bearing, and the driven-side ratchet disk arrangement is supported on the driven body.

A freewheel-type driven element for a human-powered cycle hub, the element comprising: a driven body extending from a proximal, hub-facing extremity toward a distal extremity; the driven body being carried on a hub spindle by way of two axially separated bearings, namely a proximal bearing situated toward the hub and a distal bearing situated opposite it; a driving-face arrangement attached to the driven body that selectively interlocks with a hub casing in a torque-transmitting sense during propulsion and disengages from the hub casing during coasting; wherein the driving-face arrangement includes a front dentition meshing with a complementary front dentition associated with the hub casing and is urged into meshing contact by at least one resilient urging element; the driven body includes at least two segments, a first segment and a second segment joined to the first segment so as to rotate together without relative motion; and one of the bearings is seated within one of the segments while the other bearing is seated within the remaining segment.

A drive assembly for human-propelled conveyances, comprising: a central spindle; an outer casing; a driven member having a main body; and a one-way clutch arrangement having a pair of meshing ratchet members, namely, a casing-side ratchet member joined to the outer casing, and a body-side ratchet member engaging it and joined to the main body, to link the driven member to the outer casing without slippage in the forward drive direction, and to disconnect them from each other during coasting (F); wherein each of the ratchet members includes a face gear for mutual meshing, and is urged by at least one resilient element into a meshed condition (E); wherein at least one cog seat for receiving at least one chain wheel is formed externally on the main body; and wherein the main body includes, at its inboard end, an interior radial shoulder to bear radially a casing-side rotational bearing; on a front face at the inboard end of the driven member, radially between the interior radial shoulder and an exterior wall of the driven member, an annular pocket open from the front face is formed, in which the body-side ratchet member is received in a non-rotatable manner in the forward drive direction and is axially displaceable; and wherein the one-way clutch arrangement is retained within the annular pocket.

A freewheel-carrying driven member for a hub of a human-propelled cycle, the member having a driven body extending from an inboard end toward an outboard terminus and including a driven-side dental clutch assembly joined to the driven body so as to lock it against rotation relative to a hub casing when propelled forward and to release it while coasting; wherein the driven-side dental clutch assembly carries a terminal set of teeth meshing with a complementary set on the hub casing and is urged toward meshing by at least one resilient element; wherein at least one gear seat for receiving at least one sprocket element is formed externally on the driven body, and wherein the driven body includes, at the inboard end, an inward radial shoulder bearing radially against an inboard rotor bearing; and an axially facing surface at the inboard end, radially intermediate the inward radial shoulder and an outer peripheral wall, defines an annular pocket open through that surface, in which the driven-side dental clutch assembly is seated against relative rotation in the forward drive direction while remaining axially displaceable.

An apparatus for vehicles powered at least in part by human muscle, comprising: a central spindle; an outer housing rotatably carried on at least two axially separated bearings, namely at least one bearing positioned nearer a drive member and at least one bearing positioned farther from the drive member; a drive member rotatably carried on at least two axially separated bearings, namely one bearing positioned nearer the outer housing and at least one bearing positioned farther from the outer housing; and a one-way clutch assembly having a housing-side serrated disc coupled to the outer housing and a drive-side serrated disc cooperating therewith and coupled to the drive member, each having front serrations meshing with one another and urged into an engaged state by at least one spring element, wherein the front serrations of the housing-side disc face axially toward the drive member; wherein the drive-side serrated disc is received radially within the drive member and, via an outer radial serration engaging an inner radial serration of the drive member, is locked against rotation relative to the drive member in the driving direction, and wherein the front serrations of the drive-side disc face axially toward the outer housing; and wherein the clear inside diameter of the drive-side serrated disc exceeds the outside diameter of the bearing positioned nearer the outer housing.

A drive hub for partly human-driven conveyances, the drive hub comprising: an axle member; an outer casing; a clamping collar; a driven element; and a one-way clutch arrangement; wherein the one-way clutch arrangement includes a casing-side ratchet disk assembly and a driven-side ratchet disk assembly cooperating therewith, each having a face serration configured to mesh with the other, and urged into a meshing condition by at least one spring member, wherein the clamping collar presents an exterior profile bearing an outer screw thread, and a central bore bounded by an interior profile, the interior profile being formed as a non-circular inner engagement profile that couples, in a torque-transmitting manner along the drive direction, with a complementary non-circular outer engagement profile on the periphery of the casing-side ratchet disk assembly; and the clamping collar possesses a central recess at its driven-side end, such that the outer screw thread on the clamping collar extends axially further toward the driven element than does the inner engagement profile, thereby enlarging the outer screw thread of the clamping collar in the direction toward the driven element.

A retaining collar for a cycle-type drive hub, comprising: a collar main part adapted to be threaded onto a rotor-facing terminal section of a hub casing so as to accommodate within its cavity a sprocket-side ratchet member of a one-way clutch arrangement; an exterior surface bearing a helical ridge; and a central bore defining an internal profile, the internal profile including a non-circular engagement profile that engages, in a torque-transmitting manner along the drive direction, a complementary non-circular outer engagement profile on the periphery of the sprocket-side ratchet member; wherein the collar main part features a central recess at its rotor-facing end such that the helical ridge projects axially further toward the rotor than does the engagement profile, thereby broadening the helical ridge in the direction toward the rotor.

A caster apparatus for propelling an article across a floor, the caster apparatus comprising: a casing configured to be mounted to the article; a roller holder assembly disposed inside the casing and configured to hold a roller, the roller holder assembly including a roller-engaging bracket coupled to the roller and a locking piece coupled to the casing; wherein the roller-engaging bracket includes a flexible arm bearing a catch that releasably seats within a notch of the locking piece to choose between separation and joinder of the roller-engaging bracket and the locking piece.

A gasket assembly comprising: a holding section encircling an axial orientation (A); and a main sealing flange projecting in an outward radial heading, wherein the radial orientation departs radially and at right angles from the axial orientation, and wherein the main sealing flange presents a pressurized face oriented along the axial orientation.

A utility truck, comprising: a seal element, including: a holding section encircling a central axis in a longitudinal orientation; and a main sealing flange projecting outwardly along a transverse orientation, wherein the transverse orientation extends outward at a right angle from the longitudinal orientation, and wherein the main sealing flange presents a load-bearing face facing along the longitudinal orientation; and a wheel cover possessing a pressurized air passage arrangement that runs along the longitudinal orientation.

A utility truck, comprising: a gasket assembly including a holding section surrounding a central axis in a circumferential manner; and a main sealing flange projecting in a radial dimension that extends outward and at right angles from the central axis, the main sealing flange presenting a pressurized face oriented along the central axis; and a wheel cover arrangement, comprising: a wheel cover defining a pneumatic supply passage running parallel to the central axis; and a wheel hon, wherein the main sealing flange contacts or is arranged to contact the wheel hon, and/or wherein the wheel cover is detachably secured to the wheel hon through a snap-fit latch.

A wheel covering arrangement comprising: a cover member and a gasket ring; wherein the arrangement is adapted to turn around an axis of rotation; wherein a transverse dimension extends orthogonally relative to the axis of rotation; wherein the cover member partly surrounds an interior volume; wherein the cover member comprises a conduit for conveying a liquid, the conduit communicating with the interior volume or terminating within the interior volume; wherein the gasket ring is retained within a peripheral recess of the arrangement; and wherein the recess is arranged to be placed in liquid communication with the conduit through apertures.

A road-going heavy truck, comprising: a wheel hub assembly, comprising: a cover assembly, a gasket ring and a stator member; wherein the cover assembly is arranged to turn around a longitudinal axis; wherein a transverse direction extends at right angles to the longitudinal axis; wherein the cover assembly partly surrounds a cavity; wherein the cover assembly contains a pneumatic passage that communicates with the cavity or emerges into the cavity; wherein the gasket ring is retained in a peripheral recess of the cover assembly; wherein the recess is, or can be placed, in flow communication with the pneumatic passage through apertures; and wherein the stator member contains an air supply conduit, the stator member being secured to and positioned by the cover assembly; and a spindle component that is hollow internally, wherein the stator member extends into the interior void of the spindle component, and/or wherein the air supply conduit of the stator member is, or can be placed, in flow communication with the internally hollow section of the spindle component.

A compliant rolling member comprising: a central boss establishing a rotational centerline and a mid-plane; and a flexible rim section projecting outward from the central boss, the flexible rim section including: a series of panels, a series of crease lines, and a first panel of the series of panels and a second panel of the series of panels being joined along one of the series of crease lines, the one of the series of crease lines establishing a pivot axis, the first panel being arranged to elastically displace relative to the second panel about the pivot axis.

A compliant ground-engaging rotor comprising: a central boss establishing a rotational centerline and a mid-plane bisecting the boss; and a flexible rim section projecting outward from the boss, the rim section incorporating a multitude of cells disposed in a lattice configuration, each cell being a polygon with a set of corners and a set of sides, a first cell and a second cell joined along one of the sides, the shared side establishing a flex hinge; the first cell being operable to elastically pivot with respect to the second cell about the flex hinge.

A tire wheel structure comprising: a first half-hub piece including a first cylindrical shell with an outer circumferential face, a first terminal flange projecting radially away from the outer circumferential face at one axial extremity, and a second terminal portion at the opposite axial extremity bearing a first mating face; a second half-hub piece including a second cylindrical shell with an outer circumferential face, a third terminal flange projecting radially away from the outer circumferential face at one axial extremity, and a fourth terminal portion at the opposite axial extremity bearing a second mating face; wherein the first and second mating faces are bonded to one another to define a seam, and wherein the outer circumferential faces of the first and second cylindrical shells together define a continuous rim exterior; and wherein both half-hub pieces are molded from a polymeric material.

An apparatus for sensing the tilt of a vehicle wheel, removably mountable within a wheel hub assembly, the wheel hub assembly including an outer circumferential face configured to couple with a tire to form a wheel and an end face rotationally coupled to an axle spindle, the apparatus comprising: an enclosure removably secured within the wheel hub assembly; and a detection unit disposed within the enclosure, configured to output at least one signal from which an angular deviation of the wheel relative to at least one reference direction is derivable; wherein the enclosure constitutes a hub cap seated in a central bore of the wheel hub assembly, the detection unit comprises at least one sensing element, and the sensing element is a microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) accelerometer.

A method of alerting a driver to wheel alignment deviation, comprising: a mounting operation: fitting a positioning-angle sensing attachment within a wheel rim of a motor vehicle, the sensing attachment including a detection assembly and an enclosure, the detection assembly being seated inside the enclosure, the enclosure constituting a hub covering that is fitted into a center aperture; a pairing operation: linking the detection assembly with an apparatus incorporating a processor so as to set up a data connection between the apparatus and the detection assembly; a sensing operation: producing at least one reading with the detection assembly; a computing operation: deriving an tilt value of the wheel relative to at least one reference line by applying a defined procedure to a reading; and a evaluating and notifying operation: contrasting the tilt value against a benchmark figure with the processor, and upon the tilt value falling outside a defined band around the benchmark figure, issuing a caution notice.

A cycle drivetrain arrangement, the arrangement comprising: a road wheel carrying a rotatable drum body, the drum body defining a central opening for accepting a spindle, a driven cog bore and a serrated cog situated inside the cog bore; and a free-rotation carrier assembly incorporating an external sprocket mounting portion, a catch holder bearing a series of catch hinge recesses, a set of catches hingedly fitted within the hinge recesses, and a resilient urging element that exerts a restoring load on the catches opposing their swinging movement away from a dwell face of the catch holder; wherein the catch holder sits within the serrated cog such that, upon rotation of the free-rotation carrier assembly in a forward sense relative to the drum body, the catches are permitted to swing outward from the catch holder until they meet serrations of the serrated cog, thereby driving the drum body to turn together with the free-rotation carrier assembly in the forward sense.

A cycle drivetrain coupling arrangement, the coupling arrangement comprising: a notched driven element bearing a series of projections; and a free-running carrier unit containing a retainer structure provided with a set of guide recesses, a group of latch members journaled inside the guide recesses, and a resilient urging element that exerts a restoring force on the latch members opposing their displacement away from a rest face of the retainer structure; wherein the retainer structure is situated within the notched driven element such that, upon rotation of the free-running carrier unit in a forward sense relative to the notched driven element, the latch members are free to swing outward from the retainer structure until they catch the projections of the notched driven element, thereby forcing the notched driven element to turn together with the free-running carrier unit in the forward sense.

A method of assembling a bicycle drive hub, the method comprising: furnishing a hub body unit having a serrated drive ring seated within a receiving cavity, the hub body unit being configured to join a bicycle rim through a set of wire spokes; and furnishing a freewheel unit incorporating an exterior sprocket mounting interface, a carrier element defining a plurality of hinge recesses, a plurality of catch members hingedly retained within the hinge recesses, and a resilient element exerting a restoring force on the catch members that opposes their swinging away from a rest face of the carrier element; and mating the freewheel unit with the hub body unit such that the carrier element sits inside the serrated drive ring and, upon rotation of the freewheel unit in a first sense relative to the hub body unit, the catch members swing clear of the carrier element until they engage the serrations of the drive ring, thereby driving the hub body unit to turn with the freewheel unit in the first sense.

A tire-and-wheel mounting system comprising: a pair of mirror-image annular casing halves, each half including a shut end and an unsealed end, an outer ring comprising outward-facing and inward-facing faces, and a hub-engaging ring comprising outward-facing and inward-facing faces, the hub-engaging ring being concentrically offset radially inward from the inward-facing face of the outer ring, wherein the shut end includes a flexible, continuous web extending radially between the inward-facing face of the outer ring and the outward-facing face of the hub-engaging ring, the web presenting bulged or recessed outer and inner faces, wherein the unsealed end defines an opening bounded by the inward-facing face of the outer ring, the outward-facing face of the hub-engaging ring, and the web; wherein the inward-facing faces of the hub-engaging rings of the two halves are arranged to seat upon an outer rim surface of a wheel such that the unsealed ends of each half do not enclose a closed cavity between the two halves; and wherein both annular casing halves are formed from a material containing a copolyether-ester.

An assembly combining a rim with a non-pneumatic tyre, comprising: mating ring-shaped inboard and outboard casing portions, each portion including a shut end and an unshut end, an outer tread-bearing ring having outward and inward faces, and a hub-engaging ring having outward and inward faces, the hub-engaging ring being positioned concentrically and at a smaller radius than the inward face of the outer ring, wherein the shut end includes a flexible, continuous wall spanning radially from the inward face of the outer ring to the outward face of the hub-engaging ring, the wall presenting outwardly or inwardly curved exterior and interior faces, wherein the unshut end defines a cavity bounded by the inward face of the outer ring, the hub-engaging ring, and the wall; and a rim or rim-carrying hub having an outer circumferential face; wherein the inward face of the hub-engaging ring of each of the inboard and outboard casing portions is seated on the outer circumferential face of the rim such that the unshut ends of each portion fail to define a hermetically closed chamber within the inboard and outboard portions; and wherein the ring-shaped inboard and outboard casing portions are each formed from a material comprising a copolyether-ester.

A reinforcing cord for a pneumatic tire, comprising: a polyester stretched filament bundle incorporating at least 25 percent by weight of reprocessed polyethylene terephthalate exhibiting an inherent viscosity between 0.9 dl/g and 1.5 dl/g and an isophthalic acid fraction below 1.0 mol % relative to total dicarboxylic acid constituents; wherein a breaking strength of 7.0 g/d to 8.0 g/d and an ultimate elongation of 15.0% to 17.5%, each determined per ASTM D 885, are exhibited.

A reinforced filament assembly comprising: a thermoplastic monofilament serving as an inner core element; and an outer covering including at least two sets of reinforcing strands helically laid about the inner core element, the at least two sets of reinforcing strands defining respective inclinations relative to the inner core element such that the cumulative sum of all such inclinations is substantially null.
A cord-type article comprising: a single extruded polymeric filament having a plastic matrix; and a plurality of strengthening fibrous elements dispersed within and encased by the matrix.

A two-wheeled vehicle tyre comprising: a running surface region extending between a pair of shoulder boundaries, wherein the running surface region includes a tread compound defining a contact face, the tread compound includes an outer compound stratum having a first elastomer and defining the contact face, and an inner compound stratum having a second elastomer and lying radially beneath the outer compound stratum, a damping factor tan δa of the first elastomer at 100 degrees Celsius is less than a damping factor tan δb of the second elastomer at 100 degrees Celsius, and a glass transition temperature Tga of the first elastomer is below a glass transition temperature Tgb of the second elastomer.

A wheel for an automobile, comprising: a tubular barrel; a web member having a hub section coupled to a vehicle chassis, and multiple radial arms joining the barrel to the hub section; and a closure element positioned to partly obstruct several apertures formed between the arms, wherein, with a radial dimension measured outward from the barrel axis, an axial dimension measured parallel to the spin axis of the barrel, an axially outboard direction pointing away from a vehicle midplane, and an axially inboard direction pointing toward the midplane, the barrel includes a tubular main segment, an annular arm-mounting segment extending axially and radially outward from an outboard terminal region of the main segment to which the arms attach, an annular outboard retaining lip joined to an outboard terminal region of the arm-mounting segment, and an annular inboard retaining lip joined to an inboard terminal region of the main segment for cooperating with the outboard retaining lip to secure a tire, and when a portion formed by an outboard end of the main segment together with a section of the barrel lying axially outboard of that end is designated an outboard barrel section, and an annular region situated at the innermost radial position of an interior surface of the outboard barrel section is designated an inner circumferential edge of the barrel, the closure element includes a confronting section spaced axially outboard from a part of the inner circumferential edge that axially overlaps one of the apertures, the confronting section being positioned to face that part in the axial direction so as to act as a barrier to air moving axially outward along an interior surface of the main segment, and a perimeter section extending radially outward from the confronting section and bounding at least a portion of one or more passages that connect the interior and exterior of the closure element in the axial direction, thereby furnishing the one or more passages radially outward of the inner circumferential edge.

A wheel assembly comprising: a tubular barrel; a hub member having a central mounting section secured to a chassis component, an annular fixing section joined to the barrel, and a plurality of struts linking the mounting section with the fixing section; and a closure member positioned to partly obstruct a series of apertures formed between adjacent struts, wherein, with a radial orientation taken relative to the barrel, an axial orientation taken parallel to a rotational center of the barrel, an outboard orientation denoting movement along the axis away from a vehicle midplane, and an inboard orientation denoting movement along the axis toward the vehicle midplane, and with an innermost circumferential edge of the fixing section's inner surface designated as a perimeter edge, the closure member includes an opposing section spaced outboard along the axis from the perimeter edge that partially delimits one of the apertures, the opposing section being aligned axially with the perimeter edge so as to act as a barrier against air traveling outboard along the inner surface of the fixing section, and a peripheral segment extending radially outward from the opposing section and delimiting at least a portion of one or more passages that connect the interior and exterior of the closure member along the axis, thereby furnishing the one or more passages radially outside the perimeter edge.

A wheel-balancing assembly for a vehicle, the assembly comprising: a cover panel having an outer face, an inner face, and a rim face bridging the outer face and the inner face, wherein the cover panel is adapted to be detachably secured to a mounting lip of a road wheel with the inner face facing toward the road wheel; and a rotational counterweight ring affixed to the inner face of the cover panel, wherein the counterweight ring includes an annular channel containing a filler material.

A wheel-balancing device for a road vehicle, comprising: a cover panel having an outer face, an inner face facing a rim, and an edge face joining the outer face to the inner face, the cover panel being releasably mountable to a rim flange with the inner face directed toward the rim, the cover panel including at least two apertures situated adjacent the edge face, each aperture passing from the outer face through to the inner face and sized to accept a threaded fastener that secures the cover panel to the rim flange; a rotational mass-compensating ring secured to the inner face of the cover panel; a retaining band configured to couple to the rim flange; and at least two retention brackets, each bracket having a first section mounted to the retaining band and a second section defining a bore positioned to align with one of the apertures and receive a respective threaded fastener to join the bracket to the cover panel.

A traversing apparatus for a ground-engaging robotic vehicle, the apparatus comprising: a leading roller assembly mounted to the vehicle; a trailing roller assembly mounted to the vehicle; an intermediate roller positioned between the leading roller assembly and the trailing roller assembly; arms coupling the leading roller assembly to the intermediate roller; a primary damper joined between the vehicle and the arms; and a secondary damper joined between the vehicle and the arms adjacent the primary damper.

A wheel-engaging apparatus for manipulating an automotive wheel tire, including: a chassis; a clamping unit provided with a pivoting mechanism and a jointed reach mechanism attached thereto; the reach mechanism comprising first and second extensible uprights joined at upper and lower extremities to corresponding first and second extremities of first and second extensible crossbeams; the reach mechanism further comprising first and second upper jaws and first and second lower jaws fitted to the first and second extensible uprights adjacent the respective upper and lower extremities, the upper and lower jaws configured to clasp the tire; the first and second extensible uprights carrying respective first and second upright drive cylinders; the first and second extensible crossbeams carrying respective first and second pairs of crossbeam drive cylinders; and, a hoisting unit supported on the chassis, the hoisting unit having first and second vertical hoist cylinders secured to the chassis and linked to the pivoting mechanism; wherein the upright drive cylinders and the crossbeam drive cylinders are configured to shift the upper and lower jaws between a spread condition and a retracted condition to thereby free and clasp the tire; wherein the vertical hoist cylinders are configured to shift the clamping unit between a descended location and an elevated location to thereby lower and lift the tire; and, wherein the pivoting mechanism is configured to rotate the reach mechanism between an upright orientation and a prone orientation to thereby erect and recline the tire.

An apparatus adapted to detach a wheel cover from an automobile wheel absent any rotational moment or lever action exerted upon a part other than the wheel cover, the apparatus comprising: a rod having a proximal extremity and a distal extremity, the proximal extremity bearing a catch curved beyond a ninety-degree angle; and a sliding weight mounted on the rod between the proximal extremity and the distal extremity, the sliding weight being biased by a spring, wherein a first pulling load applied to the sliding weight along a first line normal to the wheel cover and directed outwardly from the wheel causes the catch to exert a second load on the wheel cover along the first line in the outward direction.

A process comprising: detaching a wheel cover from a rim of an automobile by means of an apparatus, the apparatus possessing: an elongated rod having a proximal extremity and a distal extremity, the proximal extremity bearing a curved catch whose bend exceeds ninety degrees; and a sliding impact weight joined to the rod at a location between the proximal extremity and the distal extremity, the sliding impact weight being biased by a spring, wherein a first pulling load applied to the sliding impact weight along a first line normal to the wheel cover and directed outwardly from the rim causes the curved catch to exert a second load on the wheel cover along the first line in the same outward direction, wherein the apparatus detaches the wheel cover absent any twisting moment or lever action exerted against a structure other than the wheel cover.

A procedure for mounting a wheel cover onto a road wheel of a motor vehicle with an apparatus, the apparatus comprising: a rod having a leading extremity and a trailing extremity, the leading extremity carrying a catch curved beyond a right angle; an impact weight mounted on the rod between the leading extremity and the trailing extremity, the impact weight being biased by a resilient member; and a handle having a socket section joined to the trailing extremity of the rod and a resilient pad having a width exceeding a width of the socket section.

A traveling apparatus for conveying an appliance over a floor, the apparatus comprising: a rotating shaft bearing a roller, the roller having two opposed lateral surfaces; a threaded spindle carrying a traveling collar; at least one pivoting arm secured at one extremity to a stationary hinge location and coupled at an opposite extremity to the traveling collar, wherein each pivoting arm holds a terminal section of the rotating shaft; and an electric actuator operatively linked to the threaded spindle to turn the threaded spindle so as to shift the traveling collar and thereby move the roller between a lowered deployed position and a raised stowed position, wherein the threaded spindle is oriented tangentially to the direction of roller rotation, lies between the two lateral surfaces of the roller, and is spaced from the rotating shaft by a distance exceeding the roller radius.

A wheel holding device, comprising: a tubular collar presenting a bore dimensioned to accept a stem of a fastener that couples to a wheel support, the collar possessing a proximal extremity configured to sit adjacent a wheel bearing situated near the wheel support, and a distal extremity opposed to the proximal extremity; and a catch component attached to the collar adjacent the distal extremity, the catch component defining a catch diameter selected such that, upon failure of the wheel bearing, a wheel carried by the wheel bearing is held at least partly upon the collar by the catch component.

An assembly for a rotating ground-engaging element, comprising: a hub bearing adapted to attach to a carrier arm; a rotatable disc mounted to the hub bearing; and a securing collar situated adjacent the disc or the hub bearing, the securing collar including: a tubular body having a bore dimensioned to accept a stem of a fastener that threads into the carrier arm, the tubular body presenting a proximal terminus meant to lie adjacent the hub bearing, and a distal terminus opposite the proximal terminus; and a catch element joined to the tubular body near the distal terminus, the catch element having a catch dimension selected such that upon failure of the hub bearing, the rotatable disc is held partly upon the tubular body by the catch element.

An agricultural implement, comprising: a chassis; and a ground-engaging assembly joined to the chassis, the ground-engaging assembly including: a spindle carrier fixed to the chassis; a rotational bearing arranged to attach to the spindle carrier; a rolling disc connected to the rotational bearing; and a separation limiter situated adjacent to at least one of the rolling disc or the rotational bearing, the separation limiter including: a tubular collar having a bore dimensioned to accept a body of a fastener that threads into the spindle carrier, the tubular collar presenting an proximal terminus configured to sit adjacent to at least one of the rolling disc or the rotational bearing, and a distal terminus facing away from the proximal terminus; and a catch element secured to the tubular collar near the distal terminus, the catch element having a capture diameter selected so that, upon failure of the rotational bearing, the rolling disc is held at least partly upon the tubular collar by the catch element; and
