query_text: A rubber compound for a pneumatic tyre, the compound comprising: a quantity of a wax obtained by breaking down a polymer; a quantity of a styrene-butadiene elastomer; a quantity of a silica reinforcing agent; a quantity of a polybutadiene elastomer; and a quantity of carbon black.

A rubber compound for a pneumatic tyre, the compound consisting of: a quantity of a depolymerized polypropylene-derived wax; a quantity of styrene-butadiene copolymer elastomer; a quantity of precipitated silica reinforcing agent; a quantity of polybutadiene elastomer; a quantity of carbon black; a quantity of an antioxidant; a quantity of elemental sulfur; a quantity of stearic acid; a quantity of a vulcanization accelerator, said accelerator being N-tert-butyl-2-benzothiazolesulfenamide; a quantity of zinc oxide; and a quantity of p-phenylenediamine; wherein said wax quantity is from 1 to 5 percent by weight of said compound, wherein said zinc oxide quantity is from 2 to 4 percent by weight of said compound, wherein said antioxidant quantity is from 1 to 3 percent by weight of said compound, wherein said sulfur quantity is from 1 to 3 percent by weight of said compound, wherein said styrene-butadiene elastomer quantity is from 15 to 30 percent by weight of said compound, and wherein said silica quantity is from 25 to 30 percent by weight of said compound.

A pneumatic vehicle wheel covering comprising: an outer tread-bearing zone extended inwardly in the radial direction by a pair of lateral flanks, which are in turn followed by a pair of bead regions; an inner boundary wall defining an enclosed air-holding void of the covering; and a reinforcing assembly including at least one rigidifying member running uninterruptedly within the enclosed void from at least one of the lateral flanks or bead regions up to the tread-bearing zone, wherein the or each rigidifying member is secured within the lateral flank and/or the bead region by or about at least one radially inward load-bearing layer therein, wherein the or each rigidifying member is secured within the tread-bearing zone by or about at least one radially outward load-bearing layer therein, wherein the or each rigidifying member includes a segment traversing the enclosed void between: a radially inward securing location at which the or each rigidifying member penetrates the inner boundary wall to be fixed in or about the or one of the radially inward load-bearing layers, a radially outward securing location at which the or each rigidifying member penetrates the inner boundary wall to be fixed in or about the or one of the radially outward load-bearing layers, and wherein the tread-bearing zone has a profile thickness and comprises a plurality of land strips, two neighboring land strips being spaced apart axially from one another by a principal peripheral groove having a depth at least equal to fifty percent of the profile thickness, the radially outward securing location being aligned with one of the land strips.

A pneumatic vehicle wheel covering comprising: at least one load-bearing layer including a multitude of fabric-based strengthening strands, wherein at least a portion of the fabric-based strengthening strands each include at least two filament bundles interwound together, and wherein at least one of the at least two filament bundles is a bulked filament bundle comprising a multitude of primary fibers formed from reclaimed polymeric material intermingled with a multitude of secondary fibers formed from virgin polymeric material.

A reinforcement filament bundle for a pneumatic tire, comprising: a pair of strands intertwined with one another; wherein at least one of the strands is a bulked multifilament thread including a set of first fibers formed from reprocessed polymer partially blended with a set of second fibers formed from virgin polymer; and wherein the strands are joined in a helical twist configuration.

A jolting ride apparatus for a juvenile riding device, comprising: a chassis body; a forward running assembly and a rearward running assembly disposed beneath the chassis body to bear its weight; a saddle cover of animal-like contour fitted around the outside of the chassis body; foot rests secured by fasteners to opposite flanks of a central region of the saddle cover, sized for a child to draw in the legs; and an off-center adjusting arrangement governing the path of a leading end of the chassis body, located inside the forward running assembly; wherein the off-center adjusting arrangement includes an offset housing received within the interior of the forward running assembly, a shifting member on an inner surface of one side of the offset housing for altering the coupling location between the chassis body and the forward running assembly, and a locating spindle on an inner surface of an opposite side of the offset housing for restraining and securing the shifting member.

A cycle wheel hoop assembly, comprising a hoop body, the hoop body including a pair of lateral walls, an interior circumferential section and an exterior circumferential section; the interior circumferential section having its left and right margins joined to lower margins of the lateral walls respectively, the exterior circumferential section having its left and right margins joined to upper margins of the lateral walls respectively, a set spacing separating the interior circumferential section from the exterior circumferential section, the lateral walls, the interior circumferential section and the exterior circumferential section enclosing a void region; the interior circumferential section being thicker than the lateral walls so as to form an interior elevated ridge projecting into the void region, a curved seating channel being provided on the interior elevated ridge, the curved seating channel being provided with a plurality of evenly distributed spoke apertures each adapted to receive a spoke nipple, the spoke nipple including an enlarged cap section and a shank section, one terminal of a spoke being secured to the shank section; a transverse profile of the curved seating channel including a bowed portion, the bowed portion possessing a midpoint, the spoke apertures each defining a longitudinal axis, the midpoint acting as a reference for the longitudinal axes to pass radially through the interior circumferential section in a fan arrangement, the shank section being fitted within a respective one of the spoke apertures, and a face of the curved seating channel bearing against opposing sides of the enlarged cap section.

A rubber-metal laminate article, comprising: at least one reinforcement member having an external layer formed from a copper-zinc alloy, the member being encased within a vulcanizable elastomer blend that includes a diene-based polymer, a reinforcing particulate, a sulfur-based curing package, and a phenolic-aldehydic condensate formed from at least one aromatic polyhydroxy compound possessing an aromatic ring carrying two hydroxyl groups situated meta to one another with both ortho positions relative to at least one hydroxyl group left unsubstituted, and at least one dialdehyde species bearing two aldehyde moieties, wherein the amount of the phenolic-aldehydic condensate is below 10 phr.

A pneumatic vehicle covering, comprising: an outer tread section extended radially toward the interior by a pair of lateral flanks, which are in turn continued by a pair of rim-engaging seats, each seat including at least one peripheral strengthening member configured to permit mounting of the covering upon a wheel rim; an inner boundary wall bounding a toroidal air chamber within the covering; and a rigidifying arrangement including at least one stiffening member extending without interruption within the toroidal air chamber from at least one of the flanks or one of the seats as far as the tread section, wherein the stiffening member is secured within or about: at least one radially inward reinforcing body disposed in the flank and/or the seat, the radially inward reinforcing body being separate from the peripheral strengthening member lying on the same side of a median plane of the covering as the flank and/or the seat, and at least one radially outward reinforcing body disposed in the tread section.

A tire assembled from two separable portions, the assembly comprising: a ground-engaging band and a core structure joined together through a series of latching arrangements; the band including a wear surface situated on its exterior face, and the core structure including an elastomeric shell disposed at the outermost radial extent of the core structure; wherein each latching arrangement includes a catch that enters a receiving pocket through an aperture, each receiving pocket being bounded at least in part by a rim projecting into the pocket interior; wherein the rim delimits the aperture of the receiving pocket; wherein, for at least one of the latching arrangements, either (i) the catch is formed unitarily with an inner face of the band and the receiving pocket is formed unitarily with an outer face of the elastomeric shell, or (ii) the catch is formed unitarily with the outer face of the elastomeric shell and the receiving pocket is formed unitarily with the inner face of the band; and wherein the inner face of the band and the outer face of the elastomeric shell meet at a direct abutting boundary.

A wheel-engaging component for a bipartite tyre, the component comprising: an elastomeric shell disposed at a radially uttermost region of the component, the shell including (i) a series of projecting formations on an exterior face of the shell and unitary therewith, (ii) a series of receiving recesses on the exterior face and unitary therewith, or (iii) a mix of (i) and (ii), each receiving recess being bounded in part by a rim that intrudes into the recess and establishes an entry aperture thereof; a load-bearing framework situated radially inboard of the elastomeric shell; and a pair of flanks that descend radially inward from axially outboard margins of the elastomeric shell.

A replaceable running band for a bipartite tire, the running band comprising: a radially outward face and a radially inward face serving as opposite faces of the running band; a wear surface disposed on the radially outward face; and (i) a set of projections formed unitarily with the running band along the radially inward face, (ii) a set of retaining recesses formed unitarily with the running band along the radially inward face, or (iii) a combination of (i) and (ii), wherein each retaining recess is bounded in part by a rim extending into the retaining recess, and wherein the rim delimits an entrance of the retaining recess.

A pneumatic tyre comprising: a tread section furnished with a set of circumferential channels running continuously along a tyre circumference, a set of transverse channels running along a tyre axial direction, and a set of first lugs, wherein every first lug carries at least one first slit; in each first lug, the at least one first slit follows a serpentine course when viewed both in a section normal to its slit length and in a section parallel to a ground-engaging face of the first lug; in each first lug, the at least one first slit has a slit floor and a bridge rising radially outward from the slit floor, terminating short of the ground-engaging face of the first lug so as to partition the at least one first slit into a first segment and a second segment along the slit length; in each first lug, the floor of the first segment and the floor of the second segment undulate in a zigzag pattern in a section parallel to the ground-engaging face of the first lug; the floor of the first segment joins a first enlarged cavity of circular profile in a section normal to the slit length, the first enlarged cavity having a channel width exceeding a width of the first segment and extending in a zigzag pattern along the floor of the first segment; the floor of the second segment joins a second enlarged cavity of circular profile in a section normal to the slit length, the second enlarged cavity having a channel width exceeding a width of the second segment and extending in a zigzag pattern along the floor of the second segment; and the first enlarged cavity is not in communication with the second enlarged cavity.

A pneumatic tyre comprising: a tread section furnished with a series of peripheral channels running continuously around the tyre circumference, a set of transverse channels oriented along the tyre axis, and a plurality of first land elements, wherein each first land element carries at least one first incision, the at least one first incision follows a serpentine path both in a section orthogonal to its lengthwise direction and in a section lying parallel to the road-engaging face of the corresponding first land element, the at least one first incision includes an incision floor and a bridge member projecting locally outward in a radial direction of the tyre from the incision floor and ending short of the road-engaging face of the corresponding first land element so as to split the at least one first incision into a leading segment and a trailing segment along its lengthwise direction; the incision floor of the leading segment joins a first enlarged region that is circular in a section orthogonal to the lengthwise direction, the first enlarged region exhibiting a channel breadth exceeding the breadth of the leading segment, the first enlarged region extending in a straight line along the full extent of the leading segment; the incision floor of the trailing segment joins a second enlarged region that is circular in a section orthogonal to the lengthwise direction, the second enlarged region exhibiting a channel breadth exceeding the breadth of the trailing segment, the second enlarged region extending in a straight line along the full extent of the trailing segment; and the first enlarged region is not in fluid communication with the second enlarged region.

A pneumatic vehicle covering, comprising: a ground-engaging region furnished with a set of endless channels running around the circumference of the covering, a series of transverse channels oriented along the covering's axis, and a plurality of first lugs; wherein each of the first lugs is furnished with at least one first incision that undulates in a section taken normal to its longitudinal extent, and undulates in a section taken parallel to the ground-engaging outer face of the first lug; wherein each of the first incisions is furnished with at least one connecting strut that projects radially outward from the incision base and terminates short of the ground-engaging outer face of the first lug, such that the first incision is partially separated along its length by the at least one connecting strut into at least a first segment and a second segment; wherein, in each of the first incisions, the base of the first segment opens into a first enlarged recess having a channel width exceeding the incision width of the first segment, and the base of the second segment opens into a second enlarged recess having a channel width exceeding the incision width of the second segment; wherein the first enlarged recess comprises, in cross section, a radially outer portion defined by a pair of first curved channel walls each bulging toward a midline of the first incision such that the channel width continuously widens from the incision base toward the radially inner side, and a radially inner portion defined by a pair of second curved channel walls each bulging away from the midline of the first incision such that the channel width continuously narrows radially inward to a floor of the first enlarged recess; and wherein the first enlarged recess and the second enlarged recess are not in communication with each other.

A pneumatic tyre having a relief channel, comprising: a carcass, an edge region, a running face having at least one relief channel extending radially inward into the carcass from the running face, and a series of mutually parallel lamellae; wherein the relief channel is positioned proximate the edge region; wherein the relief channel is bounded by an outboard channel wall situated axially away from the equatorial plane and an inboard channel wall situated axially toward the equatorial plane, exhibits a first breadth dimension, and possesses a medial axis; wherein the lamellae extend axially into the inboard channel wall; wherein the relief channel possesses a radially innermost floor bounded by a curved floor face, exhibits a second breadth dimension, and possesses a midpoint; wherein the second breadth dimension exceeds the first breadth dimension; and wherein the medial axis of the relief channel meets the midpoint of the floor.

A pneumatic tyre having a notch-type relief channel, comprising: a carcass portion, a flank region, a ground-contacting face incorporating at least one relief channel extending radially downward into the carcass portion from the ground-contacting face, and a series of mutually aligned slits; wherein the relief channel is situated proximate the flank region; wherein the relief channel is bounded by an outboard channel wall and an inboard channel wall, possesses a breadth D1, and possesses a mid-line; wherein the slits extend axially into the inboard channel wall; wherein the relief channel possesses a radially innermost floor bounded by a curved floor face, possesses a breadth D2, and possesses a focal point; wherein the breadth D2 exceeds the breadth D1; wherein the mid-line of the relief channel meets the focal point of the floor; wherein the tyre possesses an axial direction A, a radial direction R, and a circumferential direction C; wherein the slits are inclined within a plane defined by the circumferential and axial directions; wherein the slits are inclined within a plane defined by the circumferential and radial directions; wherein the slits are inclined by a first slit angle SA1 within the plane defined by the circumferential and axial directions; wherein the slits are inclined by a second slit angle SA2 within the plane defined by the circumferential and radial directions; wherein SA1 lies between 20.0 and 30.0 degrees from the axial direction A; and wherein SA2 lies between 5.0 and 15.0 degrees from the radial direction R.

A pneumatic covering having a peripheral direction, a radial orientation, and an axial orientation, the covering comprising: an outer ground-engaging band including a rib element, the rib element having a plurality of side boundary faces; wherein at least a section of an exterior face of one of the side boundary faces carries a relief formation of depressions and/or elevations; and wherein the depressions and/or elevations alternate with one another along at least two spatial axes of the exterior face.

A wheel for utility vehicles, comprising: a metallic rim body possessing an inboard rim lip and an outboard rim lip, an inboard bead seat and an outboard bead seat, along with a drop well floor positioned between the bead seats; a metallic disc member located within the rim body and joined thereto, the disc member including a mounting collar with a central aperture and a ring of bores distributed along a pitch circle about a spindle axis, a perforated intermediate zone, and a peripheral margin; wherein the mounting collar, the intermediate zone, the outboard rim lip and the outboard bead seat define an exterior face of the wheel; and a securing arrangement for an aerodynamic disc cap, the securing arrangement including a plurality of retention apertures formed in the mounting collar and arranged symmetrically about the spindle axis, at least one retention aperture being a through passage aligned with a passage axis, symmetric about that axis, having a reduced bore on the exterior face relative to a larger bore on an interior side of the mounting collar, and defining a shoulder engaging a removable positive-lock fastener, and/or at least one retention aperture being a through passage threaded internally to receive a tightening bolt serving as a fastener, and/or the central aperture having an inner periphery with a narrowed throat forming a shoulder for a cap-side fastener engaging positively.

A cycle wheel hoop for two-wheeled vehicles, comprising: at least one hoop structure having an exposed face noticeable during ordinary riding; wherein a load-bearing framework of the hoop structure is fabricated from pre-impregnated fiber-reinforced composite plies; wherein the hoop structure includes lateral sidewalls positioned facing each other, a central channel, and a bottom seating portion; the exposed face is defined by a slim, unwoven veil applied over the load-bearing framework, so as to produce during fabrication an aesthetically pleasing, visible finish on the hoop structure; and the unwoven veil on the hoop structure constitutes an outermost ply of a laminate, which includes at least one pre-impregnated ply and the unwoven veil.

A process for producing a cycle wheel rim having at least one rim structure whose load-bearing framework is formed from a fiber-reinforced composite of preimpregnated plies, the rim structure including opposed sidewall portions, a central channel portion, and a bead seat portion, the process comprising: establishing a externally perceivable face on the rim structure that is seen during ordinary riding, by placing a composite stack consisting of a thin fleece-type sheet and at least one preimpregnated ply into a molding tool such that the fleece-type sheet abuts the molding tool, whereby the externally perceivable face is defined by the thin fleece-type sheet and the load-bearing framework is defined by the preimpregnated plies, so as to yield during fabrication an aesthetically pleasing exterior face on the rim structure, and wherein the fleece-type sheet on the rim structure constitutes an outermost layer of a laminate comprising the at least one preimpregnated ply and the fleece-type sheet.

A lug nut assembly comprising: a shank member including an externally threaded section; a torque-engagement face configured to be gripped by a socket driver; a bearing face adapted to mate with a seating surface; and a dome-shaped covering element separate from the shank member and possessing an ebony-toned finish applied over a substrate of the covering element to form a decorative ebony exterior, wherein the covering element is fixed to the shank member at a deformed joint region so as to overlie the torque-engagement face while leaving uncovered the bearing face and the externally threaded section.

A process for producing a lug nut, the process comprising: fabricating a shank element having a head section and an externally threaded section situated opposite the head section; shaping a cover in advance so as to enclose the head section of the shank element; applying a finish to the cover so as to yield an ornamental outer face; and deforming the cover onto the head section of the shank element to affix the cover to the shank element.

A caster mounting arrangement, comprising: a stationary frame; a pivoting frame; a pivot pin; and a stabilizing component, wherein the pivoting frame is pivotally coupled to the stationary frame via the pivot pin, the stabilizing component includes a main piece and a locating element, the stabilizing component extends in alignment with the axial direction of the pivot pin, one end of the main piece is provided with a contact surface, an opposite end of the main piece is provided with a recess, and the locating element is press-fitted and secured within the recess.

A motor vehicle having a drive axle equipped with a mechanism, the mechanism comprising: an inner sleeve; a rolling-element support; and an outer sleeve disposed concentrically about the inner sleeve, wherein the support is interposed between the inner and outer sleeves, and wherein the inner and outer sleeves are capable of angular displacement relative to one another about a common centerline while remaining axially constrained along that centerline.

A vehicle chassis linkage, comprising: a first half-shaft member having a mounting feature at a first extremity for securing a first road wheel; a second half-shaft member having a mounting feature at a first extremity for securing a second road wheel; an inner tubular element secured to a second extremity of the first half-shaft member; a rotational interface; an outer tubular element disposed circumferentially about the inner tubular element and sharing its longitudinal centerline, the rotational interface being interposed radially between the inner and outer tubular elements, the inner and outer tubular elements being free to rotate relative to one another about the centerline while being axially constrained, and the outer tubular element being secured to a second extremity of the second half-shaft member.

An aquaplaning prevention apparatus for a road vehicle, comprising: a reservoir arrangement for holding working fluids; a blending arrangement; a delivery arrangement; and a discharge arrangement having at least a first nozzle and a second nozzle adapted to spray fluid onto the roadway ahead of, respectively, a right-side contact band and a left-side contact band of a right road wheel and a left road wheel mounted on a vehicle axle, wherein said reservoir arrangement includes a primary container adapted to contain a primary working fluid and at least one secondary container adapted to contain a corresponding secondary working fluid, each of said primary container and said at least one secondary container being in fluid communication with said delivery arrangement, said blending arrangement is operable to combine a set quantity of said primary working fluid with a set quantity of said corresponding secondary working fluid, thereby forming a working blend of the apparatus, and said delivery arrangement is operable to convey said working blend to said first nozzle and said second nozzle.

A pneumatic tyre, comprising: a set of two bead cores; a casing ply spanning between the two bead cores; a breaker ply situated radially outward of the casing ply; a tread compound situated radially outward of the breaker ply; a pair of side wall compounds located axially outward of the casing ply; and a rim protector compound running from a radially inner side to an axially outer side of the two bead cores, wherein the casing ply is folded back axially outwardly while encircling the bead cores, and a radial distance GD from a tread contour at a maximum axial width location to an inner liner surface, a radial distance GE from the tread contour at a location lying at 30% of a section height SH to the inner liner surface, and a radial distance GF from the tread contour at a self-contact onset point of the folded-back portion of the casing ply to the inner liner surface fulfil the relations GE≤GF, 1.00≤GE/GD≤1.10 and 1.00≤GF/GD≤1.40.

A airless wheel covering incorporating a polymer material as its load-bearing framework, the polymer material exhibiting a flexural elastic modulus no greater than 247 MPa at −20° C. per ISO 178 and a flexural elastic modulus no less than 32 MPa at 60° C. per ISO 178, and wherein an overall outer dimension of the covering measured along its radial axis is 35 cm or smaller.

A process of fabricating a gauge wheel tire, the process comprising: molding a first elastomeric member incorporating at least a tread region configured to bear upon a terrain surface during rotation about a rotational axis; molding a second elastomeric member incorporating at least a lateral bearing region; and uniting the first elastomeric member with the second elastomeric member into an assembled structure wherein the lateral bearing region is separated from the tread region by a clearance enabling radial displacement of the tread region with respect to the lateral bearing region.

A caster-style measuring roller assembly, comprising: a first urethane flank member; a second urethane flank member positioned apart from the first urethane flank member; a urethane contact segment running from the first urethane flank member to the second urethane flank member and configured to touch a terrain surface as the assembly turns around a spin centerline; and a urethane bearing section running from the first urethane flank member to the second urethane flank member, wherein the urethane bearing section is separated from the urethane contact segment by a clearance enabling radial displacement of the urethane contact segment relative to the urethane bearing section; wherein a first junction exists between the urethane bearing section and the first urethane flank member, and a second junction exists between the urethane bearing section and the second urethane flank member.

A truck tire tread for a heavy-duty vehicle, presenting a lateral axis, a radial depth axis, and a peripheral axis, the tread comprising: a land portion bounded by a first side face and an opposite second side face, the land portion including a crest surface; and a slit formed within the land portion and traversing from the first side face to the second side face, the slit including a main channel and an enlarged drop-shaped void, wherein an end of the drop-shaped void is positioned at the first side face, an opposing end of the drop-shaped void is positioned at the second side face, and an intermediate region of the drop-shaped void is disposed between those ends along the lateral axis, a lateral center point of the drop-shaped void lying within the intermediate region; wherein a transverse section of the drop-shaped void at the lateral center point exceeds in dimension a transverse section of the drop-shaped void at the first end, and the transverse section at the lateral center point exceeds in dimension a transverse section at the second end; wherein the main channel adjoins the drop-shaped void and possesses a uniform breadth extending entirely from the first end to the second end, and the transverse section of the drop-shaped void diminishes steadily from the lateral center point toward the first end.

A wheel hub-and-rim linkage component constructed from a fibre-composite material and configured as a closed, radially symmetric annular frame, the component comprising: at least two radial members extending between an inboard boundary and an outboard boundary of the frame; a continuous filament tow traversing the frame repeatedly between the inboard boundary and the outboard boundary along the radial members; the radial members being arranged in mated pairs bonded together by a resin binder; the arrangement of the radial members within the frame emulating that of a traditional wheel employing metallic wire spokes; wherein the radial members of each pair terminate at the outboard boundary in a first looped section and terminate at the inboard boundary in a second looped section.

A process for producing a cast aluminum rim, the process comprising: formulating a molten charge possessing a specified composition that contains between 8.5 and 10 wt% silicon with the balance aluminum; purifying and conditioning the charge by removing dissolved gases and impurities; introducing into the charge a nucleating agent consisting of aluminum, titanium, vanadium, and boron together with a mother alloy; and solidifying the charge within a mold to form the rim.

A cast light-alloy road vehicle wheel, the wheel including: a central mounting portion; an outer circumferential band; and a set of radial arms linking the central mounting portion to the outer circumferential band, wherein the wheel comprises: silicon (Si) present at 8.5 to 10 wt. %; iron (Fe) present at 0.1 to 0.25 wt. %; and an aluminum fraction in which at least 70 wt. % originates from recycled aluminum stock.

A wheel spoke assembly comprising: a core member formed from a fiber-containing composite that includes a thermoplastic matrix; and at least one sleeve, each sleeve provided with at least one locking indentation, each locking indentation sunk radially into the core member.

A process for producing a thermoplastic-based spoke reinforced with fibers, the process comprising: a sleeve fitting stage: providing a core formed from a composite containing a thermoplastic matrix and filaments and fitting a sleeve over and about the core; a heat-compression stage: applying heat and compressive force to the core and the sleeve jointly so as to reshape both, thereby forming at least one locking indentation that is radially sunk into the core for mating the sleeve with the core; and a trimming stage: machining the core to eliminate burrs created by the heating and shaping on the core.

A detachable panel for a lateral face of a two-wheeler tyre, the panel constituting an arc segment of an annulus spanning between 330 degrees and 380 degrees, the panel having a pair of unattached terminal borders configured such that, when the tyre is fitted onto a carrier to yield a mounted unit and the mounted unit is installed on the two-wheeler, the panel can be affixed to and detached from the lateral face of the tyre without dismounting the mounted unit from the two-wheeler.

A combination comprising: a motorcycle tyre and at least one panel (16; 161, 162, 163, 164) for a lateral face of the tyre, the or each panel being detachably secured to the lateral face, wherein the or each lateral panel includes two unattached terminal borders configured such that, when the tyre is fitted onto a wheel support to form an installed unit and when the installed unit is fitted to the motorcycle, the panel can be attached to and detached from the lateral face of the tyre without taking the installed unit off the motorcycle.

A procedure for installing a trim piece on a lateral wall of a two-wheeler tyre, the trim piece being detachably securable to the lateral wall of the two-wheeler tyre and constituting an arcuate portion of an annulus spanning between 330° and 380°, and the trim piece possessing two unattached terminal borders, the procedure comprising: guiding the trim piece about a telescopic leg, a limb of a rocker arm, or a central boss of an installed arrangement of the two-wheeler, wherein each unattached terminal border is displaced in an axial direction relative to the other so as to permit the trim piece to be guided about the telescopic leg, the limb of the rocker arm, or the central boss of the installed arrangement, and/or each unattached terminal border is spaced apart in a circumferential direction from the other so as to permit the trim piece to be guided about the telescopic leg, the limb of the rocker arm, or the central boss of the installed arrangement; and detachably securing the trim piece to the lateral wall.

query_text: A process for attaching a set of segmental panels onto a lateral face of a two-wheeler tyre, each panel being a circular arc portion whose angular extent equals 360 degrees divided by N, where N is at least two, or equals (360 degrees minus B) divided by N, where N is at least two and B lies between 10 and 330 degrees, the process comprising: threading each panel over a fork leg, a limb of a rear suspension arm, or a wheel boss of an installed arrangement, wherein, when the panel has enough clearance between its two terminal rims to clear the fork leg, the limb, or the boss without displacing one terminal rim relative to the other, the fork leg, limb, or boss is received within that clearance; or wherein, when the panel lacks such clearance, each terminal rim is displaced axially relative to the other to permit the panel to pass over the fork leg, limb, or boss, and/or each terminal rim is spaced apart circumferentially from the other to permit the fork leg, limb, or boss to enter the gap between them; and releasably securing each panel to the lateral face.

query_text: A locomotion apparatus comprising: an enclosure pivotally mounted about a steering joint; a drum assembly journaled within the enclosure; a first actuator member and a second actuator member both carried by the steering joint; a first transmission train meshed with the first actuator member to convey torque from the first actuator member to the enclosure or the drum assembly; a second transmission train meshed with the second actuator member and the first transmission train to convey torque from the second actuator member to the enclosure or the drum assembly; and a control circuit configured to regulate rotation of the first actuator member and the second actuator member in an independent manner so as to selectively turn the enclosure or the drum assembly, whereby a vehicle is propelled along a predetermined heading.

A wheel for a motor vehicle, the wheel having: a circumferential flange portion on which a tyre is seated; a central boss section positioned radially inward of the flange portion, secured to a spindle and joined to a brake disc of a disc-type braking system; and a lateral bridging segment linking an outboard region of the flange portion to the boss section; wherein, when viewed along the rotational axis, a series of apertures passing axially through the wheel is arranged at intervals about the circumference between the flange portion and the boss section, and a succession of ribs projects from an inner circumferential face of the flange portion, arranged end to end around the circumference, each rib extending obliquely from an outboard side toward an inboard side in the axial direction while progressing in a single circumferential direction along the flange portion.

A wheel hub-engaging edge assembly comprising: a pair of sidewalls extending circumferentially; a central band positioned between the sidewalls; an outer band encircling the central band and having a pair of side sections joined respectively to the sidewalls; and a pair of projecting lips, each projecting radially outward from a respective one of the sidewalls such that a recess angle is defined between it and a respective one of the side sections of the outer band, wherein each of the projecting lips has an inwardly facing surface provided with a gripping element.

A wheel element for a ground-engaging vehicle, comprising: a first hub section; and a second hub section coupled to the first hub section, wherein the first hub section includes at least one segment that diverges outwardly from the second hub section, wherein the second hub section includes at least one segment that diverges outwardly from the first hub section, wherein an enclosed void is defined between the segment of the first hub section and the segment of the second hub section, and wherein the first hub section or the second hub section includes a lip unitary with the respective first hub section or second hub section and that projects from an outer peripheral margin of the first hub section or the second hub section to carry a resilient cushion.

A wheel arrangement for a track-type machine, comprising: a resilient cushion bonded to a wheel body; and a wheel body including a first half-shell; and a second half-shell coupled to the first half-shell; wherein the resilient cushion is affixed to the wheel body, wherein the first half-shell has at least one section tilted outward from the second half-shell, wherein the second half-shell has at least one section tilted outward from the first half-shell, wherein an enclosed void is defined between the section of the first half-shell and the section of the second half-shell, and wherein the first half-shell or the second half-shell includes a rim projection unitary with the respective half-shell and extending from an outer radial margin of the first half-shell or the second half-shell to carry the resilient cushion.

A process for producing a track-laying vehicle roadwheel, the process comprising: shaping a first wheel segment by die forging; shaping a second wheel segment by die forging; and joining the first wheel segment to the second wheel segment by fusion bonding, such that an enclosed void is delimited between the first wheel segment and the second wheel segment.

A rear cycle wheel hub assembly, comprising: a tubular housing enclosing a spindle, the housing presenting a far end provided with a terminating shoulder and a near end to which a ratchet-carrier sleeve is secured through a coupling arrangement; wherein the sleeve encloses a one-way drive cluster and includes a near-end abutment that seals and retains the hub; the coupling arrangement comprises a linking collar engaged with an interior wall of the housing and in mesh with a race of the one-way drive cluster, together with a resilient annulus seated in a peripheral channel formed on an outer face of the linking collar, the resilient annulus being radially expandable toward the interior wall so as to lock the linking collar within the housing.

A wheel-support arrangement comprising: two wheel-carried extendable rails bearing respective castors; a drive mechanism operable to shift the rails from a collapsed state to a spread state, the castors drawing nearer in the collapsed state and separating further in the spread state; and wherein the rails are contoured to envelop the drive mechanism across its upper surface and lateral faces while leaving its underside open for access.

A wheel-engaging conveyance device comprising: a duo of wheel-carried extended support bars; a twosome of castors pivotally attached to corresponding ones of said bars; and a couple of guideways through which the bars are slidably interconnected in a telescoping manner, each of the guideways having a U-shaped cross-section when viewed laterally.

An automotive wheel support device comprising: a pair of angle-shaped brackets fabricated from stamped metal plate that slidably nest within one another in an extendable manner; and wheels journaled to the angle-shaped brackets.

A hubcap ornament for an automotive rim, consisting of: a rotatable disc; a central opening formed through a middle region of the disc; a mounting plate; a journal housing; a rolling element; an axle pin; a retaining collar; the mounting plate including an underside face, a topside face, a set of resilient tabs, and a central passage; the central passage being positioned at the middle of the mounting plate; the journal housing including an exterior face, an interior face, a recess, and a central through-hole; the central through-hole being positioned at the middle of the journal housing; the rolling element being seated within the recess; the journal housing being coaxially joined to the mounting plate; the axle pin being threaded through the central opening of the disc, through the central passage, through the rolling element, and through the central through-hole; the axle pin fixing the disc to the rolling element by way of the retaining collar; the mounting plate being coaxially secured to a hub bore of the rim by the resilient tabs gripping the hub bore; and the disc turns freely apart from the rim.

A hubcap assembly for a vehicle road wheel, comprising: a rotatable ornament; a central opening formed through a middle region of the ornament; a mounting plate; a journal housing; a rolling element; a shaft; a fastening collar; the mounting plate including a plate face, a plate reverse face, a series of resilient retainers, and a plate orifice; the mounting plate having a circular profile; the series of resilient retainers being spaced around an outer edge of the plate reverse face; each resilient retainer extending at a right angle from the plate reverse face; the plate orifice being located at a center of the mounting plate; the journal housing including a housing exterior, a housing interior, a recess, and a housing aperture; the journal housing having a cylindrical form; the recess being a cylindrical pocket extending axially inward from the housing exterior; the housing aperture being positioned at a center of the journal housing; the rolling element being seated within the recess; the journal housing being coaxially joined to the mounting plate; the shaft passing through the central opening of the ornament, through the plate orifice, through the rolling element, and through the housing aperture; the shaft fixing the ornament to the rolling element by way of the fastening collar; the mounting plate being coaxially secured within a hub bore of the road wheel by the resilient retainers engaging the hub bore; and the ornament rotates freely and independently of the road wheel.

A hubcap assembly for a vehicle tire, comprising: a rotatable ornament; a central opening formed through a middle region of the ornament; a mounting plate; a journal housing; a rolling element; a shaft; a retaining fastener; a washer; the mounting plate including an exterior face, an interior face, a set of resilient latches, a central passage, and a flange; the mounting plate having a circular profile; the set of resilient latches being spaced around an outer edge of the interior face; each of the resilient latches oriented at a right angle relative to the interior face; the central passage being located at the center of the mounting plate; the flange being coaxially formed on the interior face and projecting outwardly; the journal housing slidingly received by the flange; the journal housing including an outer wall, an inner wall, a recess, and a bore; the journal housing having a cylindrical form; the recess being a cylindrical hollow; the recess extending axially inward from the outer wall; the bore being centered within the journal housing; the rolling element seated within the recess; the journal housing coaxially joined to the mounting plate; the washer being cylindrical; the washer interposed between the ornament and the rolling element; the shaft passing through the central opening, the washer, the central passage, the rolling element, and the bore; the shaft fixing the ornament to the rolling element by way of the retaining fastener; the mounting plate being coaxially secured to a hub bore of the tire by the resilient latches gripping the hub bore; and the ornament rotating freely and independently of the tire.

An axle-free rolling apparatus comprising: a powered revolving member arranged to turn around a drive spin axis extending along a first orientation; and a shifting revolving member arranged to turn around a floating spin axis whose position relative to the drive spin axis is adjustable, the shifting revolving member being displaceable with respect to the powered revolving member along a heading oblique to the first orientation, wherein the floating spin axis is caused to change its position relative to the drive spin axis as the shifting revolving member is displaced with respect to the powered revolving member.

A drivetrain hub for vehicles propelled at least partly by human muscle, the hub comprising: a central spindle; an exterior casing; a drive member; and a one-way clutch assembly; wherein the casing is carried for turning on at least two axially separated bearings, specifically at least one bearing positioned nearer the drive member and at least one further outboard bearing positioned farther from the drive member; wherein the drive member is carried for turning on at least two axially separated bearings, specifically one bearing positioned nearer the casing and at least one further outboard bearing positioned farther from the casing; wherein the one-way clutch assembly includes a casing-side toothed disc coupled to the casing and a drive-side toothed disc cooperating therewith and coupled to the drive member, each having a face toothing for mutual engagement and urged into an engaged state (E) by at least one urging element; wherein the face toothing of the casing-side toothed disc is oriented axially toward the drive member; wherein the drive-side toothed disc is received radially within the drive member and is non-rotatably joined to the drive member through an outer radial toothing mating with an inner radial toothing of the drive member for the driving direction, and wherein the face toothing of the drive-side toothed disc is oriented axially toward the casing; and wherein the clear bore of the drive-side toothed disc exceeds the outside diameter of the casing-side drive bearing, the urging element comprising at least one helical spring formed of a wound wire extending about a spring axis, with its terminal ends located within diagonally opposed sectors.

A roller unit for a mono or twin castor intended for seating, hospital cots, or clinical apparatus, the roller unit comprising: a hub flange; an elastomeric ring; and an axle assembly positioned at the middle of the hub flange, wherein a tread face of the elastomeric ring encircles the hub flange, and wherein the tread face of the elastomeric ring incorporates a multiplicity of integrally joined radial struts that are either abutting or affixed to the axle assembly.

A process for manufacturing a roller element of a single or twin castor intended for furniture, hospital beds or the like, the roller element having a elastomeric ring, a hub portion and a bearing assembly, wherein the elastomeric ring is molded in a first molding stage and the hub portion is molded in a second molding stage, the process comprising: placing the bearing assembly within a mold impression of a first polymer injection die to carry out the first molding stage; carrying out the first molding stage by forming the elastomeric ring with a rolling face and a plurality of radial struts that engage the bearing assembly; allowing the elastomeric ring formed in the first molding stage to solidify; removing the elastomeric ring from the first polymer injection die by means of a conveyor configured to match the contour of the elastomeric ring; conveying the elastomeric ring into a mold impression of a second polymer injection die to carry out the second molding stage; carrying out the second molding stage by forming the hub portion; and solidifying the roller element and withdrawing the roller element from the second polymer injection die.

A mold assembly for forming a tread component of a castor unit intended for seating frames, patient beds, or clinical apparatus, the mold assembly comprising: a primary void shaped to define a contact face of the tread; and supplementary recesses formed within the primary void that are arranged to shape a set of radial ribs.

An apparatus comprising: a set of caster modules, each caster module of the set respectively including: an enclosure having (i) one or more peripheral panels bounding an inner cavity of the enclosure and (ii) a lip projecting from at least one panel of the one or more peripheral panels to define an aperture of the enclosure; a caster carriage including a carriage body and at least one wheel element, the caster carriage being disposed at least partially within the inner cavity of the enclosure and displaceable between (i) a stowed state in which the at least one wheel element lies wholly within the inner cavity of the enclosure and (ii) a deployed state in which the at least one wheel element protrudes outside the inner cavity of the enclosure through the aperture, wherein the carriage body is too large to pass through the aperture, thereby limiting the caster carriage from moving beyond the deployed state; and a Bowden-type traction line coupled to the caster carriage; and at least one drive mechanism coupled to the traction lines, the at least one drive mechanism being operable to (i) when engaged, impart a compressive thrust to the traction lines, thereby driving the caster carriages from the stowed state to the deployed state and (ii) when disengaged, withdraw the imparted compressive thrust from the traction lines, thereby driving the caster carriages from the deployed state to the stowed state.

A castor unit for mounting beneath an article of seating or storage, the unit comprising: a casing having (i) one or more lateral panels bounding an inner cavity of the casing and (ii) a projecting lip extending from at least one lateral panel of the one or more lateral panels so as to define an aperture of the casing; a wheel carrier comprising a mounting body and at least one roller, the wheel carrier being disposed at least partly within the inner cavity and displaceable between (i) a stowed configuration in which the at least one roller lies wholly within the inner cavity and (ii) a deployed configuration in which the at least one roller protrudes beyond the inner cavity through the aperture, wherein the mounting body is too large to traverse the aperture, thereby limiting displacement of the wheel carrier beyond the deployed configuration; and a Bowden-type traction cable coupled to the wheel carrier and adapted to be connected to at least one drive member for moving the wheel carrier between the stowed configuration and the deployed configuration.

A piece of seating or storage furniture comprising: a set of supports, each supporting element having a lower face designed to contact a floor or ground; a set of wheel-bearing modules, each wheel-bearing module of the set respectively including: an enclosure having (i) one or more perimeter panels bounding an inner cavity of the enclosure and (ii) a lip projecting from at least one perimeter panel of the one or more perimeter panels so as to form an aperture of the enclosure; a castor carrier comprising a mounting body and at least one rotatable wheel, the castor carrier being disposed at least partly within the inner cavity and displaceable between (i) a stowed state in which the at least one rotatable wheel lies wholly within the inner cavity and (ii) a deployed state in which the at least one rotatable wheel protrudes beyond the inner cavity through the aperture, wherein the mounting body is too large to pass through the aperture, thereby limiting travel of the castor carrier past the deployed state; and a traction cord coupled to the castor carrier; and at least one drive mechanism coupled to the traction cords, the at least one drive mechanism being constructed to (i) upon activation, exert a thrust on the traction cords, thereby moving the castor carriers from the stowed state into the deployed state and (ii) upon deactivation, withdraw the thrust from the traction cords, thereby moving the castor carriers from the deployed state into the stowed state.

A reinforcing filament assembly for a belt layer of a motor vehicle tire, the assembly comprising: a strand produced by helically twisting n filaments at a regular pitch, the filaments being flattened by calendering and at least one filament being deformed into a non-round profile; when n is odd, a transverse section of a single filament among the n filaments remains round following the calendering, while transverse sections of the remaining n−1 filaments are non-round; and when n is even, transverse sections of two filaments among the n filaments remain round following the calendering, while transverse sections of the remaining n−2 filaments are non-round as a result of the calendering.

A noise-attenuating pneumatic covering for a vehicle wheel, the covering including: a fibrous ply framework; a circumferential rubber strip situated outwardly of the framework in the radial direction; an impermeable elastomer lining layer that has been cured, positioned inwardly of the framework in the radial direction; and a sound-dampening member formed from expanded elastomer positioned radially inward of the impermeable lining layer and extending axially across at least a portion of the circumferential strip; wherein the expanded elastomer, prior to curing, comprises a curable and foamable rubber mixture containing, before blending, a rubber formulation comprising: (i) 100 phr of at least one natural or manufactured elastomer; (ii) between 10 phr and 80 phr of at least one reinforcing particulate; (iii) less than 3 phr of at least one curing agent; (iv) between 5 phr and 30 phr of at least one blowing agent; (v) between 5 phr and 40 phr of at least one substance selected from fatty acid amides; and (vi) between 1 phr and 20 phr of at least one substance selected from polymers and copolymers of caprolactone, lactic acid, glycolic acid, and blends thereof.

A curable and expansible rubber mixture comprising, prior to blending, a rubber formulation containing: (i) 100 parts per hundred rubber of at least one natural or man-made elastomer; (ii) between 10 and 80 parts per hundred rubber of at least one strengthening filler; (iii) less than 3 parts per hundred rubber of at least one curing agent; (iv) between 5 and 30 parts per hundred rubber of at least one blowing agent; (v) between 5 and 40 parts per hundred rubber of at least one compound selected from fatty acid amides; and (vi) between 1 and 20 parts per hundred rubber of at least one compound selected from polymers and copolymers of caprolactone, lactic acid, glycolic acid, and blends thereof.

A tire-monitoring arrangement responsive to a vehicle door, comprising: a host assembly having a controller coupled to a primary radio-frequency transceiver, a primary screen, and a door-state detector, the host assembly lacking any low-frequency signal path and any low-frequency radiating element; and a plurality of wheel-mounted pressure monitors, each having a monitor controller coupled to a secondary radio-frequency transceiver that pairs with the primary radio-frequency transceiver over radio-frequency wireless signals, each wheel-mounted pressure monitor lacking any low-frequency signal path and any low-frequency radiating element; wherein, upon the door-state detector sensing that a vehicle door has been opened, the primary screen presents pressure readings reported by each of the wheel-mounted pressure monitors.

A method of rousing a tire-pressure monitoring arrangement triggered by opening a vehicle door, the method comprising: sensing, by a door detector of a central board, that a vehicle door has been opened; directing, by a processor of the central board, a primary radio-frequency transceiver to send high-frequency wireless signals that activate each paired tire sensor; upon activation of each tire sensor, processing, by a sensor controller of that tire sensor, measured data and sending high-frequency wireless replies to the primary radio-frequency transceiver through a sensor radio-frequency transceiver; and receiving, by the central board, the replies from each tire sensor and presenting the measured data on a primary screen.

A computer-implemented procedure comprising: obtaining, by a controller aboard an automobile, a initial reading from a rotation detector mounted on a tire of the automobile; identifying, by the controller, from analysis of the initial reading, a tire-replacement activity underway on the tire; activating, by the controller, responsive to identifying the tire-replacement activity, a registration phase encompassing a radio linking of a pressure transducer located within the tire to a tire inflation supervision arrangement of the automobile; and deactivating, by the controller, the registration phase once a first duration has elapsed following activation of the registration phase.

A computer-implemented procedure comprising: obtaining, by a controller aboard an automobile, a reading from a rotation-detecting transducer mounted on a road wheel of the automobile; ascertaining, by the controller, through analysis of the reading, either an initial condition linked to a first displacement of the road wheel caused by travel of the automobile or a subsequent condition linked to a second displacement of the road wheel caused by a tire-swapping task; and activating, by the controller, upon ascertaining the subsequent condition, a commissioning phase that includes establishing a wireless association between a tire-pressure transducer housed within the road wheel and a tire-pressure supervision unit of the automobile.

An automotive apparatus comprising: a tire-monitoring unit having a detection assembly; a non-transitory storage medium holding instructions executable by a controller; and a controller coupled to the storage medium and configured to carry out acts including: obtaining a initial reading from the detection assembly; identifying, from analysis of the initial reading, that a tire replacement procedure is underway on a road wheel of the automotive apparatus; ascertaining that a registration routine supported by the tire-monitoring unit is currently inactive; activating, in response to identifying the tire replacement procedure, the registration routine, the registration routine including establishing a wireless link between the tire-monitoring unit and a pressure transducer mounted within the road wheel; and deactivating the registration routine once a first interval has elapsed following activation of the registration routine.

An apparatus for holding a location-determining transmitter, the apparatus being securable to a tire pressure fitting and comprising: a cavity formed within the apparatus and dimensioned to receive a satellite-positioning transmitter; and a coupling element for affixing the apparatus to the pressure fitting.

A tracking module enclosure assembly comprising: a casing configured to be secured to a tyre valve stem; a locating cavity formed within the casing and dimensioned to receive a positioning transmitter; a mounting bracket for coupling the casing to the valve stem; and at least one sealing collar sized to encircle the valve stem; wherein the assembly further includes at least one of: a satellite positioning unit, a wheel hub, and a pneumatic tire.

A valve assembly for a tyre, comprising: a tracking unit mount that defines a cavity dimensioned to hold a satellite positioning transmitter, and an inflation port structure to which the mount is secured.

A location-monitoring module enclosure system comprising: (a) a tire pressure port component, and one or more of: (b) a satellite positioning transmitter, (c) at least one sealing collar dimensioned to encircle the tire pressure port component, (d) a wheel hub flange, and (e) a pneumatic tire.

A locating device support adapted to be affixed to a wheel rim face that, during operation, looks toward a pneumatic tire mounted on the rim; the device support being configured for holding a satellite positioning transmitter.
