query_text: A pneumatic tire for a motor vehicle, comprising: a set of paired filament bundles incorporated into a composite layer; each bundle formed by two strands joined by twisting at their terminal regions; a first strand exhibiting a Z parameter of at least 600 mN/tex; a second strand exhibiting a Z parameter of no more than 75 mN/tex and a Y parameter of no more than 150 mN/tex; wherein Z denotes the load per unit linear density at which a 1% elongation occurs on the load-extension curve, Y denotes the load per unit linear density at which a 4% elongation occurs on the load-extension curve; and wherein the ratio X of the linear density of the first strand to the linear density of the second strand lies between 1.0 and 1.3.

A twin-strand reinforcing filament for employment as a load-bearing element within a breaker band of a pneumatic automotive tyre, the filament comprising: a pair of filamentary bundles, namely a first bundle and a second bundle, joined in a twisted arrangement at their terminal extremities; the first bundle being a stiff-type bundle presenting a Z parameter of 600 mN/tex or greater; the second bundle being a compliant-type bundle presenting a Z parameter of 75 mN/tex or less and a Y parameter of 150 mN/tex or less; the first bundle and the second bundle having linear densities matched to their respective load-extension responses; wherein Z denotes the load, normalized to linear density, at which a 1% extension appears on the load-extension plot; wherein Y denotes the load, normalized to linear density, at which a 4% extension appears on the load-extension plot; wherein the ratio X of the linear density of the first bundle to that of the second bundle lies between 1.13 and 1.17; the first bundle presenting a Z parameter of 700 mN/tex or greater; the first bundle being formed from a substance chosen from the group consisting of poly(p-phenyleneterephthalamide) and polyoxazoles, particularly poly(p-phenylene-2,6-benzobisoxazole); the first bundle having a linear density within 1500 to 2000 dtex; and the second bundle having a linear density within 1300 to 1700 dtex.

A tyre assembly, comprising: a carcass structure delimiting a lateral face and a medial face opposite the lateral face, the carcass structure presenting a lateral flank region situated toward the lateral face and a medial flank region situated toward the medial face, the carcass structure extending along a peripheral orientation and a transverse orientation normal to the peripheral orientation; a plurality of initial recesses formed in the lateral flank region; a plurality of subsequent recesses positioned adjacent to the initial recesses and formed in the lateral flank region; and a plurality of terminal recesses formed in the medial flank region; the initial recesses each including a proximal terminus near the medial face, a first indentation near the medial face extending into an interior of the respective initial recess, a leading extremity on a border of the first indentation nearer the lateral face and remote from the interior of the respective initial recess, and a first apex on the border of the first indentation nearer the lateral face and nearer the interior of the respective initial recess, each initial recess tapering progressively from the leading extremity toward the lateral face; the subsequent recesses each including a second proximal terminus near the medial face, a second indentation near the lateral face extending into an interior of the respective subsequent recess, a second leading extremity on a border of the second indentation nearer the medial face and remote from the interior of the respective subsequent recess, and a second apex on the border of the second indentation nearer the medial face and nearer the interior of the respective subsequent recess, each subsequent recess tapering progressively from the second leading extremity toward the medial face; the terminal recesses each including a distal terminus near the lateral face, a third indentation near the medial face extending into an interior of the respective terminal recess, a trailing extremity on a border of the third indentation nearer the lateral face and remote from the interior of the respective terminal recess, and a third apex on the border of the third indentation nearer the lateral face and nearer the interior of the respective terminal recess, each terminal recess tapering progressively from the trailing extremity toward the lateral face; wherein, along the transverse orientation, the first apex lies lateral of the leading extremity, the second apex lies medial of the second leading extremity, and the third apex lies lateral of the trailing extremity.

A pneumatic tyre having a ground-contacting section, wherein the ground-contacting section comprises a series of peripheral channels running uninterrupted in the tyre circumferential sense between a first lateral margin and a second lateral margin, and a set of blocks delimited by the peripheral channels, the set of blocks including an outboard edge block that incorporates the first lateral margin and an inboard intermediate block abutting the outboard edge block, the outboard edge block being furnished with a plurality of outboard slits extending in the tyre axial sense, the inboard intermediate block being furnished with a plurality of inboard slits extending in the tyre axial sense, each of the outboard slit and the inboard slit comprising a core segment oriented along the tyre radial direction and an enlarged segment which emerges at the tread face of the respective block and possesses a breadth exceeding that of the core segment, and a mouth breadth of the outboard slit at the tread face exceeding a mouth breadth of the inboard slit at the tread face.

A device for predicting tread degradation of a tyre, the device including: a storage component holding a predictive model trained to relate a driving behaviour profile to tread degradation of the tyre; and a processing component configured to forecast the tread degradation of the tyre matching a driving behaviour profile of an operator using the predictive model.

A technique for gauging the degradation extent of a tread component, the technique comprising: retaining within a storage device a predictive construct that acquires a relationship between a manner of vehicle operation and the degradation extent of the tread component; and deducing, by a processing circuit, the degradation extent of the tread component associated with the manner of vehicle operation of an operator based on the predictive construct.

A pneumatic vehicle wheel covering comprising: a body possessing a section height falling within the range of 50 mm to 150 mm, wherein, when the covering is seated upon a prescribed wheel rim and pressurized to a prescribed inner pressure without any applied load, a clearance measured along a normal extending from a foremost extremity of a rim flange, in the radial direction, toward an external surface of the covering is designated as A, the clearance A relative to the section height satisfies the expression 0.01≤A/SH≤0.16; and a protrusion magnitude equal to half of the disparity between an overall covering breadth and a rim breadth of the prescribed rim is designated as W, the clearance A relative to the protrusion magnitude satisfying the expression 0.03≤A/W≤1.60.

A tyre comprising: a couple of bead sections, each furnished with a bead core; and a reinforcement insert formed from an elastomeric compound and disposed alongside the bead core of one or both of the bead sections, wherein, in the one or both of the bead sections, the reinforcement insert includes: a first segment oriented radially on the axially inward side of the bead core; a second segment oriented radially on the axially outward side of the bead core; and a connecting segment oriented axially on the radially inward side of the bead core so as to join the first segment and the second segment, wherein an upper extremity of the second segment in the radial direction lies radially beneath an upper extremity of the first segment in the radial direction and lies radially above a midpoint, measured radially, of a cross-sectional height of the bead core of the one or both of the bead sections.

A traction element, comprising: a rotational shaft; a peripheral shell defining a plurality of openings and a plurality of elastic inserts, wherein each opening houses a corresponding elastic insert, wherein a section of the peripheral shell lies proximate to a face of an installation; a support arm joining the peripheral shell to the rotational shaft; a section of a flexible membrane positioned against the section of the peripheral shell; and a membrane actuator configured to displace the section of the flexible membrane along a direction extending outward from the rotational shaft, wherein a first opening of the plurality of openings and a corresponding first elastic insert of the plurality of elastic inserts are positioned against the face of the installation, and wherein the displaced section of the flexible membrane shifts a segment of the first elastic insert outward from the rotational shaft, thereby regulating the attachment of the section of the peripheral shell to the face of the installation.

A traction element, comprising: a rotatable hub; a tread surface presenting a plurality of recesses, a plurality of actuating members, a plurality of openings, and a plurality of elastic fillers, wherein each actuating member passes through a corresponding recess, wherein each opening houses a corresponding elastic filler, and wherein a section of the tread surface lies proximate to a face of a fixture; an interior liner; a mount joining the tread surface and the interior liner to the rotatable hub; a plurality of resilient members attached to the interior liner, wherein each resilient member extends along a direction perpendicular to the rotatable hub; and a plurality of rods each attached to a respective resilient member and each attached to an elastic filler, wherein a first opening of the plurality of openings and a respective first elastic filler of the plurality of elastic fillers are positioned against the face of the fixture, and wherein turning of the tread surface places a first actuating member adjacent the face of the fixture, to govern the first actuating member entering or exiting a first corresponding recess, to displace a respective first rod along a direction perpendicular to the rotatable hub, and to displace a section of the first elastic filler along the direction perpendicular to the rotatable hub, thereby regulating the grip of the section of the tread surface against the face of the fixture.

A technique for surface gripping, comprising: furnishing a rolling member having a shaft and an exterior perimeter surface bearing a set of openings and a set of elastically extensible elements, each opening housing a corresponding elastically extensible element; turning the rolling member so as to bring a first elastically extensible element proximate a face of an object; and displacing a segment of the first elastically extensible element along a direction perpendicular to the shaft, thereby modulating attachment of a section of the exterior perimeter surface to the face of the object.

A rotatable omniwheel assembly, comprising: a hub body defining a central drive aperture rotatable about a central spindle axis; a set of transverse roller modules, each module including: a pre-assembled insert having a shaft member and a sleeve member defining an internal through-passage that receives the shaft member; and a periphery roller member molded directly onto the insert; and an outer annular track arranged around the assembly at a radial offset from the spindle axis, the hub body being molded together with the set of transverse roller modules such that the molded modules together constitute the outer annular track.

A process for constructing a roller-equipped wheel, the process comprising: furnishing a set of preassembled roller modules incorporating a group of mirror-profile shafts and a group of sleeve inserts, each sleeve insert arranged to accept a single mirror-profile shaft within a central through-channel; forming, for each preassembled roller module, a composite roller unit by encapsulating the sleeve insert with a circumferential roller body; when the composite roller units exist: positioning each composite roller unit within a forming cavity shaped to yield an outer rim ring that is encircling the wheel and offset outwardly from a central rotation axis, and molding a hub body about at least part of the composite roller units within the cavity so as to produce the outer rim ring, the hub body defining a central drive bore allowing rotation about the central rotation axis; and when the composite roller units have not been formed: positioning each preassembled roller module within the forming cavity, the forming cavity shaped to yield a preliminary outer rim ring encircling the wheel and offset outwardly from the central rotation axis, and molding the hub body about the mirror-profile shafts of the preassembled roller modules within the cavity to produce the preliminary outer rim ring, the hub body defining the central drive bore rotatable about the central rotation axis.

A environmentally responsible pneumatic tire assembled from component parts comprising at least one of each of a tread strip, ply coating, bead wire coating, lateral wall, chafer strip, toe protector, gum strip base, apex filler, cap ply overlay, and bead encapsulation; wherein each component part is fabricated from a diene elastomer formulation incorporating a mass-balance synthetic polymer; wherein the diene elastomer constitutes more than 35 wt% of the tire; wherein the tire is composed of more than approximately 85 wt% material derived from processes or technologies curbing carbon output and/or resource usage, together with recovered, regenerable, biologically sourced, biologically derived, and mass-balance feedstocks; and wherein the biologically sourced fraction of the tire is substantiated by carbon-14 radiocarbon dating per ASTM D6866 demonstrating a biological carbon content exceeding 85%.

A tyre assembly comprising: a load-bearing casing having an exterior annular tread band configured to engage a road surface; a pair of axially separated bead cores; at least one reinforcing layer extending between the bead cores; and lateral walls extending radially from the tread band to the bead cores; wherein the tread band is designed for road contact, the tyre incorporates bio-derived organic constituents whose biogenic proportion can be authenticated, and radiocarbon isotope analysis under ASTM D6866 demonstrates that the biogenic fraction of the organic constituents is at least 40%.

A pneumatic vehicle covering incorporating a ground-contacting portion, wherein the ground-contacting portion is formed from a vulcanizable elastomeric mixture comprising: between 80 and 100 parts per hundred rubber of one or more solution-prepared styrene-butadiene elastomers; between 80 and 200 parts per hundred rubber of reinforcing material including at least 40 parts per hundred rubber of carbon black; between 10 and 100 parts per hundred rubber of one or more low-molecular-weight diene-derived fluid polymers; and between 10 and 80 parts per hundred rubber of a terpene-derived resinous tackifier.

A tireless rolling assembly, comprising: a first peripheral ring; and a second peripheral ring spaced apart in an axial direction from the first peripheral ring, the second peripheral ring coupled to the first peripheral ring by a series of angularly distributed struts, the second peripheral ring having a radially directed inward surface defining a multiplicity of attachment holes.

A tireless rolling assembly, comprising: a first peripheral rim ring; a second peripheral rim ring positioned axially apart from the first peripheral rim ring, the second peripheral rim ring linked to the first peripheral rim ring by a series of circumferentially distributed struts, the second peripheral rim ring having a radially inward-facing flange provided with a set of fastener openings; and an airless tread band secured over the first peripheral rim ring and the second peripheral rim ring.

A tireless rolling assembly, comprising: a first peripheral rim; a second peripheral rim positioned axially apart from the first peripheral rim, the second peripheral rim coupled to the first peripheral rim through a series of circumferentially distributed struts, the second peripheral rim having a radially inward flange provided with a set of fastener openings; an airless tread band fitted onto the first peripheral rim and the second peripheral rim; and a drive motor coupled to the second peripheral rim.

A non-pneumatic wheel, comprising: a strut including an initial member running from an outer annular band to a central mount, wherein the strut additionally includes a secondary member extending from the outer annular band to the initial member.

An airless wheel structure, comprising: a set of web members disposed between an outer annular ring and a central mounting boss, wherein each web member exhibits a forked configuration formed of: an upper section having a pair of branches lying in a common meridional plane and running radially outward, and a lower section having a stem inclined relative to the pair of branches; and wherein an initial web member and a subsequent web member of the set are aligned identically in a tangential sense around the wheel structure.

A tire without inflation, comprising: a first group of struts extending between an outer annular band and a central mounting boss, wherein each strut of the first group includes three arms arranged in a forked configuration; and a second group of struts extending between the outer annular band and the central mounting boss, wherein each strut of the second group likewise includes three arms arranged in the forked configuration, wherein the second group is situated next to the first group along an axial dimension perpendicular to a radial dimension of the tire.

A locomotion element adapted to traverse alongside a dielectric or polymeric face of a building component, comprising: a contact face positioned proximate the face as the locomotion element advances; and a set of grip members affixed to the contact face and projecting at least perpendicularly outward from the contact face, wherein each grip member, when brought near the face, attaches to the face, wherein the set of grip members includes a first grip member and a second grip member distinct from the first grip member, and wherein the first and second grip members are chosen from the set consisting of: a van der Waals-type grip member, a micro-spine-type grip member, and a vacuum-cup-type grip member.

A rolling member adapted to traverse along a non-conductive face of a building component, comprising: a peripheral rim surface positioned proximate to the non-conductive face as the rolling member advances across it; and a set of gripping elements each secured to the peripheral rim surface and projecting at least perpendicular to the peripheral rim surface, wherein each gripping element, upon coming near the non-conductive face, is arranged to attach to the non-conductive face, wherein the set of gripping elements comprises an intermolecular-force grip element, a microscopic barb-type grip element, and a vacuum-cup-type grip element.

A crawler drive system designed to travel alongside a non-conductive panel of a building element, comprising: a set of rollers; a series of endless belts guided about the set of rollers, each endless belt possessing a flat exterior face positioned next to the non-conductive panel during travel; and a multitude of attachment elements each affixed to the flat exterior face and projecting at least perpendicularly outward from the flat exterior face, wherein each attachment element, upon coming near the non-conductive panel, is arranged to grip the non-conductive panel, and wherein the multitude of attachment elements comprise a van der Waals-style grip element, a micro-spine-style grip element, and a vacuum-cup-style grip element.

A procedure for supervising the degradation of an automobile wheel covering, carried out by a tyre-state surveillance unit installed inside said covering under observation, said unit including a pneumatic transducer and a radially oriented acceleration detector, the procedure comprising: obtaining rate-of-change readings of acceleration from the covering under observation; conducting analysis of the obtained rate-of-change readings; contrasting the analysed readings against a fixed limit; and emitting an alert once the fixed limit is attained.

A technique for assessing deterioration of a road vehicle's tread, carried out by a tire-condition sensing unit fitted inside the wheel being assessed, the unit including an air-pressure transducer and a circumferential-direction accelerometer, the technique comprising: obtaining, from a circumferential acceleration output of the sensing unit, readings of at least one parameter (V) selected from the set consisting of a highest circumferential acceleration excursion (Z max ) and a lowest circumferential acceleration excursion (Z min ); conditioning the obtained readings of the at least one parameter (V); contrasting the conditioned readings with a preset upper deviation limit value (V seuil ); and issuing an alert upon the preset upper deviation limit value (V seuil ) being attained.

A tyre having a motif region disposed on a lateral wall for presenting a design of a defined configuration, the motif region being constituted by a sequence of adjacent hexagonal repeating elements, and the repeating elements situated along a perimeter of the motif region being trimmed to conform to the outline of the motif region.

A steerable castor device for a ride-on floor care machine having a primary propulsion module and a secondary propulsion module, the steerable castor device comprising, a castor carriage delimiting a pivot axis and a rotation axis; a castor roller coupled to the castor carriage such that the castor roller is configured to be turned about the pivot axis; a first steering actuator configured to selectively impart a controlled rotational force to the castor roller about the pivot axis according to a first relation; and wherein the first relation establishes the magnitude of the rotational force to be produced as a first function of one or more sensed quantities taken at a drive input, a drive output, an attached working tool, or elapsed time.

A motorized servicing machine, comprising: a first propulsion module having a first rotating spindle, and configured to generate a first kinetic output; a second propulsion module having a second rotating spindle, and configured to generate a second kinetic output; one or more detectors coupled to the servicing machine, each detector configured to gauge a quantity and to emit data representative of the gauged quantity; a processor configured to evaluate a first expression using data from the one or more detectors, and compute a value of the first expression, wherein the first expression yields a first command representing a magnitude of rotational force to be imposed on a castor roller about a pivot axis as a first function of one or more gauged quantities relating to a drive input, a drive output, a motorized attachment, or elapsed time, and transmit the first command; and a discretionary castor steering assembly cooperatively connected to the motorized servicing machine, and having a castor yoke defining the pivot axis and a roll axis, the castor roller linked with the castor yoke so that the castor roller may be directed about the pivot axis, and a first castor steering element configured to selectively impose the magnitude of rotational force indicated by the first command upon the castor roller about the pivot axis.

A technique for supplying steering effort to a motorized upkeep machine, the technique including: furnishing a motorized upkeep machine that carries a first propulsion module with a first input shaft configured to generate a first mechanical yield, a second propulsion module with a second input shaft configured to generate a second mechanical yield, a set of detectors coupled to the machine, each detector arranged to sense a quantity and emit data representative of that quantity, and a processing unit configured to evaluate a first relation drawing on the detector data and to compute the outcome of that relation; wherein the first relation yields a first command indicating an active rotational effort to impose on a castering wheel about its pivot axis as a first function of the sensed quantities, those quantities comprising a) a reading at the input of the first propulsion module of a mechanical performance metric, b) a reading at the input of the second propulsion module of that metric, c) a reading at the output of the first propulsion module of that metric, d) a reading at the output of the second propulsion module of that metric, e) disparities between readings at the inputs of the first and second propulsion modules, f) disparities between readings at the outputs of the first and second propulsion modules, g) a mechanical power reading at a powered attachment of the machine, h) a sensed torque acting on the machine, i) elapsed time, or any combination thereof, and transmitting the first command; providing a selectively actuated caster steering assembly operatively coupled to the motorized machine, the assembly having a caster yoke defining a pivot axis and a rolling axis, a castering wheel mounted to the caster yoke for steering about the pivot axis, and a first steering actuator configured to selectively apply to the castering wheel about the pivot axis the rotational effort indicated by the first command; acquiring a reading with each detector; emitting from each detector data representative of its reading to the processing unit; computing with the processing unit the first command from the readings; transmitting the first command to the first steering actuator; and operating the first steering actuator to impose the rotational effort indicated by the first command on the castering wheel about the pivot axis, thereby furnishing steering force to the motorized machine.

A cart apparatus comprising: a suspension linkage joining a first rolling unit to a chassis, the chassis establishing a longitudinal reference line and a lateral reference line running crosswise to the longitudinal reference line, the linkage including first and second rod members configured for telescoping motion between the chassis and the first rolling unit along the lateral reference line, the first rod member mounted to the chassis and the second rod member incorporated into the first rolling unit; a turning drive connected to the rolling unit and the chassis and operable to change a steering orientation of a tire of the rolling unit relative to the longitudinal reference line; and a control processor coupled to the turning drive, the control processor being arranged to: obtain a command concerning a shift in position of the second rod member with respect to the longitudinal reference line; and establish a steering orientation of the tire based at least in part on a travel velocity of the cart apparatus and a mean rate of displacement of the turning drive.

A procedure for controlling a vehicle arrangement, the procedure comprising: obtaining a directive to modify a track dimension of a machine that carries a leading axle assembly and a trailing axle assembly; acquiring, from at least one detector, machine telemetry, the telemetry comprising a present velocity of the machine measured against a terrain surface; establishing, via a processing unit, a modification profile grounded at least in part on the present velocity of the machine; and producing commands to change the track dimension of the machine according to the modification profile.

An agricultural machine apparatus comprising: a running gear linkage joining a rolling unit to a chassis, the chassis establishing a longitudinal reference line and a lateral reference line oriented crosswise to the longitudinal reference line, the running gear linkage including: a primary shaft member and a secondary shaft member configured for operative attachment between the chassis and the rolling unit for telescoping movement along the lateral reference line, the primary shaft member mounted to the chassis and the secondary shaft member incorporated into the rolling unit; plural detection devices arranged to produce operational telemetry; a processing arrangement communicatively linked to the plural detection devices, the processing arrangement being programmed to: obtain a command pertaining to a repositioning of the secondary shaft member relative to the longitudinal reference line; and produce a modification profile derived at least in part from the command and the operational telemetry.

An adapter for a two-wheeled vehicle, comprising: an elongated cylindrical member defining a first extremity, a second extremity, and a passage extending axially through its interior; a drive-chain attachment flange, carrying a first set of equidistantly arranged openings along its rim, affixed to the elongated cylindrical member adjacent the first extremity; a stopping-device attachment flange, carrying a second set of equidistantly arranged openings along its rim, affixed to the elongated cylindrical member adjacent the second extremity and remote from the first extremity; and a rolling-element attachment flange, carrying a third set of equidistantly arranged openings along its rim, affixed to the elongated cylindrical member at an intermediate location, wherein the rolling-element attachment flange lies nearer to the stopping-device attachment flange than to the drive-chain attachment flange.

A pneumatic tyre comprising: a serpentine channel running around the circumference of a tread face, the channel having a lateral opening dimension that oscillates with a recurring period along the circumferential direction, a ratio of a narrowest to a widest value of said opening dimension lying between 0.35 and 0.85; a first channel sidewall and a second channel sidewall, both bounding the serpentine channel, each undulating in a sinusoidal pattern whose wavelength equals said recurring period when the tread face is viewed in plan; and, in said plan view, a first sinusoid traced by the first sidewall and a second sinusoid traced by the second sidewall being offset from one another in the circumferential direction by a phase shift of one-eighth to three-eighths of said period.

A pneumatic tread arrangement comprising: a set of longitudinally extending channels formed in a ground-contacting face, the channels being dimensioned so that opposing sidewalls remain spaced apart while the arrangement bears load on a road; wherein, of the channels nearest each lateral margin of the face, designated outboard channels, at least one outboard channel is a standard channel whose widest transverse dimension, measured along the channel depth, occurs solely at the level of the ground-contacting face; and wherein at least one remaining channel that is not an outboard channel is an expanded channel whose widest transverse dimension occurs at one or more depths located beneath the ground-contacting face toward the channel floor.

A procedure for determining the distortion of a pneumatic carcass under road-contact loading when fitted to a rim to form a mounted tyre unit turning at angular velocity W, the carcass possessing a tread zone meant to touch the surface and rotating around an intrinsic spin axis, the procedure comprising: securing at least one transducer to the carcass at the tread zone so as to yield at least one output responsive to acceleration, oriented perpendicular to the tread zone, imposed on the transducer within the carcass; capturing at least one first time-dependent trace Sig having at least an magnitude of the at least one output during rolling; cutting the first trace Sig across a count N TdR of full revolutions to build a revolution-based trace Sig TdR, N TdR exceeding 1; establishing at least one reference velocity W reference associated with at least one segment of the revolution-based trace Sig TdR; scaling the at least one segment of the revolution-based trace Sig TdR by a quantity which is a function F proportional to the square of the reference velocity W reference, across a number of revolutions N′ TdR not less than 1; angularly re-sampling the at least one segment of the revolution-based trace Sig TdR; deriving at least one first energy measure S from the at least one re-sampled scaled segment of the revolution-based trace Sig TdR, as S+ where the segment exceeds a limit A or as S− where the segment does not exceed the limit A; and determining a distortion Def % of the carcass as a function G of the at least one first energy measure S.

An air-retaining tire arrangement, comprising: a casing, said casing presenting an exterior face and an interior face, said casing including a first flank and an opposing second flank; said first flank exhibiting a first elastic region; said second flank exhibiting a second elastic region, said first elastic region being disposed in parallel with said second elastic region, said first elastic region and said second elastic region lying in a substantially level orientation, such that said first elastic region and said second elastic region are arranged to deform along a horizontal axis when an external load strikes said casing; a ground-engaging band fixed to at least a segment of said exterior face of said casing; a first rim seat bearing a first bead cord attached to said first flank of said casing; a second rim seat bearing a second bead cord attached to said second flank of said casing, whereby said first rim seat and said second rim seat are adapted to mount onto a wheel rim; an inner pouch, said inner pouch having a first wall situated opposite a second wall, said first wall of said pouch terminating at a first extremity and said second wall of said pouch terminating at a second extremity, said pouch presenting an outside surface and an inside surface, at least a section of said first wall of said pouch being joined to at least a section of said first flank of said casing and/or at least a section of said first rim seat, at least a section of said second wall of said pouch being joined to at least a section of said second flank of said casing and/or at least a section of said second rim seat; said first wall of said pouch exhibiting a third elastic region; said second wall of said pouch exhibiting a fourth elastic region, said third elastic region being disposed in parallel with said fourth elastic region, said third elastic region and said fourth elastic region lying in a substantially upright orientation, such that said third elastic region and said fourth elastic region are arranged to stretch along a vertical axis when the external load strikes said casing, said pouch being shaped to conform to the contour of the impacting object so that the object does not pierce said pouch; and a sealing member, said sealing member presenting an outer face and an inner face, said sealing member being coupled to at least a section of said interior face of said casing; and wherein said sealing member comprises: a body, said body enclosing an anchoring sleeve, said anchoring sleeve being linked to a first pliable projection, at least a part of said first pliable projection reaching into a cavity of said body; a first strap, said first strap having a first edge with a first flange and a second edge with a second flange, said first strap being attached to at least a part of said first pliable projection, whereby at least a portion of said first strap is held within said cavity of said body; said anchoring sleeve bearing a second pliable projection, at least a part of said second pliable projection reaching into a cavity of said body; a rod, said rod defining a notch, said rod being attached to at least a part of said second pliable projection, whereby at least a portion of said rod is held within said cavity of said body; said anchoring sleeve bearing a third pliable projection, at least a part of said third pliable projection reaching into a cavity of said body; a second strap, said second strap having a first edge with a first flange and a second edge with a second flange, said second strap being attached to at least a part of said third pliable projection, whereby at least a portion of said second strap is held within said cavity of said body; and said first flange of said first strap is received within said notch of said rod, and said second flange of said second strap is received within said notch of said rod.

A tire for a pneumatic vehicle wheel comprising: a casing structure; an impermeable inner liner; and a flexible anti-perforation ply disposed against the casing structure and exhibiting a post-vulcanization adhesion force relative to the casing structure below about 50 N at standard operating pressure.

A tire for a vehicle wheel, the tire including: a casing structure; an inner liner that retards gas permeation; and a perforation-blocking ply disposed next to the inner liner and exhibiting a post-vulcanization adhesion force against the inner liner below approximately 50 N under standard operating pressure.

A commercial road vehicle including a tire pressure maintenance arrangement, the vehicle having a trailer segment, the arrangement comprising: a regulating module, an intake port, a pressure transducer, an actuatable shut-off device that is operable by electrical or magnetic means, and a discharge port; wherein the intake port is adapted to couple with a pneumatic supply circuit of a suspension bellows; wherein the discharge port is adapted to couple with an inner cavity of a tread-bearing wheel casing; wherein the regulating module is linked to the transducer and the shut-off device; wherein the transducer is arranged to sense a pressure present at the discharge port or at the intake port; wherein the regulating module is configured to open and/or actuate the shut-off device in dependence on the sensed pressure when the sensed pressure at the discharge port drops beneath a limit value; and wherein the arrangement possesses a pressure elevating assembly incorporating an amplifier having one or two double-headed plungers or double-acting cylinders or double-acting pistons.

A hitch arrangement for joining a towed unit to a tow vehicle, the arrangement comprising: a) a joint assembly having a tow-side connector and a towed-side connector, the joint assembly exhibiting a central vertical axis and being rigidly fixed against displacement along or rotation about any of six independent axes; b) a link mechanism that establishes an instantaneous rotation center and that is arranged to allow relative angular displacement between the tow vehicle and the towed unit about at least a yaw axis; and c) a selectively engageable rotation joint; wherein the link mechanism is arranged to restrict the position of the instantaneous rotation center to lie, during operation, at or ahead of the central vertical axis of the joint assembly, at least for small yaw angles; and wherein the selectively engageable rotation joint is transitionable between a released state, in which angular movement in yaw of one portion of the arrangement relative to a remaining portion about the selectively engageable rotation joint is allowed, and a retained state, in which such angular movement of the one portion relative to the remaining portion about the selectively engageable rotation joint is prevented.

A wheel arrangement comprising: a tire-receiving circumference; a central boss coaxial with the circumference; an intermediate boss coaxial with both the circumference and the central boss, the intermediate boss lying radially between the circumference and the central boss; a first plurality of web members distributed around the central boss and extending between the central boss and the intermediate boss, each web member extending outward along a radial direction and following a sine-wave profile; and a second plurality of web members distributed around the intermediate boss and extending between the intermediate boss and the circumference, each web member extending outward along a radial direction and following a sine-wave profile, the web members of the second plurality being angularly registered with the web members of the first plurality about the intermediate boss.

A cart-type conveyance comprising: a chassis bearing structure; a roller mounted to the chassis bearing structure and configured to turn relative thereto; the roller possessing a perimeter band; the roller possessing a core boss coaxial with the perimeter band; the roller possessing an intermediate boss coaxial with the perimeter band and the core boss, the intermediate boss lying between the perimeter band and the core boss; the roller possessing a first plurality of struts distributed circumferentially around the core boss between the core boss and the intermediate boss, the first plurality of struts extending radially outward from the core boss and exhibiting a wave-like profile; the roller possessing a second plurality of struts distributed circumferentially around the intermediate boss between the intermediate boss and the perimeter band, the second plurality of struts extending radially outward from the intermediate boss and exhibiting a wave-like profile; and the second plurality of struts being angularly registered with the first plurality of struts about the intermediate boss.

A road-wheel arrangement comprising: an outer annulus; a central boss positioned coaxially within the annulus; a first plurality of web members distributed around the boss between the boss and the annulus, each web member of the first plurality presenting an oval profile extended along a radial line running from the boss toward the annulus; a second plurality of web members distributed around the boss between the first plurality and the annulus, each web member of the second plurality presenting a segmental oval profile extended along a radial line running from the boss toward the annulus; and the web members of the first plurality alternating circumferentially about the boss with the web members of the second plurality.

A cart-type conveyance comprising: a chassis bearing structure; a rolling member carried by the chassis bearing structure and turnable with respect to it; the rolling member possessing a tire seat and a central boss coaxial with the tire seat; the rolling member incorporating a primary array of arms distributed around the boss between the boss and the tire seat, each arm of the primary array presenting an oval profile stretched along a line running outward from the boss toward the tire seat; the rolling member further incorporating a secondary array of arms distributed around the boss between the primary array and the tire seat, each arm of the secondary array presenting a segmented oval profile stretched along a line running outward from the boss toward the tire seat; and the arms of the primary array alternating with the arms of the secondary array in sequence around the boss.

A foldable road-engaging assembly switchable between an extended state and a retracted state, the assembly including: a central boss establishing a spin axis; a set of radial struts projecting outward from the boss, each strut having an inboard terminus; a set of perimeter members; wherein: the boss incorporates a telescoping linkage arrangement; the linkage arrangement includes at least one lever arm having a proximal extremity and a distal extremity, the proximal extremity pivotally coupled to the boss, and the inboard terminus of each strut of the set of radial struts pivotally secured to the distal extremity; wherein: in the extended state, the at least one lever arm contributes a segment of an overall strut span, and in the retracted state, the at least one lever arm defines an oblique included angle with at least one radial strut of the set of radial struts; and wherein the assembly is configured to be transitioned between the extended state and the retracted state.

A tire-blowout-resistant wheel rim, comprising: a rim body having a peripheral surface, a inboard face and an outboard face, the inboard face and the outboard face lying opposite one another at the two ends of the peripheral surface; an aperture formed in the outboard face through which a drive axle shaft of a motor vehicle may extend, and a mounting boss on the inboard face configured to couple with that drive axle shaft; a first rim lip and a second rim lip projecting from opposite edges of the peripheral surface, a bead-seating well being defined between the first rim lip and the second rim lip; and a retention ridge disposed on the bead-seating well, the retention ridge being an annular raised band running along the peripheral surface, coaxial with the peripheral surface, and having a face provided with a serrated profile composed of a plurality of projecting cogs alternating with notches, each projecting cog rising outwardly from the face and each notch dipping inwardly into the face, wherein the overall outer diameter measured across the projecting cogs exceeds the diameter of a tire bead fitted to the bead-seating well.

A detection bracket mounted to a terminal region, along an axial direction, of a stationary race situated radially outward of a rotating element that carries a signal wheel at a terminal region thereof and is held for rotation by way of two rows of rolling bodies, the detection bracket comprising: a lid section fitted to the stationary race in a manner that seals an aperture at one axial extremity of the stationary race; a detector mount that projects from the lid section toward one axial side at a position on the lid section confronting the signal wheel and carries a transducer that senses movement of the signal wheel; and a fastener seat that projects from the lid section toward the one axial side and retains a threaded fastener by which the transducer is secured to the lid section; wherein the detector mount and the fastener seat are formed as separate members, and an axial one-side end face of the threaded fastener retained by the fastener seat projects further toward the one axial side than an axial one-side end face of the detector mount; and

query_text: A vulcanizable elastomeric mixture comprising: a diene-based elastomer constituent; and a reinforcing particulate package, wherein the reinforcing particulate package includes: a first precipitated silica bearing one or more chemically grafted moieties on its exterior and exhibiting a nitrogen-adsorption surface area of 250 to 310 m2/g and a cetyltrimethylammonium bromide adsorption surface area of 230 to 285 m2/g; and a second precipitated silica lacking any surface grafting and exhibiting a nitrogen-adsorption surface area of 60 to 120 m2/g and a cetyltrimethylammonium bromide adsorption surface area of 55 to 105 m2/g.

A tire-and-wheel-hub combination, the combination comprising: a airless tyre having a hoop; an annular tread mounted around the hoop; a set of struts projecting radially inward from the hoop, wherein each strut ends in a lower terminus formed by a laterally oriented bar, wherein each strut carries a reinforcing element at least partly enveloping the laterally oriented bar, wherein the reinforcing element is chosen from the set consisting of: a plurality of filaments of reinforcing material, a grid of reinforcing material, and a film of reinforcing material; and a wheel hub having a plurality of seats, each seat being shaped to accept the laterally oriented bar of a respective strut.

A process for fabricating a non-air-filled wheel, the process comprising: supplying a hoop; furnishing a set of longitudinal rods; positioning the rods within the hoop so that each rod runs parallel to a rotational axis of the hoop; supplying a strip of fortifying fabric; and winding the strip of fortifying fabric in a serpentine route along an interior face of the hoop and about each of the rods.

An airless wheel for a vehicle, comprising: a hoop; an outer contact band positioned around the hoop; a series of spokes projecting radially inward from the hoop, wherein a terminal portion of each spoke carries a laterally oriented bar, and wherein each spoke is provided with a strengthening sheath that runs along its span and encircles the laterally oriented bar.

A tyre-equivalent sleeve for a rolling member, the sleeve being annular and tubular and extending in a radial sense between a radially interior zone and a radially exterior zone; the exterior zone serving as a contact band that enables, during operation, sustained engagement with a ground surface; wherein the interior zone is shaped to present a multiplicity of locking projections, the locking projections being adapted to establish a press-fit type engagement between the sleeve and a component of a wheel carcass so as to transmit, between the sleeve and that component, forces having at least a partly circumferential orientation.

query_text: A wheel support body, comprising: a central boss adapted to be mounted on a drive shaft of a propulsion arrangement; a rim section disposed radially outward of the central boss and serving as a base onto which a tyre-like sleeve is fitted so as to surround the rim section from outside; at least one bracing member extending between the central boss and the rim section and imparting rigidity to the body; wherein the rim section comprises a plurality of mating projections constructed to form an interference-fit connection with the sleeve, thereby producing force components acting at least in part along a circumferential direction.

A transport apparatus adapted to carry and govern at least one load, said at least one load being fixedly yet detachably secured to said transport apparatus, said load being a blade plate, wherein said transport apparatus includes at least one roller unit, said at least one roller unit being rotationally bound to a shaft of a drive arrangement of said transport apparatus, a rolling bearing being situated between said shaft of said drive arrangement and a core of said roller unit, said roller unit comprising: a chassis including a core, a rim and at least one bracing member, said core being adapted to be joined to a shaft of a drive arrangement, said rim being disposed circumferentially outward of said core, said bracing member linking between said core and said rim and being designed to impart structural rigidity to said chassis, wherein said rim is shaped to present a plurality of interlocking formations, and a sheath of hollow cylindrical shape extending radially between an interior section and an exterior section, said exterior section being designed to serve as a traction surface and imparting to said sheath the capacity to remain in ground-engaging contact during operation, wherein said interior section is shaped to present a plurality of interlocking formations, wherein a state of reciprocal interlocking exists between the interlocking formations of said rim of said chassis and the interlocking formations of said interior section of said sheath.

A pneumatic tyre comprising a ground-contacting region having a row of rubber lugs formed by a set of lugs delimited by a series of longitudinally extending channels; each lug being fitted with a single sipe running peripherally around the tyre so as to open into at least one of the channels, the peripheral sipe incorporating one or more localized angular kinks; and an edge of the peripheral sipe being provided with a beveled rim section.

A tire for a vehicle wheel, comprising: a set of circumferentially running primary channels; and an intermediate rib arrangement situated between a pair of the primary channels, wherein the rib arrangement comprises a rib having a pair of lateral faces each opposing a respective one of the two primary channels and each provided with a recess at a midsection along the circumferential direction, and a pair of transverse flank faces linking the circumferential ends of the lateral faces, each transverse flank face comprising a first linear end, a second linear end angled with respect to the first linear end, and a third linear end angled with respect to the second linear end, the first, second and third linear ends being sequentially positioned from a first axial side toward a second axial side of the tire, the rib further comprising a narrow slit of width between 2.0 mm and 5.0 mm joining the recesses of the pair of lateral faces, the narrow slit including a first linear section, a second linear section angled with respect to the first linear section, and a third linear section angled with respect to the second linear section, the first, second and third linear sections being sequentially arranged from the first axial side toward the second axial side, the first linear section lying along a first median line bisecting the region between the first linear ends, the second linear section lying along a second median line bisecting the region between the second linear ends, and the third linear section lying along a third median line bisecting the region between the third linear ends.

A motorcycle-type two-wheeler apparatus, comprising: a wheel having a hub mounting portion positioned coaxially about a central axis (A) of the wheel; a circumferential rim portion likewise coaxial with the central axis (A); and first and second web members projecting radially inward from the rim portion toward the hub mounting portion, the web members being laterally offset from one another along a direction parallel to the central axis (A), the web members converging toward the hub mounting portion and joined to each other so as to define at least one enclosed void bounded by the web members and the rim portion; wherein at least one opening leading into the at least one enclosed void is provided within a drop-center channel of the rim portion.
A wheel arrangement as set forth in the preceding aspect, wherein the single-piece wheel body is formed as one unitary structure.

A omnidirectional drive wheel comprising: a set of barrel-shaped rotors each having a tread face and a spindle whose terminal ends project beyond both lateral margins of the tread face along the spindle's lengthwise direction and present a shoulder face substantially normal to the spindle; a hub frame that carries the rotors through seat modules configured to receive the respective terminal ends of each rotor, wherein each seat module includes a receptacle cavity provided with an access aperture into which a terminal end is introduced, the receptacle cavity engaging the corresponding terminal end so as to restrain the rotor against displacement relative to the hub frame in any direction possessing an inward-directed radial component of the omnidirectional drive wheel, a abutment face substantially normal to the spindle cooperating with the shoulder face to restrain the rotor against displacement relative to the hub frame along the spindle axis, and a resilient detent structure positioned at least in part within an introduction trajectory of the respective terminal end, the detent structure offering resistance as the terminal end is advanced past or withdrawn from the detent structure into and out of a seated position within the receptacle cavity, thereby inhibiting inadvertent dislodgement of the rotor under forces having an outward-directed radial component of the omnidirectional drive wheel.

A rolling locomotion apparatus comprising: a lattice-like framework having a central axis, the framework incorporating a set of stiff struts and a set of resilient tendons; a central collar positioned at a proximal extremity of the framework; a peripheral collar positioned at a distal extremity of the framework; and a tether engaging the peripheral collar, running through the framework alongside the central axis, and passing through the central collar, the tether being manipulable to draw in so as to shift the framework into a compact configuration and to pay out so as to shift the framework into an extended configuration.

A locomotion apparatus comprising: a chassis; a first compliant rolling member mounted on a first axle projecting from a first lateral face of the chassis, the first compliant rolling member configured to spin about a first central axis; and a second compliant rolling member mounted on a second axle projecting from a second lateral face of the chassis, the second compliant rolling member configured to spin about a second central axis.

A manipulator apparatus comprising: a proximal platform carrying a first gripping member; a distal platform carrying a second gripping member; at least one compliant tensile-compression lattice situated sequentially between the proximal platform and the distal platform, the at least one lattice establishing an axis of extension; and a set of flexible tendons running between the proximal platform and the distal platform, each tendon being selectively drawable toward or payable out from the proximal platform, each tendon lying generally aligned with the axis of extension whenever the axis of extension is substantially straight.

An electrically assisted bicycle hub assembly, comprising: a central axle member configured to turn around a central axis; an outer annular member configured to turn around the central axis, the central axle member and the outer annular member being joined together by a plurality of tensioned wires; a retention arrangement comprising a locking collar mounted non-rotatably onto the central axle member, and a tightening ring securable to the central axle member or to the locking collar by a threaded joint; a braking disk non-rotatably coupled to the central axle member through the retention arrangement, wherein the braking disk engages the locking collar in a form-fitting manner along a rotational direction, and the braking disk is clamped along the central axis between the central axle member or the locking collar and the tightening ring; and a detection ring fixed in a rotationally locked manner to the central axle member, the detection ring having a sensing region readable by a speed detector, wherein the detection ring is directly affixed to the tightening ring, and the detection ring is securable together with the tightening ring to the central axle member or to the locking collar by the threaded joint.

An axle-mounted apparatus for a pedal-driven conveyance, the apparatus comprising: a spindle defining a bore and a longitudinal axis that establishes an axial orientation and a transverse orientation; a rotatable shell surrounding the longitudinal axis and presenting a cavity bounded radially between the shell and the spindle; a shaft arranged to pass through the bore of the spindle; and a conductor assembly having a first run leading from the cavity of the shell through a port in the spindle into the bore, a second run extending axially inside the bore, and a telescoping run situated axially between the first run and the second run within the bore, the telescoping run being elongatable along the axial orientation in reaction to displacement of the shaft relative to the spindle; and
