query_text: A bicycle wheel hub unit for a pedal-driven cycle, the unit comprising: a fixed shaft defining a bore that runs from a proximal end to a distal end, and a longitudinal axis establishing an axial orientation and a transverse orientation; a rotating housing mounted about the longitudinal axis and enclosing an internal chamber; a spindle positioned within the bore of the fixed shaft, the spindle comprising a primary segment and a secondary segment, the secondary segment being removably fastened to the primary segment along the axial orientation; and a wire harness passing from the internal chamber of the rotating housing through a port formed in the fixed shaft into the bore, the wire harness extending axially alongside a portion of the primary segment.

A coupling shaft for a wheel hub unit of a pedal-driven cycle, the coupling shaft comprising: a primary shaft section having a first mounting terminus and a first joining terminus; and a secondary shaft section having a second mounting terminus and a second joining terminus, the second joining terminus of the secondary shaft section being releasably engaged with the first joining terminus of the primary shaft section by a bayonet-style fastening arrangement, the bayonet-style fastening arrangement including a protruding plug formed on one of the first joining terminus and the second joining terminus of the secondary shaft section, and a recessed socket formed on the other of the first joining terminus of the primary shaft section and the second joining terminus of the secondary shaft section.

A cycle hub drive assembly, comprising: a stationary spindle; a perforated gear-toothed hub spindle formed of a tubular barrel and a gear disk at one terminus of the barrel, the gear disk having a ring of arcuate recesses along its periphery; a hub axle having a first bearing housing at one extremity and carrying a first rolling element bearing therein, the hub axle further bearing two spoke flanges projecting from its outer surface along its length and defining a first central bore along its axis; a chain wheel spindle having an annular recess on one face, a second central bore at the centre of the recess, and a circumferential set of second locating apertures near the recess floor that cooperate with the arcuate recesses; the barrel of the gear-toothed hub spindle passing successively through the second central bore and the first central bore and projecting into the first bearing housing, with the gear disk seated within the annular recess; a closure cap engaged with the open mouth of the annular recess, the cap bearing first locating apertures coaxial with the second locating apertures, locking pegs disposed within the cylindrical volumes defined by aligned first and second apertures, biasing members interposed between the pegs and the floors of the second apertures, the pegs having a channel formed on a side facing the central axis of the gear disk; and a second bearing housing on the outer face of the closure cap, centred on the cap body and having a third central bore, a second rolling element bearing disposed within the second bearing housing; wherein the stationary spindle is received inside the barrel and the first and second rolling element bearings are respectively fitted over the outer circumferential surfaces of the journals on opposite sides of the stationary spindle.
A vehicle drive shaft housing comprising: a pair of mounting rims situated near the outer extremities of the housing; and a pair of secondary rims set back inwardly from the mounting rims.

A vehicle drive shaft housing apparatus comprising: a shaft body having first and second terminal rims disposed proximate its extremities and a pair of secondary rims situated at intermediate locations set inboard of the terminal rims.

A vehicular shaft apparatus, comprising: a pair of mounting rims located proximate to opposite terminal regions of the shaft apparatus, the mounting rims being adapted to fasten brake drum units to the shaft apparatus; and a pair of supplemental rims set back inwardly from the mounting rims, the supplemental rims being adapted to fasten vehicle guard systems to the shaft apparatus.

A wheel tyre assembly, comprising: a hub, an outer casing, a bladder ring, and a pressurization fitting; a radially outer face of the hub defines a channel extending about the full circumference of the hub; bead regions of the outer casing are sealingly joined to flanks of the channel, such that a closed pneumatic chamber is delimited between the hub and the outer casing; the bladder ring is annular and composed of a resilient cellular material, having a cross-sectional dimension exceeding that of the pneumatic chamber; the bladder ring is situated within the pneumatic chamber such that an exterior surface of the bladder ring abuts an interior boundary of the pneumatic chamber; and the pressurization fitting is secured to the hub and is operable to pressurize the pneumatic chamber and the bladder ring.

A pneumatic covering assembly comprising: a signal transceiver integrated within a sidewall region of the covering; and a series of raised ridges protruding from an exterior face of the sidewall region, running in a radial orientation, and spaced apart around a circumferential direction; wherein, when viewed in a projection onto the sidewall region along an axial direction, the signal transceiver coincides with at least one of a gap situated between neighboring raised ridges and one of the raised ridges.

An anti-theft apparatus for a vehicle wheel, comprising: a circular plate element shaped to surround a hub cap and, jointly with the hub cap, mount onto a spindle flange of a motor vehicle; wherein the circular plate element serves as a retainer that holds a wheel rim in place and blocks its separation from the vehicle when wheel-securing bolts become loosened inadvertently.

A vehicle wheel retention apparatus comprising: a retaining element shaped to surround a hub cap and, jointly with the hub cap, mount onto a drive spindle of a motor vehicle, wherein the retaining element is arranged to hold and prevent a road wheel from separating from the vehicle if securing bolts holding the road wheel to the vehicle become loosened inadvertently.

A roller assembly, comprising: an axle defining a spin axis; a core member arranged to turn about the spin axis; a tire ring arranged to turn about the spin axis, the tire ring disposed farther from the spin axis than the core member; a first flex arm joined between the core member and the tire ring; a second flex arm joined between the core member and the tire ring, the second flex arm comprising: a root segment projecting from the core member; a terminal segment projecting from the tire ring; and a linking segment bridging the root segment and the terminal segment; and a third flex arm joined between the core member and the tire ring, the third flex arm comprising: a root segment projecting from the core member; a terminal segment projecting from the tire ring; and a linking segment bridging the root segment and the terminal segment, wherein the linking segment of the third flex arm and the linking segment of the second flex arm are curved toward one another in an unloaded state; a first gap measured between a first point of the root segment of the second flex arm attached to the core member and a second point of the root segment of the third flex arm attached to the core member; and a second gap measured between a third point of the terminal segment of the second flex arm attached to the tire ring and a fourth point of the terminal segment of the third flex arm attached to the tire ring; wherein the first gap is smaller than the second gap; and wherein, upon applied loading sufficient to deform the roller assembly, the first flex arm contacts the second flex arm after the roller assembly has deformed by a first amount, such that said contact opposes further deformation of the roller assembly.

A rolling assembly, comprising: a pivot line; a central boss arranged to revolve about the pivot line; a peripheral ring arranged to revolve about the pivot line and situated radially beyond the central boss; a first group of radial members, including: a first member bridging the central boss and the peripheral ring, the first member having a root segment projecting from the central boss, a terminal segment projecting from the peripheral ring, and an intermediate segment joining the root segment and the terminal segment; and a second member bridging the central boss and the peripheral ring, the second member having a root segment projecting from the central boss, a terminal segment projecting from the peripheral ring, and an intermediate segment joining the root segment and the terminal segment, wherein the intermediate segments of the first and second members bulge toward one another when the rolling assembly is at rest; and a second group of radial members adjacent the first group, the second group including: a third member bridging the central boss and the peripheral ring, the third member having a root segment projecting from the central boss, a terminal segment projecting from the peripheral ring, and an intermediate segment joining the root segment and the terminal segment; and a fourth member bridging the central boss and the peripheral ring, the fourth member having a root segment projecting from the central boss, a terminal segment projecting from the peripheral ring, and an intermediate segment joining the root segment and the terminal segment, wherein the intermediate segments of the third and fourth members bulge toward one another when the rolling assembly is at rest; a first spacing between the root segments of the second and third members when the rolling assembly is at rest; and a second spacing between the terminal segments of the second and third members when the rolling assembly is at rest, the second spacing being larger than the first spacing.

A wheel assembly, comprising: a pivot axis; a central boss arranged to turn about the pivot axis; a circumferential ring arranged to turn about the pivot axis, the ring disposed at a greater radial distance from the pivot axis than the boss; a first flexible arm extending between the boss and the ring, the first flexible arm comprising: an intermediate portion; a proximal segment extending from the boss to the intermediate portion; and a distal segment extending from the ring to the intermediate portion; a second flexible arm extending between the boss and the ring, the second flexible arm comprising: an intermediate portion; a proximal segment extending from the boss to the intermediate portion; and a distal segment extending from the ring to the intermediate portion; a third flexible arm extending between the boss and the ring, the third flexible arm comprising: an intermediate portion; a proximal segment extending from the boss to the intermediate portion; and a distal segment extending from the ring to the intermediate portion; wherein the second flexible arm is located between the first flexible arm and the third flexible arm; wherein a minimum angular separation between the second flexible arm and the third flexible arm, measured in radians about the pivot axis, occurs between the proximal segment of the second flexible arm and the proximal segment of the third flexible arm; wherein the minimum angular separation is smaller than a first spacing measured between the distal segment of the second flexible arm and the distal segment of the third flexible arm in an undeformed state of the wheel assembly; wherein the minimum angular separation is smaller than a second spacing measured between the proximal segment of the first flexible arm and the proximal segment of the second flexible arm in the undeformed state; and wherein, upon loading of the wheel assembly sufficient to deform the wheel assembly, the first flexible arm contacts the second flexible arm after the wheel assembly has deformed by a first extent, such that said contact opposes further deformation of the wheel assembly.

A wheel-end bearing unit comprising: an axis of revolution; a non-rotating outer race; a hub with a radial collar protruding into the bore of the outer race and arranged to turn about the axis and with respect to the outer race; an inner race fitted onto the hub and abutting a section of the hub along its axial direction; a splined collar positioned axially inboard of and next to the inner race, the splined collar being locked against rotation with respect to the hub; a supplementary ring fitted onto the hub and touching the splined collar, wherein the hub has an axially inboard flared lip touching the supplementary ring and operable to keep a preload on the inner race; and wherein the supplementary ring is shaped to absorb distortions caused by forming the flared lip.

A process for constructing a wheel bearing arrangement, the process comprising: fitting a shaped hub having a radial collar within a fixed outer race; seating an inner race onto the shaped hub so that it axially bears against a section of the shaped hub; positioning a splined collar on the shaped hub axially inboard of and next to the inner race in a manner that prevents relative rotation between the splined collar and the shaped hub; placing a supplementary ring on the shaped hub so that it touches the splined collar; and creating a turned lip on the shaped hub that bears against the supplementary ring so as to keep a preload applied to the inner race and absorbs distortions produced by forming the turned lip.

A rolling support device, comprising: a rolling member; a bearing plate that defines a first aperture in which the rolling member is seated and that carries the rolling member for rotation; and a pivot assembly that retains a perimeter region bounding the first aperture in the bearing plate so as to permit horizontal pivoting.

A pneumatic covering for road-going wheels, the covering including a ground-engaging crown structure having: a first lateral edge zone and a second lateral edge zone situated on opposite axial sides; a midsection positioned between the first edge zone and the second edge zone; a series of paired first and second tread elements, disposed in consecutive order around the circumference of the midsection, with each first tread element and its paired second tread element being at least partly aligned with one another in an axial orientation of the crown structure; a first group of longitudinal channels arranged in consecutive order around the circumference of the crown structure to partly bound the first and second tread elements, each channel of the first group consisting of a first long channel extending from the first edge zone toward the midsection and a second long channel extending from the second edge zone toward the midsection; a second group of longitudinal channels arranged in consecutive order around the circumference of the crown structure in alternation with the channels of the first group, each channel of the second group consisting of a third long channel extending from the first edge zone toward the midsection and a fourth long channel extending from the second edge zone toward the midsection; wherein, within each channel pair of the first group, the second long channel has an axially inner end joined to the first long channel; wherein, within each channel pair of the first group, the first long channel has an axially inner terminal portion joined to the second long channel that follows it circumferentially, thereby axially separating one first tread element and one second tread element of one of the paired tread elements; and wherein, within each channel pair of the second group, the third and fourth long channels have respective axially inner ends prolonged by respective first narrow slits joined to the terminal portion of the first long channel, thereby circumferentially separating the first and second tread elements into respective first and second block portions; and in which a first series of pairs of auxiliary channels is formed in the crown structure, arranged in consecutive order around the circumference to at least partly bound the first and second tread elements from their axially outer side, each pair of auxiliary channels comprising a first auxiliary channel branching from a first long channel and a second auxiliary channel branching from a second long channel.

A pneumatic tyre for a commercial truck, comprising: a ground-engaging crown portion having an axial breadth W and bearing a pattern of paired land elements divided by voids; the pattern being formed, around a circumference of the tyre, by a succession of ranks of land elements each shaped as a V so that every V points toward the rolling direction and each apex lies within a common circumferential reference plane normal to the spin axis; each rank spanning from one shoulder edge of the crown portion to the opposite shoulder edge and consisting, along the axial direction, of adjacent land elements; land elements within one rank being spaced pairwise by a circumferential groove whose centreline forms an average inclination below 45 degrees relative to the circumferential direction; two neighbouring ranks being partitioned by a V-shaped transverse groove extending uninterrupted between the shoulder edges, such that the leading or trailing faces of the land elements bounding that groove along the road-contacting surface lie on a single common line; and wherein every V-shaped transverse groove possesses a centreline formed of two legs, each leg making with the axial direction an average angle between 15 degrees and 55 degrees.

A process for capturing a tire tread profile, comprising: observing imaging data containing one or more depictions of a grooved road-contact face recorded by a sensing apparatus; recognizing, from the imaging data, that the apparatus has crossed an edge of the grooved face; upon recognizing the crossing of the edge, establishing an initiation location for acquisition within the one or more depictions; and constructing a contour of the grooved face from the one or more depictions using the initiation location.

An apparatus for capturing tire tread information, comprising: a light-projecting module; an imaging component; and a controller configured to: track image frames containing one or more views of a grooved contact face captured by the imaging component; recognize, from the image frames, that the apparatus has crossed an edge of the grooved contact face; upon recognizing the crossing of the edge, select a capture start location among the one or more views; and construct a topography map of the grooved contact face from the one or more views using the capture start location.

A vehicle pneumatic tyre comprising: a tread portion; a belt package; a radial ply casing; and flanks, each flank bearing, in its outer radial zone, at least two series of parallelogrammic projections rising 0.80 mm to 1.50 mm above the surrounding flank surface, the series extending coaxially with the annular flank profile, with gaps provided between projections within a single series and between adjacent series; wherein the series of projections are displaced relative to one another along the circumference of the flank, the projections partially overlapping, and wherein the gaps between projections are likewise displaced circumferentially from series to series so that they do not align.

An apparatus, comprising: an air-supply assembly coupled to a rim of an automobile, including: a compressor operable to fill a tyre fitted on the rim; a onboard governor arranged to regulate the compressor according to a collection of operating directives; and a plurality of detectors arranged to gather readings describing the air-supply assembly; and a wireless transceiver affixed to the automobile and arranged to: relay the readings to an offsite governing unit adapted to compute revised operating directives in real time from the readings; obtain the revised operating directives from the offsite governing unit; and forward the revised operating directives to the onboard governor, wherein the onboard governor drives the compressor in accordance with the revised operating directives.

An apparatus, comprising: a plurality of tire pressure regulation modules, each adapted to be fastened to a road wheel of an automotive vehicle, wherein each regulation module includes: a compressed gas reservoir; a group of transducers adapted to capture a collection of readings; and a control circuit adapted to govern the compressed gas reservoir according to a set of inflation setpoints; and a central supervisory unit, situated apart from the plurality of regulation modules and adapted to: compute an updated set of inflation setpoints using each collection of readings; and wirelessly send the updated set of inflation setpoints to multiple regulation modules while the vehicle is in motion, wherein the control circuit of each regulation module is adapted to govern the respective compressed gas reservoir in accordance with the updated set of inflation setpoints.

A load-measuring apparatus for a towing vehicle, comprising: a chassis having a fixed end configured to attach the chassis to a hitch, coupler, or tow ball of a tractor; and a load-sensing platform positioned on a second connecting section of the chassis, next to the fixed end.

A tire-removal apparatus comprising: a set of fastener-engaging rotors disposed in a mirrored configuration so that every rotor turns in an identical angular sense, each rotor defining a central passage whose sidewall bears an internal helical groove; a driveline coupled to one of the rotors, such that turning the driveline imparts identical angular motion to all of the rotors; a collection of threaded studs, each stud bearing an external helical ridge dimensioned to mate with the internal helical groove of a respective rotor, each stud being passable through openings in a rim-and-hub unit and into the central passage of its corresponding rotor, each stud being selectively advanced to mate with the rotor and clamp the tire to the hub, and selectively retracted to disengage from the rotor and free the tire from the hub, whereby turning the driveline causes the rotors to advance or retract the mated studs in unison; and a release stud having an external helical ridge sized to mate with the internal helical groove of the central passage of one of the rotors, the release stud insertable into that passage from a side opposite the insertion side of the corresponding threaded stud, wherein the release stud, upon being turned counterclockwise by an applied external torque, drives the rotors to back out the studs seated therein and free the tire.

A procedure for swapping a road wheel on an automobile, comprising: choosing, through a smartphone application, a hoisting action for the automobile by means of a powered lift possessing multiple supports, each support telescoping outward from a retracted state housed inside the automobile frame into a deployed state sufficient to lift the automobile; designating, through the smartphone application, at least one road wheel of the automobile to be exchanged; instructing the smartphone application to energize the multiple supports so as to elevate the automobile to an elevation appropriate for exchanging the road wheel; instructing the smartphone application to drive an electric motor coupled to a fastener-engaging gear assembly so that it turns in a backing-off direction, thereby slackening a group of drive fasteners that retain a first road wheel attached to a set of fastener-engaging gears within the fastener-engaging gear assembly; manually withdrawing the group of drive fasteners; manually detaching the first road wheel from a spindle of the automobile; manually seating a replacement road wheel onto the spindle; manually reinstalling the group of drive fasteners to affix the replacement road wheel to the set of fastener-engaging gears; instructing the smartphone application to energize the electric motor to rotate in a tightening direction, thereby cinching the group of drive fasteners against the fastener-engaging gears; and instructing the smartphone application to energize the multiple supports to lower the automobile to a ground surface.

A tire-use elastomeric mixture, containing a polymer base, a tackifying modifier, and a reinforcing particulate material, where: the polymer base includes an isoprene-backbone elastomer and a styrene-butadiene elastomer; the styrene-butadiene elastomer exhibits a glass transition point below −40° C.; the tackifying modifier is present at 1 or more but less than 50 parts by weight per 100 parts by weight of the polymer base; the tackifying modifier has been partially saturated by hydrogenation and differs in solubility parameter from the isoprene-backbone elastomer by no more than 1.40 (cal/cm³)^1/2; and the mixture satisfies the relation that the weight ratio of the tackifying modifier to the isoprene-backbone elastomer is 0.5 or greater.
