query_text: A procedure for driving a conveyance unit within an article-handling installation, the conveyance unit having at least one roller, the method comprising: spinning the at least one roller along a first heading so that the conveyance unit advances; the at least one roller incorporating a central boss, an peripheral band, and a flexible coupling layer positioned between the boss and the band, the flexible coupling layer comprising neighboring flexible members that bound a oval-shaped opening between them, the oval-shaped opening possessing a long axis oriented at an angle relative to a substantially outward direction of the neighboring flexible members, and wherein each crest of curved segments of the neighboring flexible members shifts between lying nearer the peripheral band than the central boss and lying nearer the central boss than the peripheral band, such that torque is conveyed from the central boss to the peripheral band more quickly when the rotation of the central boss follows the long axis than when that rotation runs counter to the long axis; imposing a squeezing load on the at least one roller while it turns; and taking up the squeezing load through the flexible coupling layer.

A road-wheel arrangement, comprising: a rim member including a flange section, wherein the flange section incorporates a debris expulsion region having a first expelling face and a second expelling face recessed in divergent orientations along an interior-facing surface of the flange section.

A road-wheel arrangement comprising: a rim section including a flange segment provided with a debris expulsion feature; and a central boss section coupled to the rim section, the boss section defining a recessed expulsion face situated at a location aligned with the debris expulsion feature.

A bogie-less wheelset arrangement for a railway carriage, comprising: a central beam portion extending along a lengthwise axis; a pair of pivot pins, a first pin mounted at a first terminal region of the central beam portion and a second pin mounted at a second terminal region of the central beam portion situated opposite the first terminal region, the pins projecting outwardly from the central beam portion and defining a rotational axis for a railway wheel journaled on each respective pin; wherein the central beam portion includes a top surface oriented toward a vehicle superstructure during operation and the pins are disposed on the top surface; and wherein at least one moulded element of the assembly is provided with a lengthwise bore running along the lengthwise direction of the arrangement, the bore being formed during moulding as a continuous passage traversing the respective moulded element.

A pneumatic tyre comprising: at least one rib-like segment delimited on a ground-contacting face by at least one channel and by shoulder boundaries, the segment lying between channels or between a channel and a shoulder boundary; wherein at least one such segment incorporates at least one slit oriented along the peripheral direction or the axial direction of the tyre, the slit presenting: a constricted portion continuously traversing radially inward from the ground-contacting face, an enlarged portion situated radially inward of the constricted portion in which the slit breadth exceeds that of the constricted portion, and a plurality of floor channels at the base of the enlarged portion extending along the lengthwise direction of the slit.

A commercial vehicle tire tread, comprising: a peripheral direction extending about a pivot axis, an axial direction running parallel to the pivot axis, and a radial direction orthogonal to the pivot axis, wherein the tread possesses an exterior face; a channel extending in the peripheral direction entirely encircling the tread; a land having a segment that delimits a section of the channel, wherein the segment includes a crest in the radial direction, the crest possessing a forward border and a rearward border in the peripheral direction, the forward border and the rearward border lying at unequal radial spacings from the pivot axis, wherein the exterior face of the tread at a region of the land abutting the crest in the axial direction is positioned at a uniform radial spacing from the pivot axis along the peripheral direction; a first narrow slit extending into the land and terminating at the channel; a second narrow slit extending into the land and terminating at the channel; and wherein the segment extends from the first narrow slit to the second narrow slit in the peripheral direction.

A tyre assembly comprising: a tread section; a pair of side wall regions; a pair of bead regions each housing a bead core; a casing extending across the pair of bead regions; a breaker structure positioned radially outside the casing; and stiffening rubber strips respectively located at the pair of bead regions, wherein the casing is a ply that includes: a main sheet running between the bead cores of the pair of bead regions, and a pair of folded-back sheets each wrapped about a respective bead core from an inboard side toward an outboard side, extending radially outward, and terminating at free edges, and in a meridional section of the tyre in a reference condition where the tyre is mounted on a reference rim and pressurised to a reference pressure with no applied load, each of the pair of folded-back sheets comprises: a first segment between the main sheet and the breaker structure, a second segment abutting each stiffening rubber strip in the axial direction, radially outward of a rim flange of the reference rim, and a third segment interposed between the first segment and the second segment, and a third extent of the third segment is 0.8 to 1.4 times a sum of a first extent of the first segment and a second extent of the second segment.

A tyre assembly comprising: a tread section; a pair of flank regions; a pair of bead regions each provided with a bead core; a casing spanning between the pair of bead regions; a belted layer disposed radially outward of the casing; and stiffening rubber strips respectively located at the pair of bead regions, wherein the casing is formed by a single ply having a main segment running between the bead cores of the pair of bead regions, and a pair of folded-back segments each wrapped about a respective bead core from an inboard side toward an outboard side in an axial direction, extending radially outward, and terminating in free ends, and wherein, in a meridional section of the tyre mounted on a specified rim, inflated to a specified pressure, and unloaded, each folded-back segment includes: a first zone between the main segment and the belted layer, a second zone adjacent to a respective stiffening rubber strip in the axial direction and positioned radially outward of a rim flange of the specified rim, and a third zone interposed between the first zone and the second zone, a length of the third zone being 0.8 to 1.4 times a combined length of a length of the first zone and a length of the second zone, each bead region includes a bead filler rubber projecting radially outward from a radially outer surface of the bead core, and, in the specified state, a radially outer end of the bead filler rubber and a radially outer end of the stiffening rubber strip both lie radially outward of a radially outer end of the rim flange of the specified rim.

An air-filled tyre comprising an internal chamber and a permeable acoustic absorber disposed within the internal chamber; wherein the acoustic absorber forms a ring-shaped member encircling the tyre in a circumferential sense and is detached from any face of the internal chamber; the absorber presents a circumferential direction of the ring and a thickness direction coinciding with a radial direction of the ring; a mean thickness T (mm) of the absorber and an internal chamber face radius R (mm), being a radial distance from the tyre spin axis to the internal chamber face along the tyre median plane, fulfil the relation 0.04 ≤ T/R ≤ 0.18; a mean circumferential extent L (mm) of the absorber, measured with the absorber detached from the tyre, and an internal chamber face circumference C (mm), being the length along the tyre circumferential direction of the internal chamber face on the tyre median plane, fulfil the relations 1.02 − 1.1 × T/R ≤ L/C ≤ 0.95 + 1.4 × T/R and L/C ≤ 1.1.

A pressure-sustaining apparatus for a vehicle tire, comprising: a storage vessel, a transfer conduit housing a sealing body, and an outflow port downstream of the sealing body; wherein the transfer conduit communicates fluidly with the storage vessel, wherein the transfer conduit communicates fluidly with the outflow port, and wherein the sealing body is fabricated from an elastomeric mixture.

A wheel-and-tyre combination incorporating a self-regulating inflation apparatus, comprising: a wheel hub featuring a rim and at least one radial arm; a tyre fitted onto the wheel hub defining an interior pneumatic cavity; the apparatus comprising: a storage vessel, a transfer conduit housing a blocking element, and an exit opening located beyond the blocking element, wherein the exit opening communicates with the interior pneumatic cavity.

A wheel-and-tyre combination incorporating a self-regulating pressure supply apparatus, comprising: a wheel hub having a flange and at least one web member; a tyre fitted onto the wheel hub so as to define an enclosed pneumatic cavity; the apparatus including: a storage vessel running around the flange in a circumferential direction, a transfer compartment housing a transfer stopper, and a discharge port located downstream of the transfer stopper, wherein the discharge port is in fluid communication with the enclosed pneumatic cavity.

An apparatus linked to an automobile, the apparatus comprising: a sensing module arranged to capture acoustic signals near a wheel's pneumatic casing; and a controller operatively connected to the sensing module, wherein the controller is adapted to: receive readings from the sensing module; determine a gradual air loss in the wheel's pneumatic casing from the readings; and transmit an alert in reaction to determining the gradual air loss.

A technique for identifying a gradual air loss in a tire mounted on an automobile, the technique comprising: receiving, by a controller of an apparatus, readings from an acoustic sensor of the apparatus, the acoustic sensor being arranged to capture audible vibrations adjacent the tire, the apparatus being linked to the automobile; determining, by the controller, a gradual air loss in the tire using the readings; and generating, by the controller, an alert in response to determining the gradual air loss.

A computer-readable memory device operating within a networked computing environment, the memory device storing program code that, upon execution by a processing circuit, directs the circuit to: receive readings from a sensing module of an apparatus, wherein the sensing module is adapted to detect acoustic energy adjacent a wheel of an automobile, and wherein the apparatus is linked to the automobile; determine a gradual air loss from the wheel using the readings; and generate an alert in reply to determining the gradual air loss.

A tamper-resistant lug nut arrangement comprising: a head member presenting a conventional wrench-engaging exterior and a bottom flange portion; a shank component including: a male-threaded section for attaching the arrangement to a matching internally threaded hub of an automobile; an inclined shoulder positioned opposite the male-threaded section and terminating in a tip, the head member masking the inclined shoulder; a recessed groove located beneath the inclined shoulder with a smaller curvature than a foot of the inclined shoulder, wherein the bottom flange portion of the head member is plastically displaced radially inward into the recessed groove via a cold-forming operation so as to retain the head member on the shank component; and a splined anti-theft recess located between the male-threaded section and the inclined shoulder and left exposed by the head member, the splined anti-theft recess receiving a matching proprietary key, wherein turning the head member leaves the male-threaded section stationary, and wherein the shank component is detachable from the internally threaded hub solely through engagement of the splined anti-theft recess with the matching proprietary key.

A technique for producing a securing member, the technique comprising: supplying a shank possessing a helical section and a retaining projection having a terminal end positioned away from the helical section, wherein a recess is machined beneath the retaining projection, and wherein a protected engagement feature is situated between the helical section and the retaining projection for mating with a matching protected driver implement; furnishing a cover possessing a conventional driving face and an inferior anchoring section; seating the cover over the shank so as to envelop the retaining projection; plastically deforming the cover through cold forming so that the inferior anchoring section is pressed into the recess, thereby holding the cover on the shank.

A wheel hoop for a two-wheeled cycle, the hoop comprising: an inner annular section situated along an interior perimeter of the hoop; a first lateral wall; a second lateral wall positioned apart from the first lateral wall, the first and second lateral walls projecting radially outward from the inner annular section; a peripheral tread-supporting section located along an exterior perimeter of the hoop, the tread-supporting section extending between the first and second lateral walls; an aperture passing through the inner annular section, the first lateral wall, the second lateral wall, the tread-supporting section, or any combination thereof, wherein at least one of those sections includes a laminated composite having one or more consolidated plies of a first composite and one or more consolidated plies of a second composite, the second composite differing from the first composite and exhibiting reduced void content relative to the first composite, the first composite including a polymeric binder and plant-derived fibers as reinforcement, and wherein the aperture traverses at least one of the consolidated plies of the second composite such that the second composite encircles the aperture.

A process for fabricating a cycle part, the process comprising: disposing a sheet of a first fiber-containing compound inside a forming cavity; placing a sheet of a second compound inside the cavity so that a segment of the second sheet contacts, overlaps, or both contacts and overlaps the first sheet, the second compound incorporating filaments of a reinforcement distinct from the first reinforcement and exhibiting reduced void content relative to the first compound; molding the cycle part by consolidating a multilayer panel comprising the first sheet and the second sheet within the cavity; and cutting an aperture through the second sheet layer of the multilayer panel such that the second compound encircles the aperture.

A wheel hoop for a cycle, the hoop comprising: an inward annular segment running along an interior perimeter of the hoop; a lateral flank; a second lateral flank set apart from the lateral flank, wherein both lateral flanks project outward in the radial direction from the inward annular segment; and an outward annular tire-receiving section situated along an exterior perimeter of the hoop, the outward section extending from the lateral flank and from the second lateral flank, respectively; a plurality of apertures passing through the inward annular segment, the apertures being spoke bores and being distributed at intervals about the inward annular segment, wherein at least the inward annular segment incorporates a layered composite, the layered composite including one or more densified layers of a first composite substance and one or more densified layers of a second composite substance, the second composite substance differing from the first composite substance and exhibiting a reduced void fraction relative to the first composite substance, wherein the densified layers of the first composite substance and of the second composite substance each are formed solely from ribbons of the respective composite substance, wherein the first composite substance comprises a polymer-based binder and plant-derived fibers serving as reinforcement, and wherein the plurality of apertures pass through at least one of the densified layers of the second composite substance, such that the second composite substance encircles the plurality of apertures.

A rotatable hub assembly, comprising: a rim member defining a set of apertures; a shroud structure having a series of perforations and a set of lattice bars partially delimiting the series of perforations; a centrifugally responsive drive mechanism configured to pivot the shroud structure relative to the rim member so as to at least partly obstruct the apertures; and a return biasing element configured to urge the shroud structure to pivot relative to the rim member so as to at least partly expose the apertures.

A device for shielding a wheel assembly, comprising: a shield carrier having a set of apertures, and a set of partition segments partly separating the apertures from one another; a rotary drive mechanism arranged to turn the shield carrier along a first angular direction under the influence of outward force produced by revolution of the drive mechanism; and a return elastic member arranged to load the shield carrier as it turns along the first angular direction, so as to turn the shield carrier along a second angular direction opposite to the first.

An automotive conveyance comprising: at least one rolling assembly including a hub element having a primary aperture and a set of secondary apertures, and a shroud structure including a central passage, a group of auxiliary passages, and multiple partition members at least partly separating the group of auxiliary passages; a drive mechanism operable to pivotally displace the shroud structure relative to the hub element under centrifugal loading so as to at least partly obstruct the set of secondary apertures; and a return resilient member arranged to urge the shroud structure to pivotally displace relative to the hub element so as to at least partly expose the set of secondary apertures.

A steerable multidirectional traction apparatus comprising: a pivot member coupled to a chassis; a rim assembly pivotable about the pivot member; a set of roller modules journaled on the rim assembly; and a conical gear disposed within the rim assembly and pivotable about the pivot member, wherein the roller modules are driven in response to a discrepancy between a rotational velocity of the rim assembly and a rotational velocity of the conical gear.

A wheel-steering actuation apparatus comprising: a pivot member coupled to a chassis structure; a rotor housing arranged to revolve about the pivot member; a plurality of secondary roller assemblies journaled on the rotor housing; a conical gear disposed within the rotor housing and arranged to revolve about the pivot member; and a plurality of transmission spindles mounted for rotation on the rotor housing and linking the conical gear to the plurality of secondary roller assemblies, wherein the plurality of transmission spindles is configured and positioned so as to be non-parallel to the conical gear.

A cycling apparatus comprising: a bicycle chassis having rear dropout terminals; and a rear wheel axle arrangement including: a rear retention member secured to the rear dropout terminals, wherein the rear retention member presents a pair of rear engagement surfaces that each carry serrated retaining ridges, the rear serrated retaining ridges having an identical contour on each of the pair of rear engagement surfaces; and a hub body including a pair of collars, wherein each of the collars includes an outboard collar surface bearing toothed hub ridges that mate with the rear serrated retaining ridges; wherein the hub body is detachably seated between the pair of rear engagement surfaces by pressing the rear serrated retaining ridges against the toothed hub ridges.

A cycle wheel coupling arrangement comprising: a rear retention device having a pair of opposed rear surfaces, each bearing rear undulating retention teeth of an identical contour; and a hub body having a pair of rims, each rim presenting an outboard rim surface provided with undulating hub teeth configured to mate with the rear undulating retention teeth; wherein the hub body is releasably seatable between the pair of opposed rear surfaces by clamping the rear undulating retention teeth into engagement with the undulating hub teeth.

A procedure for actuating a cycle drivetrain arrangement, the procedure comprising: situating a hub body between two opposing surfaces of a rear retention unit, each surface bearing rear undulating retaining ridges of identical contour; and securing the hub body to the rear retention unit by pressing the rear undulating retaining ridges against wavy engagement ridges on outboard flange surfaces, the wavy engagement ridges mating with the rear undulating retaining ridges.

A bicycle rear wheel hub arrangement comprising: a rear retention assembly including a corrugated-face spindle and a brake disc carrier casing, the corrugated-face spindle having a tubular core joined to a toothed terminal surface and the brake disc carrier casing having a toothed casing surface, wherein the toothed casing surface opposes the toothed terminal surface; a rear drum situated between the toothed casing surface and the toothed terminal surface; and a passthrough shaft extending through the tubular core of the corrugated-face spindle and a central bore of the rear drum and releasably engaged inside a middle opening of the brake disc carrier casing; wherein when the retention assembly is attached to the drum, the corrugated-face spindle, the rear drum and the passthrough shaft are all configured to turn in unison.

A rotational braking coupling apparatus comprising: a corrugated shaft terminus bearing a serrated end surface; a hub-side journal shaft; a disc carrier bushing; and a disc carrier casing defining a middle opening, a toothed casing surface, and a disc carrier interior chamber, wherein one extremity of the hub-side journal shaft oriented toward the middle opening lies within the disc carrier interior chamber, the disc carrier bushing encircles a periphery of said extremity inside the disc carrier interior chamber, and the toothed casing surface confronts the serrated end surface.

A procedure for actuating a rear sprocket-side hub arrangement of a cycle, the procedure comprising: furnishing a rear retention assembly having a undulating-profile spindle with a tubular core joined to a toothed terminal surface and a rotor carrier body presenting a toothed seating surface oriented toward the toothed terminal surface; situating a rear hub between the toothed seating surface and the toothed terminal surface; and inserting a traversing shaft through the tubular core of the undulating-profile spindle and a central passage of the rear hub, the traversing shaft being releasably engaged within a central bore of the rotor carrier body; wherein, upon the retention assembly being engaged with the hub, the undulating-profile spindle, the rear hub and the traversing shaft are all capable of co-rotation.

A cycle wheel hub apparatus comprising: a forward coupling assembly including a bearing cover on a side opposite a rotor, a race bearing, a toothed backing plate, a rotor-carrying bearing and a rotor carrier shell, the race bearing encircling a lower portion of the toothed backing plate and the rotor carrier shell presenting a toothed shell surface and an internal chamber of the rotor carrier shell, wherein the rotor-carrying bearing sits inside the internal chamber and the toothed shell surface confronts the toothed backing plate; and a forward hub seated between the toothed shell surface and the toothed backing plate; wherein upon the forward coupling assembly being attached to the forward hub, the toothed backing plate turns together with the forward hub during rotation of the forward hub.

A forward wheel-securing apparatus for a two-wheeled cycle, the apparatus comprising: a toothed plate bearing a serrated exterior; a sleeve encasing a non-drive-side bearing; a non-drive-side roller bearing encircling the toothed plate; a brake disc carrier bearing; and a brake disc carrier casing presenting a serrated casing face and an interior void of the carrier casing, wherein the brake disc carrier bearing sits inside the interior void and the serrated casing face confronts the serrated exterior.

A bicycle axle assembly for a forward wheel, the assembly comprising: a set of two end plates, each having a terminal rim and an exterior plate surface, the exterior plate surface defining a middle opening and a series of ridged grooves; and an elongated cylindrical shell having a leading shell extremity joined to the terminal rim of a first of the end plates and a trailing shell extremity joined to the terminal rim of a second of the end plates.

A procedure for actuating a front hub arrangement of a bicycle, the procedure comprising: supplying a front engagement assembly having a non-brake-side bearing enclosure, a non-brake-side bearing, a serrated plate member, a disc-carrier bearing and a disc-carrier enclosure, the non-brake-side bearing disposed about the serrated plate member and the disc-carrier enclosure defining a serrated enclosure surface and an internal recess, wherein the disc-carrier bearing sits within the internal recess and the serrated enclosure surface opposes the serrated plate member; and attaching a front hub to the front engagement assembly between the serrated enclosure surface and the serrated plate member; wherein, once the front engagement assembly is attached to the front hub, the serrated plate member turns together with the front hub during rotation of the front hub.

A cycle back wheel drivetrain arrangement incorporating a straight-attached rear changer, the arrangement comprising: a rear retention assembly having a changer fixing foundation with a pair of bracket limbs, a changer joining sleeve, a changer pivot bearing, a corrugated spindle shaft and a brake disc carrier casing, the spindle shaft having a toothed terminal face, the carrier casing having a toothed recess face, and each of the bracket limbs having a fixing bore, wherein the changer joining sleeve is seated at least partly through both of the fixing bores and the changer pivot bearing is disposed within the changer joining sleeve; and a rear hub seated between the toothed recess face and the toothed terminal face.

A rear sprocket-side locking arrangement for a direct-attach gear changer, the arrangement comprising: a changer attachment seat presenting a pair of flanking brackets, each bracket defining a fastening opening; a changer retaining sleeve extending through at least part of both fastening openings; a changer journal assembly; and a wavy-surfaced spindle shaft having a toothed terminal end, wherein the changer journal assembly is disposed inside the changer retaining sleeve.

A procedure for using a bicycle rear wheel hub arrangement that incorporates a direct-attach gear changer, the procedure comprising: furnishing a rear retention unit having a gear changer anchoring base with a duo of fastening limbs, a changer linking enclosure, a changer rotational support, a wave-profile spindle and a brake-disc carrier casing, the spindle possessing a toothed terminal surface, the carrier casing possessing a toothed casing surface, and each fastening limb possessing a fixing opening, wherein the changer rotational support is seated inside the changer linking enclosure; situating the fastening limbs on opposite sides of a rear dropout of a bicycle frame so that the fixing openings line up with an aperture in the rear dropout; and advancing the changer linking enclosure at least partly through the aperture and both of the fixing openings.

A cycling drivetrain apparatus comprising: a propulsion arrangement configured to move the cycle; and a one-way clutch assembly operatively linked to the propulsion arrangement, the one-way clutch assembly including: an enclosure defining a longitudinal rotation axis; a dual-faced toothed wheel disposed coaxially along the rotation axis inside the enclosure, the dual-faced toothed wheel presenting a first face and an opposed second face, a first group of inclined cams that converge circumferentially in a clockwise sense about the rotation axis on the first face, and a second group of inclined cams that converge circumferentially in a counter-clockwise sense about the rotation axis on the second face; a pair of single-faced pawl gears disposed coaxially along the rotation axis and sandwiching the dual-faced toothed wheel within the enclosure, each pawl gear having a ratcheting face and a smooth face, wherein a first of the pawl gears carries a first set of pawl teeth converging counter-clockwise about the rotation axis on its ratcheting face and a second of the pawl gears carries a second set of pawl teeth converging clockwise about the rotation axis on its ratcheting face; and a drive shaft extending along the rotation axis through the dual-faced toothed wheel and the pawl gears, wherein the drive shaft is fixed to one of the dual-faced toothed wheel and the pair of pawl gears and the enclosure is fixed to another of the dual-faced toothed wheel and the pair of pawl gears; wherein the first set of pawl teeth sits adjacent the first group of inclined cams and the second set of pawl teeth sits adjacent the second group of inclined cams, and further wherein, upon rotation in a first sense about the rotation axis driven by the propulsion arrangement, the first set of pawl teeth ride over the first group of inclined cams and the second set of pawl teeth ride over the second group of inclined cams so that the enclosure rotates freely relative to the drive shaft, and upon rotation in a second sense opposite the first sense, the first set of pawl teeth engage the first group of inclined cams and the second set of pawl teeth engage the second group of inclined cams so that the enclosure drives the drive shaft to rotate correspondingly in the second sense.

A freewheel clutch apparatus comprising: a casing defining a longitudinal axis; a bidirectional toothed member disposed coaxially along the longitudinal axis within the casing and presenting a first face, an opposing second face, a first plurality of inclined cams angled circumferentially in a clockwise sense about the longitudinal axis on the first face, and a second plurality of inclined cams angled circumferentially in a counterclockwise sense about the longitudinal axis on the second face; a pair of unilateral toothed members coaxially aligned with the longitudinal axis and flanking the bidirectional toothed member within the casing, each unilateral toothed member presenting an engaging surface and a disengaged surface, wherein a first of the unilateral toothed members carries a first set of teeth angled circumferentially in a counterclockwise sense about the longitudinal axis on its engaging surface and a second of the unilateral toothed members carries a second set of teeth angled circumferentially in a clockwise sense about the longitudinal axis on its engaging surface; and a drive spindle extending along the longitudinal axis through the bidirectional toothed member and the unilateral toothed members, the spindle being coupled to one of the bidirectional toothed member and the pair of unilateral toothed members, and the casing being coupled to another of the bidirectional toothed member and the pair of unilateral toothed members; wherein the first set of teeth lies adjacent the first plurality of inclined cams and the second set of teeth lies adjacent the second plurality of inclined cams, and further wherein, upon rotation in a first sense about the longitudinal axis, the first set of teeth ride over the first plurality of inclined cams and the second set of teeth ride over the second plurality of inclined cams such that the casing rotates freely relative to the spindle, and, upon rotation in a second sense opposite the first sense, the first set of teeth engage the first plurality of inclined cams and the second set of teeth engage the second plurality of inclined cams such that the casing drives the spindle to rotate correspondingly in the second sense.

A procedure for assembling a freewheel unit of a cycle, the procedure comprising: supplying a cylindrical casing defining a longitudinal axis; situating a two-faced toothed member coaxially inside the casing, the two-faced toothed member possessing a first face, an opposing second face, a first group of inclined cams that narrow in a clockwise sense about the longitudinal axis on the first face, and a second group of inclined cams that narrow in a counterclockwise sense about the longitudinal axis on the second face; arranging a pair of one-faced toothed members inside the casing so that both are coaxial with the longitudinal axis and sandwich the two-faced toothed member, each of the pair having a pawl-engaging face and a smooth face, wherein a first of the one-faced toothed members carries a first array of teeth that narrow in a counterclockwise sense about the longitudinal axis on its pawl-engaging face and a second of the one-faced toothed members carries a second array of teeth that narrow in a clockwise sense about the longitudinal axis on its pawl-engaging face; threading a spindle along the longitudinal axis through the two-faced toothed member and the one-faced toothed members; and joining the spindle to one of the two-faced toothed member and the pair of one-faced toothed members while joining the casing to another of the two-faced toothed member and the pair of one-faced toothed members; wherein the first array of teeth is disposed adjacent the first group of inclined cams and the second array of teeth is disposed adjacent the second group of inclined cams, and further wherein, upon rotation in a first sense about the longitudinal axis, the first array of teeth slides past the first group of inclined cams and the second array of teeth slides past the second group of inclined cams such that the casing turns freely relative to the spindle, and, upon rotation in a second sense opposite the first sense, the first array of teeth engages the first group of inclined cams and the second array of teeth engages the second group of inclined cams such that the casing drives the spindle to turn correspondingly in the second sense.

A motor car presenting a leading extremity and a trailing extremity, the motor car comprising: a propulsion unit operable to supply drive force to the motor car; a driveshaft rotatable under torque received from the propulsion unit; a drivetrain enclosure surrounding the driveshaft; a braking rotor situated within the drivetrain enclosure, joined to the driveshaft, and arranged to turn as the driveshaft turns; a fluid conduit running from an intake port coaxially aligned with the braking rotor to an discharge port formed in the drivetrain enclosure; and a thermal transfer device positioned along the fluid conduit to transfer heat between the fluid within the fluid conduit and a coolant flowing through the thermal transfer device.

A drive-train unit that accepts torque from a prime mover aboard a motor vehicle, the unit comprising: a half-shaft mounted for turning motion; a casing enclosing the half-shaft; a friction rotor situated inside the casing, joined to the half-shaft, and arranged to spin along with the half-shaft; a fluid conduit running from an intake port positioned in line with the friction rotor to an discharge port formed through the casing; and a thermal transfer unit placed within the fluid conduit so as to move heat between oil flowing through the conduit and a cooling medium passed through the thermal transfer unit.

A technique for regulating the thermal state of a fluid within a drive-axle enclosure of a motor vehicle driven by a prime mover, the technique comprising: propelling the fluid radially outwardly within the enclosure toward a fluid conduit entrance by spinning a friction rotor that is linked to a half-shaft and turns together with it; conveying the fluid from the conduit entrance to a fluid conduit exit formed in the enclosure; and passing the fluid through a thermal transfer unit arranged along the fluid conduit so as to adjust its temperature by transferring heat between the fluid and a cooling medium flowing within the thermal transfer unit.

A hub unit for a road vehicle wheel, comprising: a hub body secured to a vehicle wheel, the hub body presenting a brake disc seating face oriented toward an interior side of the vehicle; a brake rotor whose attachment face abuts the brake disc seating face, the attachment face being directed toward an exterior side of the vehicle; and a roller bearing seated within the hub body, wherein the hub body comprises a tubular section and a rim projecting radially outward from the tubular section and extending continuously around a circumference, the rim having a face directed toward the exterior side, and wherein the brake disc seating face is finished by machining after the roller bearing is installed within the hub body and retained thereto by a circlip, such that the eccentricity of the brake disc seating face is no greater than 30 micrometers (μm).

A process for manufacturing a hub-and-bearing unit, the process comprising: mounting a rolling bearing within a hub body that includes a collar presenting a collar face directed toward an outer side; securing the rolling bearing to the hub body via a retaining ring; cutting a brake-engaging seat of the hub body, facing an inner side, so that its axial deviation is no more than 30 micrometers (μm); and seating a friction plate of a disc brake onto the brake-engaging seat, with the friction plate's contact face directed toward the outer side.

A drive hub unit comprising: a main casing; a half-shaft carrier secured to the main casing by a set of initial bolts; and a lubricant guard attached to the main casing through at least one securing member positioned concentrically with at least one bolt of the set of initial bolts and with at least one aperture among a group of previously formed apertures of the main casing.

A drive axle apparatus comprising: a core casing; a halfshaft housing secured to the core casing by a set of primary threaded connectors; and a lubricant guard affixed to the core casing by a retention arrangement that is aligned along a common axis with at least one of the primary threaded connectors and with at least one aperture from a group of previously formed apertures of the core casing, the retention arrangement including a secondary threaded connector and a bushing disposed circumferentially about the secondary threaded connector, wherein the secondary threaded connector is a screw-style member or a bolt-style member.

An axle assembly, comprising: a main body; an arm member secured to the main body by a set of first connectors; and a lubricant guard affixed to the main body by a retaining arrangement that is aligned on a common axis with at least one connector of the set of first connectors and at least one aperture among a plurality of already-formed apertures of the main body, wherein the retaining arrangement includes a retention component that is a second connector having a snap-engagement design with a snap-engagement member, and the second connector is either formed as one piece with or physically joined to the guard.

A drive-axle hub carrier, comprising: a shell having a tubular segment spanning a tubular length, the tubular segment terminating in a discharge opening at a proximal end, and a mounting collar having a flat bearing surface at a distal end opposite the proximal end; and reinforcing ribs disposed within a hollow cavity of the shell and projecting across at least a leading part of a collar length of the mounting collar, a collar-to-tube junction where the mounting collar merges into the tubular segment, and at least a segment of the tubular length.

An electric vehicle drivetrain unit, comprising: a motor assembly; a left lateral support member; and a right lateral support member, wherein at least one of the left lateral support member and the right lateral support member includes a shell having a tubular segment extending over a span, a coupling collar with a level abutment surface at a terminal end of the span, and reinforcing ribs disposed within an inner cavity of the shell, where the left lateral support member and the right lateral support member are each arranged to attach to the motor assembly through a corresponding collar.

A vehicle drive-axle casing, comprising: a limb portion having a span of a given length; a mounting collar having a level abutment surface at one terminus of a collar span, the collar being joined to the limb portion at a collar-to-limb juncture; reinforcing ribs disposed within a hollow of the collar and the limb portion, the reinforcing ribs extending along at least a segment of the span of the limb portion and along at least a first segment of the collar span; outer reinforcing ribs disposed on an outside surface of the collar, the outer reinforcing ribs extending along at least a second segment of the collar span; a first pair of pivot locations at the level abutment surface of the collar; and a second pair of pivot locations at the collar-to-limb juncture, wherein: the first pair of pivot locations and the second pair of pivot locations both remain rigid when the limb portion deflects in a first, downward direction owing to, in an upper half of the casing, the inner reinforcing ribs being under compression and the outer reinforcing ribs being under tension, and in a lower half of the casing the inner reinforcing ribs being under tension and the outer reinforcing ribs being under compression; and the first pair of pivot locations and the second pair of pivot locations both remain rigid when the limb portion deflects in a second, upward direction owing to, in the upper half of the casing, the inner reinforcing ribs being under tension and the outer reinforcing ribs being under compression, and in the lower half of the casing, the inner reinforcing ribs being under compression and the outer reinforcing ribs being under tension.

A tyre condition assessment arrangement comprising: an input module adapted to obtain wear-influencing data pertaining to a airless wheel fitted to an automobile; a primary evaluation module adapted to ascertain, on the basis of the wear-influencing data, at least one of: whether an early indication of a defect exists in the airless wheel; and whether the defect is present in the airless wheel; and a reporting module adapted to transmit a first evaluation outcome of the primary evaluation module to a designated recipient.

A tire condition assessment device comprising: an input unit configured to obtain wear-influencing data bearing on degradation of a airless wheel fitted to a motor vehicle; a evaluation unit configured to derive from the wear-influencing data at least one of: whether an early indication of a defect exists in the airless wheel; and whether a defect is currently present in the airless wheel; and a reporting unit configured to transmit an evaluation result of the evaluation unit to a designated recipient.

A method for assessing a tire condition, wherein one or more processors carry out: obtaining degradation-linked data capable of affecting wear of a airless tire fitted to a motor vehicle; deriving, from the degradation-linked data, at least one of: an indication that a defect is forming in the airless tire; and an existence of a defect in the airless tire; and transmitting a first assessment outcome from the deriving to a designated recipient destination.

A computer-readable storage medium storing instructions that, when executed by one or more processors, carry out: obtaining wear-affecting data relevant to degradation of a airless tire fitted to a motor vehicle; evaluating, using the wear-affecting data, at least one of: whether an incipient defect is indicated in the airless tire; and whether a defect is present in the airless tire; and transmitting a result of the evaluating to a designated recipient.

query_text: A pneumatic covering for a light-duty automobile, designed to be seated upon a wheel flange and capable of receiving at least one lateral panel attachment, the covering having a cross-sectional profile of height H and including: a pair of flanks joining a tread region to two bead regions, each bead region being designed to bear against the wheel flange; at least one flank provided with a retention feature designed to engage the at least one lateral panel attachment, the retention feature extending around the covering in a circumferential direction and comprising a cavity formed within an outermost flank layer containing at least one elastomeric compound, the cavity extending from an outer lateral flank surface inwardly toward the interior of the flank, the cavity being bounded axially inward by a cavity floor and radially by two cavity sidewalls, the cavity having, in any meridional plane containing the rotational axis of the covering, a depth Pc, being the greatest perpendicular distance between the outer lateral flank surface and the cavity floor, that is at least 2 mm, and an opening width Lc, measured at the outer lateral flank surface between the two cavity sidewalls, that is at most 15% of the cross-sectional height H; wherein the retention feature includes a boss standing proud of the cavity floor and extending from the cavity floor to a location adjacent the outer lateral flank surface, and wherein the boss is formed, in any meridional plane, by a stepped configuration of a narrow leading segment extending outwardly in the axial direction from the cavity floor and presenting a minimum width Lpmin, and a broad trailing segment extending outwardly in the axial direction from the narrow leading segment and presenting a maximum width Lpmax, such that the difference Lpmax minus Lpmin is at least 1 mm and at most 4 mm.

A tyre assembly, comprising: a tread section running around the circumference of the tyre in an annular configuration; a pair of flanks positioned on opposite sides of the tread section; and a pair of beads situated radially inward of the flanks; the tyre incorporating a responder enclosed within a sheath; a 50% strain secant modulus of the sheath measured at 0° C. lying between 0.5 MPa and 2.0 MPa; and a 50% strain secant modulus of the sheath measured at −20° C. divided by the 50% strain secant modulus measured at 0° C. being greater than 1.0 yet not exceeding 2.5.

A tyre, comprising: a crown section extending circumferentially in an annular configuration; a pair of flank sections positioned on opposite lateral sides of the crown section; and a pair of bead sections located radially inward of the flank sections; the tyre incorporating a responder enclosed by a coating layer; a secant modulus M50 (20° C.) at 50% strain at 20° C. of the coating layer lying between 0.4 MPa and 1.5 MPa; and the secant modulus M50 (20° C.) of the coating layer and a secant modulus M50 (100° C.) at 50% strain at 100° C. of the coating layer fulfilling the condition 1.0<M50 (20° C.)/M50 (100° C.)≤2.5.

A tire-mounted pressure monitoring transmitter for commercial vehicles, comprising: a coiled loop radiator and a type 1225 button battery, the transmitter being affixed to an exterior surface of a wheel tyre; wherein energy draw is lowered by raising a data link speed, and/or lengthening the interval between readings, and/or reducing the quantity of packets sent per transmission, and/or lowering the radio emission level, and/or placing a low-noise amplifier stage at an input of a companion receiving antenna.

A transportable all-terrain conveyance comprising: a chassis structure; a set of rotating ground-engaging members coupled to the chassis structure; a motive unit mounted on the chassis structure and operable to drive at least one of the ground-engaging members so as to propel the chassis structure across a ground surface; a directional control mechanism coupled to the chassis structure and to at least one of the ground-engaging members, the directional control mechanism enabling an operator to steer the chassis structure; a hitch receiver affixed to the chassis structure; and a raisable drawbar having a chassis-coupling section extending from a first drawbar end and configured for detachable connection to the hitch receiver, an upright section extending lengthwise from the chassis-coupling section, and a hauling-vehicle section extending from a second upright end and configured for detachable connection to a pulling vehicle; wherein, when the raisable drawbar is installed in a towing arrangement by connection to the hitch receiver, the hauling-vehicle section is situated at a greater first height above the ground surface supporting the conveyance than a lesser second height at which the chassis-coupling section is spaced from that ground surface.

A hitch-receiver extension apparatus, comprising: a shaft portion adapted to be received within a towing receptacle of an automobile; a pivoting pressing element, journaled upon the shaft portion, the pivoting pressing element being selectively positionable in an engaged configuration in which it bears against an interior surface of the towing receptacle and a disengaged configuration in which it is withdrawn from the interior surface of the towing receptacle; and an actuating mechanism, mounted to the shaft portion, in communication with the pivoting pressing element, and operable to rotate the pivoting pressing element and to maintain the pivoting pressing element in the engaged configuration; and wherein the actuating mechanism is coupled to the pivoting pressing element.

A hubcap assembly adapted for attachment to a road wheel of an automobile having a tread-bearing tire and a body panel encircling a wheelhouse, the hubcap assembly comprising: a journal mount configured to affix to the road wheel, a segment of the journal mount being arranged to spin independently of the road wheel during forward or reverse travel of the automobile; a shroud attachable to the journal mount, the shroud comprising: a leading section arranged to overlay a first area of the tread-bearing tire when the hubcap assembly is mounted for service; a trailing section arranged to overlay a second area of the tread-bearing tire when the hubcap assembly is mounted for service, the trailing section comprising: a primary zone configured to abut a first area of the body panel upon the automobile executing a turn in a first sense; and a secondary zone configured to abut a second area of the body panel upon the automobile executing a turn in a second sense, the secondary zone being configured to deform elastically when abutting the second area of the body panel during a turn in the second sense.

A hubcap arrangement adapted to attach to a road wheel of an automobile having a tread-bearing tyre and a guard panel encircling a wheel recess, the arrangement comprising: a shield attachable to the road wheel so as to remain non-rotating relative to the spinning of the road wheel during forward or reverse travel, the shield including: a leading segment positioned to overlie a first section of the tyre when the arrangement is mounted; a trailing segment positioned to overlie a second section of the tyre when the arrangement is mounted, the trailing segment including: an elevated zone arranged to abut an upper region of the guard panel when the automobile steers in a first sense; and a rear zone arranged to abut a rearward region of the guard panel when the automobile steers in a second sense, the rear zone being configured to bend upon abutting the guard panel when the automobile steers in the second sense.

A road-wheel arrangement configured for mounting onto a axle hub of an automotive vehicle, the arrangement comprising: a hub-attachable core rim; an encircling peripheral rim disposed about the core rim; a series of pneumatic-type resilient struts operably interposed between the core rim and the peripheral rim and enabling displacement therebetween; a non-deformable outboard shroud disc secured to an outboard face of the peripheral rim and projecting radially inwardly toward the core rim; a set of threaded retainers securing the non-deformable outboard shroud disc to the outboard face of the peripheral rim, each retainer including a screw-driven head and a threaded stem projecting therefrom; and a compliant outboard gasket interposed between the non-deformable outboard shroud disc and the core rim.

An apparatus for mounting upon a vehicle axle assembly, the apparatus comprising: a central band configured to attach to the axle assembly; an peripheral band encircling the central band; at least one tire mounted about the peripheral band; a series of pneumatic struts coupled between the central band and the peripheral band and enabling displacement therebetween; a stiff inboard shroud secured to an inner face of the peripheral band and projecting radially toward the central band; a set of threaded bolts securing the stiff inboard shroud to the inner face of the peripheral band, each bolt including a threaded head and an elongated threaded stem extending therefrom; and a pliable inboard accordion gasket connected between the stiff inboard shroud and the central band.

A technique for fabricating a rolling assembly adapted to attach to a vehicle axle flange, the technique comprising: joining a set of pneumatic struts between a central hub-engaging band and a peripheral annular band encircling the central band so as to allow shifting motion between them; securing a stiff lateral shroud plate to an interior-facing lateral edge of the peripheral band and directing it radially inward toward the central band; attaching the stiff lateral shroud plate to the interior-facing lateral edge of the peripheral band using a plurality of bolts, each bolt having a female-threaded head and a male-threaded stem projecting therefrom; and fitting a pliable interior-side gasket between the stiff lateral shroud plate and the central band.

A manipulation apparatus for accepting a control command concerning lateral shifting and/or rotation around an upright axis of a locomotive device, from an individual steering that device, the manipulation apparatus comprising: at least three support members projecting upwardly from a chassis; a control member coupled to each of the support members and designed to accept a control command from the individual; and at least one shift detector designed to measure a horizontal shift quantity of the control member, wherein, when viewed from above, each of the support members sits at a location offset from a line joining a chosen pair of the remaining support members.

An in-wheel drive apparatus for an electric conveyance, comprising: a primary braking rotor, a drive unit housing, securing fasteners, and a secondary braking rotor; wherein a hub flange is affixed to an exterior face of the drive unit housing, a top cover is affixed to an upper extremity of the hub flange, and a bottom cover is affixed to a lower extremity of the hub flange; the top cover, the hub flange, and the bottom cover each include a substrate, a first stiffening ply is affixed to an exterior face of the substrate, and a second stiffening ply is affixed to an exterior face of the first stiffening ply.

A locomotive apparatus comprising: a chassis and rolling members mounted beneath the chassis to propel the apparatus across a surface, each of the rolling members including a hub and a ring-shaped covering, wherein the covering is releasably coupled to the hub and includes a leading segment and a trailing segment, the leading segment and the trailing segment being releasably joined such that the leading segment and the trailing segment can be uncoupled to permit the covering to be removed from the hub.

A hub-mounted bearing carrier for a vehicle wheel end and drive axle arrangement, comprising: an interior cavity; a conduit extending from an outboard face of the carrier into the cavity; a first aperture establishing flow communication between the conduit and the cavity; and a second aperture establishing flow communication between the conduit and an exterior of the outboard face; wherein the carrier retains a rolling element bearing within the cavity, and grease is delivered to the cavity and the rolling element bearing through the conduit while the carrier stays installed and secured to other drivetrain components of a motor vehicle.

A hub unit for a wheel bearing arrangement, the hub unit comprising: a recess formed within the hub body; a conduit extending from an outboard face of the hub body to the recess; a first aperture establishing communication between the conduit and the recess; and a second aperture establishing communication between the conduit and an exterior face of the outboard face; wherein the hub body fixedly attaches to a rim presenting an inboard side nearest the hub body, wherein the hub body retains a rolling element via the recess, and grease is supplied to the recess and the rolling element through the conduit while the hub body stays installed and mechanically joined to other parts of an automobile.

A hub support member for a wheel bearing arrangement and a drive axle arrangement, comprising: a receptacle portion, the receptacle portion including a seat and an aperture; a fastening portion; a recess, the fastening portion is disposed about the recess and the recess is fluidically continuous with the aperture; a first conduit, the fastening portion including the first conduit; a second conduit, the receptacle portion includes the second conduit; a passageway, the passageway extending from the first conduit to the second conduit and establishing fluid communication between the first conduit and the second conduit; and a rolling element is retained by the receptacle portion through the aperture, wherein grease is delivered to the rolling element via the first conduit, the second conduit, and the passageway while the hub support member remains installed and mechanically joined to one or more other components of a motor vehicle.

A tyre lacking inflation, comprising: a ring-shaped running surface component; an annular reinforcing band bearing the running surface component; a central mounting member; and a load-transmitting framework holding the reinforcing band upon the central mounting member, wherein the reinforcing band and the load-transmitting framework are engaged with one another through mechanical interlocking.

An airless wheel for a vehicle, the wheel including: a peripheral ground-contacting band bearing a tread layer; a ring-shaped load-transmitting belt holding the band; a central mounting member; and a framework joining the belt to the mounting member, wherein a textile sheet runs along an inward-facing side of the belt and an outward-facing side of the framework.

A process for fabricating a non-pneumatic wheel, the process comprising: furnishing a textile sheet having an upper face and a lower face situated opposite the upper face, the upper face bearing a multitude of projections; depositing a molten thermoplastic material over the upper face to produce a section of a load-bearing framework, the projections extending into the thermoplastic material; furnishing a reinforced band; and bonding the reinforced band to the lower face of the textile sheet.

A pneumatic vehicle covering for a passenger car, the covering including a tread member designed to engage a roadway during rotation through a tread face, the tread member having: primary peripheral grooves of a penetration depth at least half of a pattern relief height, the primary peripheral grooves including first and second outermost primary peripheral grooves positioned on opposite sides of a central equatorial plane, the first and second outermost primary peripheral grooves being the farthest-lying primary peripheral grooves of the tread member; a broad outboard section having, at the floor, a breadth between 0.7 mm and 5.0 mm, in fluid communication with the slender inboard section and disposed axially outward thereof, the broad outboard section being the axially outermost segment of the composite transverse incision within the at least one lateral zone; wherein each composite transverse incision terminates in a floor that lies entirely radially outward of a boundary between the cap ply stratum and the carcass-side underlayer, and wherein at least a portion of the floor of the slender inboard section is positioned at a radial spacing from the boundary that exceeds the radial spacing at which at least a portion of the floor of the broad outboard section is positioned.

A heavy-load pneumatic tyre, comprising: a pair of bead cores; a casing ply extending across and between the pair of bead cores; a reinforcing band disposed radially outside the casing ply and formed from a multitude of parallel reinforcement filaments; a pair of flank portions each disposed axially outside the casing ply; a pair of abrasion guards each disposed radially inside one of the flank portions and adapted to contact a wheel rim; and a transponder carrier incorporating an radio-frequency identification transponder, wherein each bead comprises a bead core and a filler element positioned radially outside the bead core, the casing ply comprises a main ply section extending between the pair of bead cores and a pair of folded-back sections each joined to the main ply section and folded around a bead, the reinforcing band comprises three or fewer belt layers stacked in a radial direction, the wheel rim is a standard rim, a condition in which the tyre is mounted on the standard rim and inflated to a standard inflation pressure is a nominal condition, a condition in which a load equal to 50% of a nominal load is applied to the tyre in the nominal condition and the tyre is pressed against a level surface is a reference ground-contact condition, and in the reference ground-contact condition, the transponder is located between an axially outermost end of the wheel rim and a maximum-width location of the tyre in an axial direction, and is located between a radially outermost end of the wheel rim and the maximum-width location of the tyre in a radial direction.
