A wheel-end assembly, comprising: a bearing unit rotationally holding a road wheel; a knuckle component carrying the bearing unit; a detector arranged to sense the spinning condition of the road wheel; a seal member arranged to block contaminants from reaching the interior of the bearing unit; and a shield arranged to protect the detector from contaminants, wherein the shield is affixed to the seal member.

A wheel bearing arrangement, comprising: a bearing unit configured to rotatably carry a road wheel; a knuckle that holds the bearing unit; a detector that senses a revolving condition of the road wheel; and a fitting component installed onto the bearing unit, the knuckle, or both the bearing unit and the knuckle, wherein the fitting component includes an enlarged outward projection that works together with the knuckle to block debris from reaching the detector.

A wheel-end mounting apparatus for a motor vehicle, comprising: a bearing assembly that rotationally carries a road wheel; a knuckle structure that holds the bearing assembly; a detector that senses the spinning condition of the road wheel; and a closure that blocks debris from reaching the bearing assembly and into which a shield component, including at least a portion of a baffle that segregates the detector from the debris, is unitarily incorporated.

A wheel hub apparatus for a pedal-driven cycle, the apparatus comprising: a spindle defining a rotational axis along which a longitudinal direction and a peripheral direction are established; a drum housing journaled on the spindle for rotation about the rotational axis, the drum housing having at least one first protrusion with a leading axial edge and a trailing axial edge opposite the leading axial edge; a cog carrier journaled on the spindle for rotation about the rotational axis, the cog carrier having a first key groove; a first pawl element including: at least one first detent; and a second key groove engageable with the first key groove; a second pawl element including: at least one second detent engageable with the at least one first detent; and at least one second protrusion engageable with the at least one first protrusion; a separator including: at least one base plate extending in the peripheral direction; and at least one longitudinal tab extending from the at least one base plate in the longitudinal direction, the at least one longitudinal tab being positioned at least partly between the at least one first protrusion and the at least one second protrusion in the peripheral direction; the leading axial edge of the at least one first protrusion lying nearer a median axial plane of the apparatus than the trailing axial edge of the at least one first protrusion; and the at least one base plate of the separator being situated nearer the leading axial edge of the at least one first protrusion than the trailing axial edge of the at least one first protrusion.

A cycle hub unit for a bicycle, the unit comprising: a central shaft defining a rotational axis extending lengthwise and a transverse dimension perpendicular thereto; an outer drum journaled about the central shaft for free rotation, the outer drum bearing at least one first projection; a cog carrier journaled about the central shaft for rotation therewith, the cog carrier featuring a first key-groove arrangement; a first engagement piece including: at least one first pawl tooth; and a second key-groove arrangement mating with the first key-groove arrangement; a second engagement piece including: at least one second pawl tooth meshing with the at least one first pawl tooth; and at least one second projection meshing with the at least one first projection; a resilient element positioned between the outer drum and the first engagement piece along the rotational axis to urge the first engagement piece toward the second engagement piece along the rotational axis; a seat element situated between the first engagement piece and the resilient element along the rotational axis; the first engagement piece having a lateral stop lug protruding transversely outward; and the lateral stop lug of the first engagement piece operating to block the seat element from shifting toward a midplane of the cycle hub unit when the cycle hub unit is fully assembled.

An apparatus for a bicycle-type conveyance, the apparatus comprising: a spindle defining a rotational axis that establishes a longitudinal orientation; a outer drum supported on the spindle for rotation about the rotational axis, the outer drum having at least one first protrusion; a driven gear carrier supported on the spindle for rotation about the rotational axis; and a sealing element including: a mounting section configured to be secured to one of the outer drum and the driven gear carrier; a wiping section extending along a first course so as to slidably contact the driven gear carrier; and a bifurcated section extending along a second course differing from the first course so that a lubricant retention chamber is defined between the wiping section and the bifurcated section.

A cycle hub arrangement for a pedal-driven conveyance, the arrangement comprising: a spindle defining a rotational axis that establishes an axial orientation, a radial orientation and a peripheral orientation; a drum body journalled about the spindle for rotation around the rotational axis; a cog carrier journalled about the spindle for rotation around the rotational axis, the cog carrier being arranged to carry at least one chainwheel; a first rotary support situated between the spindle and the drum body in the radial orientation; a second rotary support situated between the spindle and the cog carrier in the radial orientation; a bushing fitted onto the spindle and extending in the axial orientation, the bushing being engageable with the spindle in the radial orientation; the first rotary support including: a first inner ring secured to the spindle; a first outer ring secured to the drum body; and at least two first rollers located between the first inner ring and the first outer ring in the radial orientation; the second rotary support including: a second inner ring secured to the spindle; a second outer ring secured to the cog carrier; and at least two second rollers located between the second inner ring and the second outer ring in the radial orientation; and the bushing including: a first seating section bearing against the first inner ring; and a second seating section bearing against the second inner ring in the radial orientation.

A cycle hub apparatus for a pedal-driven conveyance, the apparatus comprising: a spindle member defining a central rotational axis that establishes an axial orientation, a radial orientation, and a peripheral orientation; a drum housing journaled about the spindle member so as to pivot around the central rotational axis; a cog carrier journaled about the spindle member so as to pivot around the central rotational axis, the cog carrier being adapted to carry at least one gear wheel; an outboard rolling assembly interposed between the spindle member and the cog carrier along the radial orientation; an inboard rolling assembly interposed between the spindle member and the cog carrier along the radial orientation, the inboard rolling assembly lying nearer a midplane of the apparatus along the axial orientation than the outboard rolling assembly; a bushing seated on the spindle member and extending along the axial orientation, the bushing being engageable with the spindle member along the radial orientation; the outboard rolling assembly including: an outboard fixed ring coupled to the spindle member; an outboard rotating ring coupled to the cog carrier; and at least two outboard rollers positioned between the outboard fixed ring and the outboard rotating ring along the radial orientation; the inboard rolling assembly including: an inboard fixed ring coupled to the spindle member; an inboard rotating ring coupled to the cog carrier; and at least two inboard rollers positioned between the inboard fixed ring and the inboard rotating ring along the radial orientation; the bushing including: an axial bearing face engaging the outboard fixed ring along the axial orientation; and a radial bearing face engaging the inboard fixed ring along the radial orientation; and the bushing being unconstrained against radial engagement with the outboard fixed ring relative to the central rotational axis.

A bicycle hub arrangement for a pedal-driven cycle, the arrangement comprising: a spindle defining a rotation axis that establishes an axial orientation, a radial orientation and a peripheral orientation; a drum housing journaled on the spindle for rotation about the rotation axis; a cog carrier journaled on the spindle for rotation about the rotation axis, the cog carrier being arranged to carry at least one chainwheel; an outboard rolling assembly interposed between the spindle and the cog carrier in the radial orientation; an inboard rolling assembly interposed between the spindle and the cog carrier in the radial orientation, the inboard rolling assembly being situated nearer a median transverse plane of the arrangement along the axial orientation than the outboard rolling assembly; a bushing fitted onto the spindle and extending along the axial orientation, the bushing being engageable with the spindle in the radial orientation; the outboard rolling assembly including: an outboard fixed ring secured to the spindle; an outboard rotating ring secured to the cog carrier; and at least two outboard balls located between the outboard fixed ring and the outboard rotating ring in the radial orientation, and the inboard rolling assembly including: an inboard fixed ring secured to the spindle; an inboard rotating ring secured to the cog carrier; and at least two inboard balls located between the inboard fixed ring and the inboard rotating ring in the radial orientation; the bushing including: an axial bearing shoulder bearing against the outboard fixed ring in the axial orientation; and a radial bearing collar bearing against the inboard fixed ring in the radial orientation; and the bushing being devoid of axial contact with the inboard fixed ring relative to the rotation axis.

A process of producing a gauge wheel tire, the process comprising: fabricating a first elastomeric member; fabricating a second elastomeric member; and sliding the first elastomeric member against the second elastomeric member to produce frictional heat that softens abutting surfaces of both members, thereby uniting them into a unitary structure wherein a load-bearing hub section is separated from a contact-tread section by a clearance permitting radial displacement of the contact-tread section with respect to the load-bearing hub section.

A rolling measurement wheel covering, comprising: a first resilient body; and a second resilient body bonded to the first resilient body to define a unit that includes at least (A) a contact section configured to engage a terrain surface as the covering revolves around a spin axis, and (B) a bearing section separated from the contact section by a clearance enabling radial displacement of the contact section with respect to the bearing section, wherein: the bearing section includes at least one ridge that projects radially outward into the clearance to restrict the contact section from traveling radially inward past a level of the at least one ridge; and a first junction is present at a first site where the first resilient body and the second resilient body are fused or adhered together.

A system for predicting a remaining tread thickness of a tire mounted on an automobile, comprising: a sensing apparatus adapted to take a first thickness reading and a second thickness reading of the tread, both readings corresponding to a single operator; a computing module adapted to obtain the first and second thickness readings, the computing module incorporating a calculation routine that derives an erosion speed from at least the two thickness readings and a set of operator-specific parameters, the computing module being further adapted, using the erosion speed, to estimate a moment at which the tread thickness is expected to drop beneath a predefined limit; and a portable terminal assigned to the operator, the portable terminal being structured to receive a notification from the computing module stating the expected moment at which the tread thickness will fall under the predefined limit.

A technique for predicting the remaining thickness of a tread on an automobile wheel covering, comprising: taking an initial thickness reading of the tread; taking a subsequent thickness reading of the tread; linking the initial and subsequent thickness readings to a single purchaser; transmitting the initial and subsequent thickness readings to a computing module, wherein the computing module contains a calculation routine that derives a degradation speed from at least the initial thickness reading, the subsequent thickness reading, and a set of attributes of the purchaser; projecting, using the degradation speed, a moment at which the tread thickness will fall beneath a set limit; and notifying the purchaser of a prediction of when the tread thickness is expected to drop below the set limit.

A tyre, comprising: a pair of bead portions each incorporating a bead core; a pair of side wall portions extending radially outward from the respective bead portions; and a crown region positioned between the side wall portions, wherein each side wall portion carries an indicia zone having a projecting portion that extends axially outward beyond a contour line of the side wall in a meridional sectional view, the indicia zone including: a covering elastomer, and a tinted elastomer whose surface is partly overlaid by the covering elastomer while another part thereof remains uncovered, the indicia zone further defining a depression in the meridional sectional view, and a floor of the depression lying axially outboard of the contour line of the side wall.

A traction element adapted for mounting on a rotatable wheel, the traction element comprising: a plate-like member extending along a longitudinal axis from a leading extremity to a trailing extremity and along a transverse axis, orthogonal to the longitudinal axis, from a left margin to a right margin, the member presenting an outwardly bulging face and an inwardly recessed face, the inwardly recessed face exhibiting a first arc along the longitudinal axis between the leading and trailing extremities and a second arc along the transverse axis between the left and right margins, the second arc possessing a sharper bend than the first arc; and at least one fin projecting from the outwardly bulging face, the at least one fin including a proximal root secured to the outwardly bulging face and a distal crest spaced apart from the member, the fin having a forward edge and a rearward edge joined between the crest and the root, and a first side surface and an opposed second side surface extending between the crest and the root as well as between the forward and rearward edges; wherein a least dimension of the fin measured between the forward and rearward edges along the longitudinal axis exceeds a greatest thickness of the fin measured between the first and second side surfaces along the transverse axis.

A traction assembly comprising: a rotatable hub having an outer perimeter encircling a pneumatic tread and wheel rim, together with a set of radial members; and a set of ground-engaging inserts, each insert comprising: a support plate extending along a fore-aft axis from a leading extremity to a trailing extremity and along a transverse axis orthogonal to the fore-aft axis from a left margin to a right margin, the support plate presenting an outward-facing bulged face and an opposed inward-facing hollowed face, the hollowed face describing a fore-aft arc between the leading and trailing extremities and a transverse arc between the left and right margins, the transverse arc possessing a greater curvature magnitude than the fore-aft arc; and at least one fin having a root fixed to the bulged face of the support plate and a free rim spaced apart from the support plate, the fin possessing a leading edge and a trailing edge extending between the free rim and the root, and a first flank and an opposing second flank extending between the free rim and the root and also between the leading and trailing edges; wherein a least extent of the fin measured from the leading edge to the trailing edge along the fore-aft axis exceeds a greatest thickness of the fin measured from the first flank to the second flank along the transverse axis.

An apparatus for lasso training, comprising: a motorized carrier including a control unit that governs its powered state according to a condition of a actuator; a target body attached to the carrier by a coupling assembly; and wherein the coupling assembly is arranged to trigger the actuator.

An apparatus for lasso training, comprising: a motorized conveyance including a regulator arranged to govern its operational state according to a condition of a toggle, and a coupling assembly including: a coupler housing with an accepting element defining a bored cylinder; a toggle holder insertable into the bored cylinder and arranged to retain the toggle; a linkage mechanism including a primary piece that glides within the bored cylinder, the primary piece having a forward extremity adjacent the toggle holder, a clearance separating a rear extremity of the primary piece from a terminal bracket, a resilient element passing through the terminal bracket and the primary piece to urge the primary piece toward a first heading, a threaded fastener passing through the terminal bracket, the resilient element, the primary piece, the toggle holder, and the accepting element; a secondary piece projecting downward from the primary piece and traversing a passage, the secondary piece including a sphere seat bracket; and a mannequin including a drawbar configured to attach to the coupling assembly through a sphere joined to the sphere seat bracket; wherein a rearward load imposed on the mannequin compresses the resilient element and permits the primary and secondary pieces to translate rearward relative to the coupler housing, thereby releasing the secondary piece from the toggle, whereby the conveyance halts upon release of the toggle.

A technique for employing a lasso training apparatus, the technique comprising: attaching a mannequin target to a self-propelled cart; engaging a propulsion unit of the cart so that the cart travels unattended by any driver; casting a loop at and capturing the mannequin target; wherein the capture applies a backward pull on the mannequin target relative to the cart; and wherein that backward pull engages a sensor that instructs the cart to halt its travel.

A cycle rear-wheel hub assembly comprising: an axle; a casing encircling the axle and possessing a near terminus and a far terminus; a torque transmitter encircling the axle, positioned at the near terminus of the casing, possessing an exterior extremity protruding beyond the casing and an interior extremity reaching within the casing; a linkage member positioned at the far terminus of the casing; a coupling sleeve encircling the axle, slidable along the axle, positioned within the casing, possessing a release portion extending away from the torque transmitter and a retarding portion adjacent the torque transmitter, encircling and threadably joined to the interior extremity of the torque transmitter, and possessing an outside diameter greater than an outside diameter of the release portion; a retarding base affixed to and encircling the axle, extending into the far terminus of the casing, and situated between the linkage member and the coupling sleeve; a biasing arrangement interposed between the retarding base and the coupling sleeve; at least one friction shoe interposed between an inner circumferential wall of the casing and outer peripheries of the coupling sleeve and the retarding base; and a chainwheel joined to the exterior extremity of the torque transmitter, the chainwheel being chosen from a group consisting of a retarding chainwheel and a unidirectional chainwheel; wherein, with the exterior extremity joined to the retarding chainwheel, the retarding chainwheel drives the torque transmitter to rotate in both directions and a reverse rotation of the torque transmitter displaces the coupling sleeve toward the retarding base to press the at least one friction shoe against the inner circumferential wall of the casing; and wherein, with the exterior extremity joined to the unidirectional chainwheel, the unidirectional chainwheel drives the torque transmitter to rotate in a forward direction only.

A roller carriage apparatus comprising: a roller unit and a roller mounting bracket; the roller unit including a spindle member and a roller hub defining a spindle passage aperture, the roller hub being pivotably supported on the spindle member that extends through the spindle passage aperture; the spindle member being seated within receiving slots of the roller mounting bracket with at least two resilient cushioning elements interposed therebetween; and the spindle member, when in a secured orientation, being retained in a gripping manner within the receiving slots of the roller mounting bracket by the cushioning elements.

A caster orientation tuning device for a wheelchair, comprising: a first attachment component secured to a chassis part of the wheelchair; a second attachment component secured to a castor; and an angular setting component having an upper face opposite a lower face, the upper face bearing a set of first teeth and the lower face bearing a set of second teeth, the set of first teeth numbering differently from the set of second teeth, wherein the first attachment component comprises a set of third teeth engageable with the first teeth upon releasable tightening of the angular setting component to the first attachment component, wherein the second attachment component comprises a set of fourth teeth engageable with the second teeth upon releasable tightening of the angular setting component to the second attachment component, and wherein upon turning of the angular setting component relative to at least one of the first attachment component and the second attachment component, the castor is angularly repositioned relative to the chassis part.

A wheelchair caster orientation apparatus comprising: a pivot element having an upper face bearing a first set of teeth and an opposed lower face bearing a second set of teeth, the teeth of the first set being separated by a first pitch angle and the teeth of the second set being separated by a second pitch angle differing from the first pitch angle; a chassis bracket secured to a structural rail of the wheelchair and including a third set of teeth matable with the first set; and a wheel yoke secured to a shank of a caster and including a fourth set of teeth matable with the second set, wherein the chassis bracket is selectively engageable with the pivot element, the first and third sets being meshed, wherein the wheel yoke is selectively engageable with the pivot element, the second and fourth sets being meshed, and wherein upon turning the pivot element relative to the chassis bracket and/or the wheel yoke, the angular disposition of the caster shank shifts with respect to the structural rail.

A tread article fabricated from a crosslinkable rubber mixture comprising, measured as parts by weight relative to one hundred parts of elastomer (phr): 100 phr of an elastomeric matrix containing natural caoutchouc and a polydiene-type elastomer; no less than 40 phr of reinforcing soot; optionally, one or more processing adjuvants chosen from a liquid softener, a paraffin-type wax, and blends thereof; a vulcanization package comprising a sulfur-donating crosslinker, a zinc-containing activator, an organic activator, and a blend of accelerators, the accelerator blend comprising: (i) a sulfenamide promoter, (ii) a metal dithiocarbamate promoter, and (iii) at least one of a thiazole polysulfide promoter and a thiuram polysulfide promoter.

A process for manufacturing a long-service tire, the process comprising: a) preparing a vulcanizable compound by blending: 100 parts per hundred rubber of an elastomeric material, the elastomeric material including natural caoutchouc and a polydiene elastomer; at least 40 parts per hundred rubber of carbon black filler; optionally, one or more processing additives selected from a liquid softener, a paraffin, and blends thereof; a vulcanization package comprising a sulfur donor, a zinc-containing activator, an organic activator, and a set of accelerators, the set of accelerators comprising: (i) a sulfenamide accelerator, (ii) a metal dithiocarbamate accelerator, and (iii) at least one of a thiazole polysulfide accelerator and a thiuram polysulfide accelerator; and b) vulcanizing the vulcanizable compound to produce at least a portion of the tire.

A vulcanized rubber tread article manufactured from a curable rubber blend comprising, in parts by weight per hundred parts of rubber (phr): 100 phr of a rubbery polymer matrix, the polymer matrix consisting of natural polyisoprene, a cis-polybutadiene, and an emulsion styrene-butadiene copolymer, wherein the weight ratio of the natural polyisoprene to the cis-polybutadiene falls between 50:40 and 60:30, and the weight ratio of the cis-polybutadiene to the styrene-butadiene copolymer falls between 30:20 and 40:10; 40 to 70 phr of reinforcing carbon black; no more than 1 phr of a tackifying resin; no more than 2 phr of precipitated silica; and a cure package comprising: (i) 0.5 to 2.0 phr of a sulfenamide vulcanization accelerator, (ii) 0.3 to 1.2 phr of a metal dithiocarbamate vulcanization accelerator, and (iii) 0.05 to 0.4 phr of a thiazole polysulfide vulcanization accelerator.

A pneumatic tire comprising: a liner layer having a face oriented toward an interior air chamber, wherein the face defines an indentation having a penetration distance of 20 μm to 3000 μm and a terraced lateral wall; and wherein at least one terrace of the lateral wall has a rise measuring 5 μm to 1500 μm.

A technique for treating a pneumatic tyre, comprising forming a graduated depression within a region of an interior face of the tyre, the interior face being defined by a rubber mixture; and wherein forming the graduated depression includes: eliminating a initial layer of the rubber mixture across a first zone of the region; and eliminating a subsequent layer of the rubber mixture across a second zone of the region, the second zone partially coinciding with the first zone along an intersection area such that a combined layer of the rubber mixture is eliminated within the intersection area owing to the removal of the initial layer and the subsequent layer.

A airless wheel tyre assembly, comprising: a base hoop furnished with a plurality of recessed concavities, each recessed concavity presenting a first arcuate face; a crown hoop positioned concentrically relative to the base hoop; and a load-bearing lattice linking the base hoop to the crown hoop, the lattice consisting of a plurality of struts divided into a first strut cluster and a second strut cluster spaced axially apart from the first strut cluster, each strut of the plurality of struts including: a proximal extremity coupled to the base hoop; a distal extremity coupled to the crown hoop; a first face and a second face oriented opposite the first face, each of the first face and the second face extending from the proximal extremity to the distal extremity; and a base flange located adjacent the proximal extremity, the first face at the base flange defining a second arcuate face, the second arcuate face being bonded to the first arcuate face of one of the recessed concavities to join the proximal extremity of the strut to the base hoop.

A process for fabricating a airless wheel tyre, the process comprising: supplying an inner annular member possessing a first girth and an outer annular member possessing a second girth exceeding the first girth; creating a series of recessed contours on the inner annular member, each recessed contour presenting a first arcuate face; shaping a set of web members, each web member including an obverse face and a reverse face oriented opposite the obverse face, the obverse face and the reverse face each extending between a leading extremity and a trailing extremity, the shaping of the web members incorporating a base section adjacent the leading extremity, the obverse face at the base section defining a second arcuate face; joining the inner annular member to the outer annular member by a first web group and a second web group, the joining including securing the second arcuate face of the web member at the base section to the first arcuate face of one of the recessed contours to attach the leading extremity to the inner annular member and coupling the trailing extremity to the outer annular member; and

query_text: A tyre comprising: a first and a second bead, each bead having a core and a filler projecting radially outward from the core; a first and a second side wall each extending radially outward from a respective bead; a crown section positioned between the side walls; and a casing layer bridging the beads and incorporated within the tyre, wherein each side wall has a flank elastomer, wherein the casing layer has an ascending layer and a descending layer, the ascending layer including a main run that passes from the crown section through the side walls to positions axially inside the beads, and a turned-up segment joined to the main run that is looped about the bead core and reversed to lie radially outward, the descending layer passing from the crown section through the side walls to positions axially outside the beads, and wherein a sensing element is captured between the turned-up segment of the ascending layer and the descending layer and sits radially farther outward than an inner terminus of the flank elastomer.

A pneumatic tyre comprising: a ring-shaped running portion; an interior face bounding in part a cavity of the tyre; a ring-shaped layer of puncture-sealing material disposed at least partly on the interior face beneath the running portion in a radial direction, the sealing layer having an inboard surface and an outboard surface; a first conductive film covering at least partly one of the surfaces of the sealing layer; a second conductive film positioned substantially parallel to the first conductive film and electrically insulated from the first conductive film; and a detection circuit electrically coupled separately to the first conductive film and the second conductive film, the detection circuit being operable to sense a rise in electrical conductance between the first conductive film and the second conductive film.

A pneumatic vehicle wheel covering comprising: a ring-shaped running surface portion; a boundary wall partly bounding an internal air chamber; a ring-shaped viscous puncture-resistant film positioned on the boundary wall beneath the running surface portion; a first conductive film overlying at least some of a radially innermost face of the puncture-resistant film, wherein the puncture-resistant film exhibits a volume resistivity electrically at least one hundred times greater than a volume resistivity of the first conductive film; a second conductive film disposed radially outward of the puncture-resistant film; and a monitoring circuit in discrete electrical connection with the first conductive film and the second conductive film, the monitoring circuit being arranged to sense a short between the first conductive film and the second conductive film and further including a radio emitter that wirelessly sends a notification indicating a sensed short.

A pneumatic tyre comprising: a casing whose interior face is formed from a rubber-based compound and which bounds, in part, an inflatable chamber; a fitted member having a bonding face formed from a macromolecular material, the bonding face being secured to a region of the interior face by means of a cement layer; and wherein the bonding face bears a textured arrangement of protrusions having a vertical extent between 20 μm and 1000 μm.

A process for affixing a part to a section of an interior wall of a pneumatic tire, the process comprising: furnishing a tire having an interior wall bounding an inflatable chamber; furnishing a part having a bonding face made of a polymeric material and bearing a relief design formed on the bonding face; spreading a bonding agent over at least one of the bonding face and the section of the interior wall; and pressing the bonding face of the part against the section of the interior wall.

An apparatus for housing a monitoring device within a pneumatic tire, the apparatus comprising: a enclosure having a mounting face formed of a rubber-based material, the mounting face bearing a relief texture with a plurality of protrusions each rising between 20 μm and 1000 μm; and a pressure monitoring transducer supported by the enclosure.

A tire-state telemetry apparatus, comprising: at least one detector affixed to a circuit board, the at least one detector arranged to sense at least one attribute of a tire; radio-frequency tag circuitry affixed to the circuit board and electrically connected to a loop-type radiator affixed to the circuit board, the tag circuitry arranged to scavenge power and emit gathered tire information upon receipt of a query signal, wherein the tag circuitry is adjusted to accept query signals within a band spanning at least 868 MHz through at least 915 MHz; and control circuitry affixed to the circuit board, the control circuitry arranged to retrieve the gathered tire information from the at least one detector in response to a received query signal and supply the gathered tire information to the tag circuitry for emission.

A tire-pressure telemetry arrangement, comprising: a wheel-mounted sensing unit having radio-frequency identification (RFID) electronics populated on a circuit board and electrically connected to a loop-type antenna carried by the board, the electronics operable to scavenge power and emit recorded wheel information upon receipt of a polling signal, wherein the electronics are calibrated to respond to polling signals spanning at least 868 MHz through at least 915 MHz; and a radio-frequency reader configured to emit a polling signal at approximately 868 MHz or approximately 915 MHz so as to retrieve the recorded wheel information from the sensing unit, the recorded wheel information being relayed to at least one processing device upon request.

A glass pane handling fixture for use in installing automotive glazing, the fixture comprising: an attachment unit adapted to be fastened to a lateral pane of a motor vehicle; a base body fixedly joined to the attachment unit; an indexing rotary hub carried by the base body; a pivot linkage projecting from the indexing rotary hub; and a holding bracket coupled to the pivot linkage, wherein the holding bracket is shaped to couple with a carrier beam of a glass pane suspension assembly; wherein the indexing rotary hub governs stepwise angular displacement of the pivot linkage that shifts the holding bracket between a lowered position and an elevated position at successive angularly offset stations of the indexing rotary hub.

A wheel spoke assembly, comprising a tensile cord and threaded fittings, wherein securing collars are affixed to opposite extremities of the tensile cord; apertures passing completely through are provided in the threaded fittings; and the threaded fittings are affixed onto the securing collars by way of the apertures.

A vehicle road wheel carrier, comprising: a central mounting section; a dome-shaped section positioned next to the central mounting section on its outer radial side, the dome-shaped section projecting axially outward and including a ring-shaped crown, a sloping sidewall linking the crown to the central mounting section, and a perimeter wall located radially beyond the crown; a series of weld tabs and a series of window-defining tabs arranged in an alternating pattern along an edge of the perimeter wall of the dome-shaped section, both the weld tabs and the window-defining tabs extending axially inward, wherein the weld tabs are joined by welding to an interior surface of a wheel barrel, wherein the window-defining tabs are shaped to delimit openings between themselves and the interior surface of the wheel barrel, wherein the perimeter wall comprises first zones coupled to the weld tabs and second zones coupled to the window-defining tabs, the first zones and the second zones alternating around a circumference, wherein the second zones are coupled to the window-defining tabs through joining segments that project axially outward relative to adjacent portions of the first zones across spans encompassing midpoints of the joining segments in the circumferential direction, and wherein the joining segments and the adjacent portions lie at identical radial distances from a central rotational axis of the wheel.

An air-resistance-reducing cycle hoop, comprising: a peripheral tread-retaining section configured to receive a tyre; a central hub-linking section configured to receive spokes; and a pair of lateral flanks disposed on opposite sides between the peripheral tread-retaining section and the central hub-linking section, the hoop defining a midplane bisecting its breadth; wherein the hoop further includes a series of undulating contours extending from the central hub-linking section to both lateral flanks, mirror-arranged about the midplane, the undulating contours being consecutively disposed to define a ring-shaped drag-reducing configuration, and the undulating contours including alternating peaks and valleys.

A pneumatic wheel covering apparatus comprising: at least one hoop arrangement including a shape-retentive alloy strip possessing an exterior face, the strip encircling the apparatus in a peripheral direction; a bead element possessing an exterior face, the bead element encircling the apparatus in a peripheral direction; and a multiplicity of filamentary strengthening strands, each strand wrapping about the exterior face of the strip and the exterior face of the bead element to constitute the hoop arrangement.

A tyre arrangement comprising: at least one belt arrangement including a first shape-memory alloy strip having an exterior face, the first strip running in a peripheral direction around the arrangement; a second shape-memory alloy strip having an exterior face, the second strip running in the peripheral direction and situated sideways next to the first strip; a first bead component having an exterior face, the bead component running in the peripheral direction around the arrangement; and a first fiber-composite sheath that includes a multitude of fiber strands embedded in a resin body, the sheath wrapping around the exterior face of the first strip, the exterior face of the second strip and the exterior face of the bead component, the sheath extending in the peripheral direction around the arrangement.

A non-air-filled resilient wheel, comprising: a ring-shaped structural member; a helical passageway formed within the structural member, the helical passageway traversing continuously from a leading terminus to a trailing terminus.

A road-going tyre assembly comprising: lateral walls and a contact band having at least one outboard-positioned ridge bounded by a peripheral channel, the ridge possessing an external face and a shoulder incline reaching the corresponding lateral wall; wherein the outboard ridge carries recesses that originate at the shoulder incline and terminate in an aperture on the external face; wherein the aperture is bounded on an inward side of the contact band by a first limiting border lying wholly within the outboard ridge, and along the peripheral direction by two second limiting borders, and wherein the aperture between the second limiting borders measures a breadth (b1) with a peak value of 10.0 mm to 30.0 mm; wherein the aperture of the recess, viewed from above, is oblong-rectangular in the axial direction or oblong-trapezoidal in the axial direction; wherein the recess includes a terminal incline extending from the first limiting border and a floor; wherein the terminal incline, viewed from above in a section taken perpendicular to the first limiting border, extends at an angle (ε) of 8° to 20° relative to the radial direction, and wherein the floor, viewed from above in a section aligned perpendicular to the first limiting border, comprises an inner floor section maintained at a uniform depth (tmin), an outer floor section inclined at an angle (θ) of 30° to 60° relative to the radial direction, and an intermediate floor section bulging outwardly in an arc and tangentially merging with said floor sections.

A vehicle pneumatic tyre comprising: lateral walls and a tread having at least one outboard-located contour band bounded by a peripheral channel with a band exterior face and a shoulder incline reaching the corresponding lateral wall; wherein the outboard contour band incorporates recesses that originate at the shoulder incline and open onto the band exterior face: wherein each opening is bounded on an inward side of the tread by a first bounding margin lying wholly inside the outboard contour band, and in the peripheral direction by two second bounding margins, and wherein the aperture between the second bounding margins in the peripheral direction exhibits a breadth (b 1 ) peaking at 10.0 mm to 30.0 mm; wherein the aperture of the recess, viewed from above, is oblong-rectangular along the axial direction or oblong-trapezoidal along the axial direction; wherein the recess possesses an end incline extending from the first bounding margin, and a floor; wherein the end incline, viewed from above in a section taken perpendicular to the first bounding margin, slopes at an angle (ε) of 8° to 20° relative to the radial direction, and wherein the floor, viewed from above in a section oriented perpendicularly to the first bounding margin, comprises an inner floor segment running at a uniform depth (tmin), an outer floor segment inclined at an angle (θ) of 30° to 60° relative to the radial direction, and a middle floor segment that bulges outwardly in an arc and tangentially merges with these floor segments; wherein the breadth (b 1 ) of the aperture of the recess diminishes steadily toward the inward side of the tread, such that the breadth (b 1 ) attains its greatest value (b 1 max) at the outer tread ends of the second bounding margins and its smallest value (b 1 min) at the inner tread ends of the second bounding margins; wherein the smallest value (b 1 min) of the breadth (b 1 ) amounts to 40% to 60%; and the peripheral channel, viewed from above, follows a zigzag course and is formed of channel sections each extending at an angle (α) of 15° to 30°, in particular 20° to 25°, relative to the peripheral direction, wherein the outboard peripheral channel at the channel sections each has a turning point with an inner turn side and an outer turn side, and wherein the recesses are each situated axially adjacent the inner turn side.

A noise-attenuating pneumatic vehicle wheel covering comprising: a set of tread lugs arranged on an outer running surface; a channel positioned between adjacent lugs and running around the periphery of the covering; and ridge structures composed of multiple raised elements rising from a floor and a sidewall of the channel and aligned lengthwise with the channel, wherein acoustic energy is diminished through heat dissipation arising from friction produced by the multiple raised elements.

An apparatus for insertion within an interior void formed between a rim and a tread band to partition that void into multiple compartments, the apparatus comprising: a conduit for conveying pressurized gas; a set of inflatable dividers, each divider having a mounting pedestal affixed to the rim and provided with a gas channel communicating with the conduit, and a distensible bladder coupled to the pedestal and communicating with the gas channel to receive gas from the conduit; and a gasket encircling a peripheral edge of the distensible bladder, wherein the dividers are operable to accept gas from the conduit to transition from a collapsed state to a swollen state in which the dividers press against an interior surface of the tread band mounted on the rim to subdivide the interior void into the multiple compartments.

An apparatus for insertion within an interior void formed between a rim and a casing to partition the void into multiple compartments, the apparatus comprising: a pneumatic conduit; a set of inflatable dividers, each divider of the set including: a mounting pedestal configured to attach to the rim, the pedestal forming a channel in communication with the pneumatic conduit; a bladder joined to the pedestal and communicating with the channel by way of the pedestal, the bladder being fillable from the pneumatic conduit; and a sealing collar running around a periphery of the bladder and communicating with the channel of the pedestal, the collar being inflatable and fillable with air from the pneumatic conduit to swell the collar from a collapsed state to a distended state in which the collar presses against an interior surface of the casing mounted on the rim to partition the void into the multiple compartments.

A tire-and-rim arrangement comprising: a rim having a hub; a tyre fitted onto the rim so as to enclose an interior chamber between the rim and the tyre; a divider arrangement secured to the rim within the interior chamber, the divider arrangement including: a conduit running circumferentially along the rim, the conduit cooperating with a fitting adapted to couple with a pressurized gas supply for delivering gas from the supply into the conduit; and a plurality of partitions attached to the rim and fluidly linked to the conduit to draw gas from the conduit, each partition being transitionable from a collapsed state to an expanded state upon gas from the conduit entering the partitions, wherein in the expanded state the partitions press against an inner surface of the tyre to separate the interior chamber into a plurality of gas-sealed compartments; wherein each partition includes: a distensible bladder in fluid communication with the conduit to receive gas therefrom for inflating the bladder; and a gasket encircling an outer periphery of the bladder, the gasket being in fluid communication with the conduit to receive gas therefrom for inflating the gasket.

A tire-mounted sensing apparatus comprising: a casing affixed to an interior circumferential face of a tyre through a resilient bonding agent; a depression formed in a terminal face of the casing that opposes the interior circumferential face of the tyre; a deformation sensor arranged at a central region of the depression that senses distortion of the tyre through the resilient bonding agent; and a compliant body positioned along an inner rim region of the depression and projecting toward the interior circumferential face of the tyre beyond the terminal face of the casing, wherein a gap bounded by a floor of the depression and the interior circumferential face of the tyre, inside the compliant body, is occupied by the resilient bonding agent.

A venting closure device comprising: a primary discharge bore extending from an interior face into the closure and communicating with a lateral discharge channel crossing the primary discharge bore, the primary discharge bore and the lateral discharge channel joined to form an uninterrupted route for fluid flow, the primary discharge bore including a frustoconical wall that narrows toward the interior face and widens away from the interior face, the primary discharge bore including a ledge disposed opposite the frustoconical wall; a valve member seated within the primary discharge bore, the valve member having a shank projecting from a head portion of the valve member, the shank including a collar disposed opposite the head portion, the head portion positioned adjacent the frustoconical wall, the head portion including an annular groove configured to hold a gasket, the valve member displaceable between a sealed orientation, in which the gasket engages the frustoconical wall, and an unsealed orientation in which the gasket is separated from the frustoconical wall; and a resilient element interposed between the ledge and the collar, the resilient element urging the valve member toward the sealed orientation.

A pressure relief fitting comprising: an outlet bore penetrating from a interior face into a body and joining a crosswise discharge channel crossing said outlet bore, said outlet bore and said crosswise discharge channel joined to furnish an uninterrupted flow route for a gas, said outlet bore having a frustoconical wall that narrows toward said interior face and widens away from said interior face; a valve element disposed within said outlet bore, said valve element having a shank projecting from a terminal section of said valve element and said shank having a collar facing away from said terminal section, said terminal section of said valve element abutting said frustoconical wall, said terminal section including a circumferential groove for holding a gasket, said valve element displaceable between a shut setting in which said gasket engages said frustoconical wall and an unseated setting in which said gasket is separated from said frustoconical wall; and a coil biasing member positioned between said collar of said valve element and said body, said coil biasing member urging said valve element toward said shut setting.

A pressure relief fitting comprising: a body defining a primary bore opening from an interior face and extending into the body, and intersecting a lateral flow channel, the primary bore and the lateral flow channel joined to establish an uninterrupted fluid route, the primary bore having a frustoconical wall that narrows toward the interior face and widens away from it; a flexible collar positioned beside a locking channel, the collar configured to bend inward upon insertion into an opening; a valve member disposed within the primary bore, the valve member having a shank projecting from an end section, the shank terminating in a shoulder positioned opposite the end section, the end section adjoining the frustoconical wall and incorporating a circumferential groove that holds a sealing element, the valve member displaceable between a shut state in which the sealing element engages the frustoconical wall and an unseated state in which the sealing element is separated from the frustoconical wall; and a coil element interposed between the shoulder and the body, the coil element urging the valve member into the shut state.

A traction assembly capable of yielding under load, designed for mounting on a rover traversing lunar or Martian terrain, comprising: a central core member; a flexible annular band positioned encircling and coaxial with the core member, the band including a stack of coaxial rings separated by interlayers each formed of a substance whose elastic modulus is between roughly 600,000 and 1,000 times smaller than that of the rings; a set of wire tension elements extending radially between the core member and the band, each element secured at an outer extremity to the band and at an inner extremity to the core member; wherein the band is enveloped by at least one insulating sheath formed of a material exhibiting a thermal conductivity below 0.2 W m−1 K−1; and wherein the assembly further includes apparatus for warming the interlayers of the band.

A non-inflatable, yielding ground-engaging wheel, the yielding wheel comprising: a central core member; an endless laminated band configured to contact the terrain, arranged encircling and coaxial with the central core member, and including a series of coaxially nested rings joined through intervening layers each formed of a substance whose elastic modulus is between 1000 and 600000 times smaller than that of the rings; and a set of metallic wires extending along radial directions and linking the central core member to the endless laminated band, each wire being secured at an outer extremity to the endless laminated band and at an inner extremity to the central core member; wherein the endless laminated band is enveloped by at least one heat-blocking sheath composed of at least one material exhibiting a thermal conductivity below 0.2 W m-1 K-1, and the yielding wheel further includes apparatus for warming the intervening layers of the endless laminated band.

A load-supporting, non-inflatable rolling assembly adapted for locomotion over harsh terrain such as lunar regsolith and Martian soil, comprising: a central carrier provided with at least one rotatable flange extending outwardly in a radial direction; a ring-shaped flexible running member encircling the carrier, having an exterior face configured to engage the terrain and deform under an applied weight so as to conform to the terrain contour, and an interior face configured to abut the flange so as to restrict radial compression of the running member; and a series of spoke-like members joining the running member to the carrier; wherein the flange is pivotally supported on the carrier such that it turns about the carrier axis upon contact with the interior face of the running member.

A load-supporting, non-pneumatic compliant ground-engaging member, comprising: a central core carrying at least one radially protruding retaining flange; a flexible ring-shaped skin disposed about the core, presenting an exterior face that yields when subjected to an applied weight so as to conform to the terrain, and an interior face that engages the retaining flange to restrict radial yielding of the skin; and a series of spokes joining the skin to the core; wherein the retaining flange is journaled for rotation relative to the core.

A two-wheeler pneumatic tyre comprising: a tread section presenting a first shoulder boundary, a second shoulder boundary and a road-engaging face interposed between them; the road-engaging face including a first half extending from a mid-circumferential plane to the first shoulder boundary; wherein, when said first half is partitioned along its developed breadth into five equal bands arranged sequentially from the mid-circumferential plane toward the first shoulder boundary, namely a first band, a second band, a third band, a fourth band and a fifth band, a rubber coverage fraction Lb2 of the second band exceeds a rubber coverage fraction Lb1 of the first band and exceeds a rubber coverage fraction Lb3 of the third band.

A pneumatic article of manufacture, comprising: a rubber body defining at least one exterior face; a zone situated on the exterior face and bearing a multiplicity of raised features; and the raised features being distributed in a quasi-random arrangement throughout the zone.

A device, comprising: a article formed from elastomeric material having an exterior face; at least one zone situated upon the exterior face, the at least one zone bearing a multiplicity of raised features; and the raised features being arranged in a quasi-random distribution throughout the zone.

A tire for a vehicle wheel, the tire comprising: a set of acoustic Helmholtz resonators mounted on an interior surface bounding an enclosed air chamber; wherein the resonators exhibit an uppermost tuned frequency and a lowermost tuned frequency, and the spread between the uppermost and lowermost tuned frequencies lies within a range of 10 to 90 Hz.

A tyre assembly comprising: a tread section; a pair of flank regions, each flank region extending radially inward from a respective one of two axially opposite edges of the tread section; a pair of bead regions, each bead region positioned radially inward of a respective one of the flank regions; and a plurality of resonant cavity acoustic dampers mounted on an interior surface bounding an inner chamber of the tyre, wherein the plurality of resonant cavity acoustic dampers includes a first damper tuned to a first resonant frequency and a second damper tuned to a second resonant frequency differing from the first resonant frequency, and each of the first damper and the second damper is located axially inward of at least one of the pair of flank regions.

A tyre assembly comprising: a tread section; a pair of flank regions, each flank region extending radially inward from a respective one of opposite axial edges of the tread section; a pair of bead regions, each bead region positioned radially inward of a respective one of the flank regions; and a plurality of resonant acoustic dampers mounted to an interior surface of the tyre cavity, the resonant acoustic dampers exhibiting mutually distinct tuning frequencies, wherein each of the resonant acoustic dampers includes at least one damping cavity enclosing an internal volume and a conduit section coupling the at least one damping cavity to the tyre cavity.

A method for issuing a warning relating to tire inflation, the method comprising: acquiring a fixed loading figure and a measured inflation level of a wheel; establishing a minimum acceptable inflation level from the fixed loading figure, the measured inflation level, and a predefined correspondence linking the fixed loading figure, the measured inflation level, and the minimum acceptable inflation level; and contrasting the measured inflation level against the minimum acceptable inflation level, and generating a warning output when the measured inflation level falls below the minimum acceptable inflation level.

A towing attachment arrangement, comprising: a transverse impact member; an energy-absorbing support element; and a towing eyelet, including: a forward attachment portion; and a rearward attachment portion, wherein: the forward attachment portion is fastened to the transverse impact member, and the rearward attachment portion is fastened to the energy-absorbing support element.

A tyre assembly comprising: a casing ply extending annularly between a pair of bead cores; a reinforcing ring arranged radially outward of the casing ply; and a tread band situated radially outward of the reinforcing ring; wherein the reinforcing ring is a looped band formed from a rubber-sheathed filament that alternates direction in the plane of the band so as to traverse in a serpentine pattern around the circumference, the filament presenting turnaround segments at opposite lateral extremities of the band and oblique runs disposed inboard of those turnaround segments and inclined to the circumferential direction; a lateral perimeter of the band being delineated by a succession of the turnaround segments aligned along the circumference; wherein, when the band is unrolled into a flat plan, crossing points of the filament at which it meets itself between two neighbouring turnaround segments are denoted as nodes, a circumferential spacing between two adjacent nodes, a diameter of the filament, and an oblique angle of the filament measured against the circumferential direction along the oblique runs satisfy either: 5° < angle ≤ 10° and spacing < 3 × diameter / tan(angle − 2°), or 10° < angle ≤ 45° and spacing < 3 × diameter / tan(angle − 5°).

A tire having a sidewall-to-sidewall casing wound between a pair of inextensible bead cores, a reinforcing ply arranged radially outward of the casing, and an outer tread layer arranged radially outward of the reinforcing ply, wherein the reinforcing ply is a closed loop formed from an elastomer-encased filament that alternates direction in the circumferential sense so as to reverse heading toward the axial midline at each lateral margin, the filament presenting reversal segments at the lateral margins and angled runs extending from those segments toward the equatorial region, a lateral edge of the closed loop being delimited by a succession of the reversal segments arrayed in the circumferential direction, and wherein, when the closed loop is flattened and viewed in plan, a crossing point T is defined where the filament meets itself across two circumferentially adjacent reversal segments, an angle θ1 between the filament and the circumferential direction along the angled runs and an angle θ2 between the filament and the circumferential direction at the reversal segments, measured in an edge elevation of the lateral margin, satisfy either 5° < θ1 ≤ 10° together with θ2 > θ1 − 2°, or 10° < θ1 ≤ 45° together with θ2 > θ1 − 5°.

A tyre monitoring apparatus comprising: a data receiving unit adapted to obtain location data identifying where a wheel is fitted on a motor vehicle, together with wheel condition data including gas pressure within the wheel; an evaluation unit adapted to decide whether the gas pressure within the wheel is irregular based on the wheel condition data; and an alerting unit adapted to transmit the fitted location and an irregular pressure finding for any wheel found to have irregular pressure to a designated recipient.

A computer-readable storage medium storing program code that, when executed, directs a tire monitoring apparatus to perform operations comprising: obtaining location data identifying where a wheel-mounted tire is positioned on a motor vehicle and tire status data reflecting a condition of the tire, including air pressure; evaluating the tire status data to identify an irregular air pressure in the tire; and transmitting the tire position and an irregular air pressure finding for the tire to a designated recipient.

A tyre supervision technique carried out by a tyre supervision apparatus, the technique comprising: obtaining location data specifying where a tyre is fitted on an automobile and fitted-tyre data that describes the condition of the tyre, including inflation pressure; judging an irregular inflation pressure of the tyre on the basis of the fitted-tyre data; and transmitting the fitted location and an irregular-pressure judgement outcome for the tyre judged to have the irregular inflation pressure to a designated recipient.

A guarding apparatus for a rolling compactor element, comprising: one or more serrated cutting members, each of the one or more serrated cutting members comprising: a three-sided protrusion having a pair of angled flank faces, an upper face, and a lower face; and a rectilinear mounting base having an upper face and a planar underside, wherein the upper face of the rectilinear mounting base is bonded by brazing to the lower face of the three-sided protrusion.

A rolling assembly comprising: a hub possessing an outer shell that encircles a central spindle axis; a set of projections secured to the outer shell so as to extend outwardly therefrom, wherein a group of the projections are spaced evenly about the spindle axis along an outer margin of the outer shell; and a series of anti-snag inserts each including a foundation having a curved outer face and a planar underside opposite the curved outer face, wherein the curved outer face of the foundation carries a sequence of ridged teeth distributed from a leading extremity of the foundation to a trailing extremity thereof opposite the leading extremity, and a set of cutting protrusions, wherein each of the cutting protrusions includes a three-sided wedge having a pair of triangular flanks, an upper crest, and a lower face, wherein the upper crest has a first slope oriented toward one direction and a second slope oriented toward an opposing direction, a rounded transition joining the first slope and the second slope, and a rectangular mounting strip possessing an upper face and a level base face, wherein the upper face of the rectangular mounting strip is bonded by brazing to the lower face of the three-sided wedge, wherein the level base face of the rectangular mounting strip of each of the cutting protrusions is fixed to a corresponding one of the ridged teeth on the curved outer face of the foundation, and wherein the planar underside of the foundation of each of the anti-snag inserts is joined to the outer shell of the hub between a corresponding adjacent pair of projections in the group of projections.

A tire-protection assembly for a landfill compaction drum, the assembly comprising: a carrier body having an outer perimeter surface, the outer perimeter surface including a series of planar regions extending from a leading edge of the carrier body to a trailing edge of the carrier body; and a set of serrated blades, each serrated blade including a three-sided cutting projection defined by two angled flanks, an upper ridge, and a lower face, the upper ridge having a first slope facing one direction and a second slope facing the opposite direction, with a rounded transition between the first slope and the second slope; and a flat mounting base having an upper face bonded by brazing to the lower face of the three-sided cutting projection, and a planar underside.

A ground-engaging roller apparatus for a towed cart, comprising: a rolling element; a carrier structure, the carrier structure including a wear plate, a left flange member, and a right flange member; the left flange member and the right flange member project outwardly from respective lateral edges of the wear plate; the rolling element is mounted for rotation to the left flange member and the right flange member, and the rolling element is disposed between the left flange member and the right flange member; and a leading region of a circumferential tread of the rolling element is shielded by the wear plate, the left flange member and the right flange member.

A caster-style trundle assembly for a towed carriage, comprising: a rolling member; a mounting bracket including a wear strip, a left flange, and a right flange; the left flange and the right flange project outward from transversely opposed edges of the wear strip; the rolling member is journaled to the left flange and the right flange, and is disposed between the left flange and the right flange; the left flange defines a first trailing face, the right flange defines a second trailing face, the first trailing face carries a first trailing brace having a first crown contact face, and the second trailing face carries a second trailing brace having a second crown contact face; the wear strip includes a top face extending between a leading edge of the left flange and a leading edge of the right flange; and the top face of the wear strip, the first crown contact face, and the second crown contact face are adapted to seat against an underside of a chassis rail of a trailer.

A trailer-mounted ground-contact roller assembly, comprising: a rolling element; a chassis, the chassis including a glide plate, a primary arm, and a secondary arm; the primary arm and the secondary arm project outward from opposing sides of the glide plate; the primary arm defines a first trailing face, the secondary arm defines a second trailing face, the first trailing face carries a first rearward brace, and the second trailing face carries a second rearward brace; and the rolling element is journaled to the primary arm and the secondary arm, the rolling element sits between the primary arm and the secondary arm, and the rolling element is situated between the glide plate on one side and the first and second rearward braces on the other.

A ground-engaging roller apparatus for a towed carriage, comprising: a rolling element; a chassis assembly, the chassis assembly including a guard panel, a primary bracket, and a secondary bracket; the primary bracket and the secondary bracket project outward from opposite edges of the guard panel; the rolling element is pivotally coupled to the primary bracket and the secondary bracket, and the rolling element is situated between the primary bracket and the secondary bracket; and a leading section of the rolling element is shielded by the guard panel.

A securing bolt for attaching a rotor to a hub assembly, comprising: an elongated stem; a flange produced at one extremity of the stem, or a mating nut arranged to engage the stem; and at least one vibration-absorbing element incorporated within the stem and/or mounted on a face of the flange or the mating nut.

A ground-engaging wheel apparatus comprising: a hub member; a shell member encircling the hub member; a set of pneumatic struts interposed between the hub member and the shell member; and a traction band supported by the shell member, the traction band including a compliant elastomeric sublayer disposed on an exterior periphery of the shell member, and a rigid metal skin supported by the compliant elastomeric sublayer to roll against a terrain surface during travel along a course.

A ground-engaging roller apparatus, comprising: a hub member; a shell member encircling the hub member; a set of pneumatic dampers linked between the hub member and the shell member; and a traction sleeve mounted on the shell member and including an elastomeric underlayer bonded to an outer peripheral face of the shell member, a metal skin disposed over the elastomeric underlayer to roll against terrain during travel along a route, and a steel carcass supporting the elastomeric underlayer and the metal skin.

A process for fabricating a rolling assembly, the process comprising: mounting a set of pneumatic-type resilient struts between an interior hub and an exterior hoop; and affixing a ground-engaging covering to the exterior hoop, the covering including a compliant elastomeric stratum seated upon a peripheral outer face of the exterior hoop, and an exterior sheet of metal supported atop the compliant elastomeric stratum so as to roll against a terrain surface as the rolling assembly traverses a travel route.

A two-wheeler tyre comprising: a running surface section; a couple of flank regions; a pair of rim-engaging regions; and a casing body running over and between the pair of rim-engaging regions, wherein the running surface section incorporates a reinforcing structure disposed radially outside the casing body, and an elastomeric cover disposed radially outside the reinforcing structure, the reinforcing structure comprises a crossing ply having a plurality of inclined reinforcers oriented obliquely relative to a circumferential direction of the tyre, and a restraining ply disposed radially outside the crossing ply and having at least one reinforcer spirally wound along the circumferential direction, an axial extent of the restraining ply being less than an axial extent of the crossing ply, the elastomeric cover includes a central compound situated across an equatorial plane of the tyre, and flanking compounds each situated axially outward of the central compound adjacent a tread margin, a hardness at 100° C. of each flanking compound exceeds a hardness at 100° C. of the central compound, a complex modulus at 100° C. of each flanking compound exceeds a complex modulus at 100° C. of the central compound, and a 300% tensile modulus at 100° C. of each flanking compound exceeds a 300% tensile modulus at 100° C. of the central compound.

A heavy-duty pneumatic tyre, comprising: a reinforcing belt assembly formed of three stacked strata of belting; and an elastomeric interlayer, the belt assembly and the interlayer being situated between a carcass ply and a outer wear strip; each stratum possessing a multitude of filaments and a coating compound enveloping the multitude of filaments, wherein the belt assembly incorporates: a first stratum positioned radially outward of the interlayer; a second stratum positioned radially outward of the first stratum; and a third stratum positioned radially outward of the second stratum, wherein a stiffness of the interlayer equals a stiffness of the coating compound of the first stratum, and wherein the interlayer exhibits a gauge of not less than 1.5 mm and not more than 2.0 mm.

A heavy-duty radial tyre, comprising: a crown reinforcement formed from three laminated strata of reinforcing plies situated between a carcass layer and a tread band, each stratum incorporating a set of filaments encased in a coating compound; wherein the crown reinforcement contains: a lowermost ply positioned radially outward of the carcass layer; an intermediate ply positioned radially outward of the lowermost ply; and an uppermost ply positioned radially outward of the intermediate ply; and wherein the filaments of the lowermost ply are arranged radially outward of a radial midpoint of the lowermost ply.

A pneumatic tyre comprising: a tread section having a first tread edge, and at least one first shoulder land element bounded by the first tread edge, the first shoulder land element includes a first ground-contacting face extending medially from the first tread edge along a tyre axial direction, a first flank face extending radially inward from the first tread edge, and a second ground-contacting face extending laterally outward from the first flank face along the tyre axial direction, the second ground-contacting face is inclined at an angle of no more than 10° with respect to a tangent line touching the first ground-contacting face at the first tread edge, as viewed in a tyre meridian section of the first shoulder land element, and at least one channel is formed within the second ground-contacting face.

A tyre arrangement, comprising: a carcass featuring a ground-engaging crown, a pair of lateral transitions, a pair of flanks, and a pair of rim-seating regions, wherein the flanks extend radially between the corresponding transitions and the corresponding rim-seating regions, wherein each of the flanks is overhung in configuration, such that each respective transition protrudes axially outward beyond the full extent of its respective flank; and a deformable flank-reinforcing band disposed axially outboard of and abutting each flank together with its respective rim-seating region, wherein the deformable flank-reinforcing band is ring-shaped, and wherein the deformable flank-reinforcing band lies outside of and is distinct from the carcass.

A tyre arrangement, comprising: a tyre possessing a running surface, a pair of flanks at its outer edges, a pair of sidewalls, and a pair of bead regions, wherein the sidewalls extend radially between the respective flanks and the respective bead regions, wherein each sidewall is of overhanging form, with each flank protruding axially outwardly beyond the whole of its corresponding sidewall, and a pliable sidewall reinforcement member situated axially outboard of and touching each sidewall and its associated bead region, wherein the pliable sidewall reinforcement member is ring-shaped, wherein the pliable sidewall reinforcement member lies outside of and apart from the tyre, and wherein the tyre arrangement is seated on a wheel having a split rim with a first rim section and a second rim section, and wherein each rim section incorporates a rim lip.

A valve actuator mount for a fluid control device having a housing with a peripheral groove and a closure element carrying a lug, the mount comprising: a housing receptacle dimensioned to accept the housing, the receptacle including at least one latch component partially located within the receptacle, the at least one latch component being situated to register with the peripheral groove when the housing is seated in the receptacle; and a stop protrusion positioned adjacent a terminal end of the receptacle, the stop protrusion being situated to contact the lug when the housing is seated in the receptacle.

An assembly comprising: a dispensing unit including a housing defining an interior recess dimensioned to accept a main body; at least one catch element partially situated inside the recess; and a stop protrusion located near a terminal region of the recess; and a flow regulator including a primary casing having a bore and a peripheral groove, the groove being oriented to accommodate the at least one catch element when the regulator is seated in the recess; a plunger component having a secondary protrusion slidably positioned within the bore; and a gasket situated in the bore, the secondary protrusion being shaped to mate with the stop protrusion when the regulator is located in the recess and to push the plunger component away from the gasket.

An apparatus for determining mass comprising: a hitch-receiving platform adapted to bear a trailer tow ball thereupon; an elevation-modifiable structure selectively settable to place the hitch-receiving platform at a mass-sensing elevation; a base member engageable with a ground-contacting support to hold the apparatus upright; a force-sensing arrangement that generates and conveys a signal representative of a load applied to the hitch-receiving platform, the force-sensing arrangement comprising a carrier positioned above the base member that locates a transducer where it is struck when the load is imposed on the hitch-receiving platform; and an enclosure affixed to the elevation-modifiable structure and shaped to carry the force-sensing arrangement.

A load-measuring apparatus comprising: a hitch-receiving saddle adapted to carry a trailer tow ball thereon; a base pad adapted to rest the apparatus upon a ground plane; a vertically extensible column having an upper tube slidably received within a lower tube and a locking element for fixing the slide position of the upper tube relative to the lower tube to set a saddle elevation above the base pad; and a strain transducer housed within a sensor enclosure coupled to the column, the transducer seated atop a rigid bracket inside the enclosure and including one or more strain-responsive members configured to sense a load imposed on the saddle and emit a signal representing that load; wherein the load imposed on the saddle displaces the saddle through a travel range bounded by at least one opening so as to contact the transducer.

A mass-measuring apparatus comprising: a hitch receiver platform adapted to bear a trailer tow ball thereon, the platform having a stem projecting therefrom; a vertically extensible support including an upper tube slidably received within a lower tube and a locking element for fixing the upper tube to the lower tube; a sensor enclosure affixed to the upper tube at a top end thereof, the stem passing into the sensor enclosure, and the stem being slidably held by side walls of the sensor enclosure; a force transducer disposed within the sensor enclosure, the platform displaceable such that the stem contacts the force transducer when a load is imposed on the platform, and the force transducer operative to sense the imposed load and generate an electrical signal; and a readout unit operative to receive the electrical signal and present a numerical figure representing the electrical signal.
